mission.properties|m.shopping_again_4a: Take it easy {0}, not all gremlins are cut from the same cloth.  Some disagree with the ways of King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order.  In fact, somewhere down in the Clockworks I'm told there's an entire town full of gremlins who left the Great Colony.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: A dash of Moonstone, a pinch of... H... How did you... Who are you\!? You're not supposed to be here\!
item.properties|f.spiral_round_helm: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.shadow_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who gain their powers using forbidden, dark arts.
item.properties|f.redwood: A sturdy chunk of fine, unfinished wood. It's typically used in the production of cabinets.
helptips.properties|m.atg_torto: Tortodrones can be found patrolling the Clockworks.  They will not attack unless attacked first - but be warned, once they are enraged, they are fearsome and deadly opponents.
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_2b: Do the gremlins have a leader?
chat.properties|m.unknown_item: Unknown equipment {0}. Use /help level to list equipment.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_weap_2: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
helptips.properties|m.elevator: The elevator will activate when all living party members are standing on it.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: So, you have chosen the shadowy maskeraith, battle sprite of those who wish to lurk in the shadows and strike the enemy with sneak attacks? \n\nOnce you choose there is no going back\!
item.properties|f.gh_theme_spooky: A dark and foreboding theme perfect for a Guild Hall whose members are among the recently departed.
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_dev: 'Wrap thy self in my embrace and succumb to my infinite love. Let your breath drift from you like candle smoke, dreaming deeper and deeper still.'
mission.properties|o.p_r6_mat_123: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.furni_table_manor_1: An exquisite end table, meticulously manufactured for monumental magnificence.
projectx.properties|m.instance_shutdown: There has been a server error. You will be transferred to another instance.
conversation.properties|r.emberlight_vis: I have enough info, thanks. (End conversation)
item.properties|f.armor_rear: An accessory that can be attached to the rear of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
item.properties|f.catalyzer: An advanced alchemical armament adapted from Gremlin mining and demolition devices. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
chat.properties|m.away_set: Auto-response message set. Use /back to turn it off.
item.properties|f.thricer_slicer: At some point the eggheads will figure out what these mysterious energy spikes are. But in the meantime, now we can slice and sling them at double the rate, with extra mysterious orbital spins\!
item.properties|f.vial_shock: A glass vial containing hyper-charged electric fluids. It can be used to inflict enemies with Shock.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and give your foes a real ZAP\!
chat.properties|m.user_not_online: That user is not currently online.
logon.properties|m.paying_customers_only: This server is only available to customers who have spent at least $4.95 on Energy in the last three months.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_mat_2: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|o.p_fast_advancement: Quickly power up your Knight's gear\!
chat.properties|m.usage_pbroadcast: Usage\: /{0} message\nBroadcasts message to everyone on the current peer.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_crystal: Crystal blocks are like breakable blocks except that if destroyed, they also destroy the crystal blocks of the same color connected to them.
item.properties|f.luminite_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of luminite.
dungeon.properties|m.goahead_description: Leave your party and venture out on your own.
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_2c: How do I obtain more energy?
support.properties|m.transfer_item: Transfered item "{0}" from knightId\:{1} to knightId\:{2}. (count \= {3})
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_2d: Your lessons have energized me\! I'm off to adventure, bye\!
guild.properties|l.gl_save_progress: Saving guild log to the desktop...
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_1: Visit the Hall of Heroes wearing at least 2 Star gear and receive certification
item.properties|f.style_kit: {0}  This item will be destroyed, but you will be able to re-apply this modifier to your knight using the style kit.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_3a: I'm glad you asked, they certainly do\!  Let's head over to Vatel.
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_2: Visit the Hall of Heroes wearing at least 3 Star gear and receive certification
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_1a:
{0}, still holding it together I see and earning the rank of Defender Elite no less.  Bravo. 

I've had a chance to analyze your combat data from your last mission and it's proving quite interesting.  The mecha knights in particular appear to actually be reacting to your attacks as if improvising.  But I can't say just yet. 

In any case, that's not relevant to today's data that I'm presenting.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_10a: Come in, {0}\!  What happened in there?
helptips.properties|m.loading7: If you are on fire you will take damage regularly until the fire wears off. That can't stop you from spreading it to monsters though. Get close and share the love\!
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_h: It's hard to tell, but it seems to correlate to Constructs. \n\nThese Mecha Knights went wild\! Faster, stronger -- I think one was trying to climb the elevator\!
mission.properties|b.beyond_axes_of_evil: Despite your previous efforts, gremlins have reformed their logging operation in the Jigsaw Valley in order to supply their munitions plants with resources. Given the results of their last project, the Roarmulus Twins, Spiral HQ would like you to end their eco-destruction before it becomes anything more serious\!
item.properties|f.meteor_mote: A small piece of a rare material that is said to have fallen from the sky. Gremlins typically use it in the construction of power sources.
item.properties|f.circuit_breaker_shield: A Proto Shield modified to provide some protection against shock.
item.properties|f.seraphic_helm: A beautiful mail coif that causes its wearer to strike out at evil with righteous fury.
item.properties|f.gel_core: A fist-sized, gelatinous lump collected from a jelly.
chat.properties|m.no_last_teller: Nobody has sent you a /tell to respond to.
item.properties|f.sentinel_armor: A suit of armor imbued with the power to repel the various afflictions that knights might encounter in the line of duty.
conversation.properties|m.npc_captainkni: Don't forget to prime your bomb\!
helptips.properties|m.battle_arena_1: Welcome to the battle arena\! The only rule is that you must fight at least once to move on. Should you claim victory, it will be up to you to decide to fight for even more glory\!
helptips.properties|m.tg1_heat: You may have noticed monsters leaving little embers like these behind. Embers grant you heat. As your heat meter fills, the flame next to your health will grow. If you make it to the exit without dying, the heat will be applied to your weapons and armor. Over time, this will level them up and make them stronger. While playing with others, every party member gets heat whenever anyone picks up an ember.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_2a: The inhabitants native of Haven are called 'Strangers.' You can't miss them- they're the towering, cloaked figures with masks. Despite their intimidating appearance, they have been extremely helpful to us and mostly keep to themselves. The odd, little birds in town certainly seem to like them anyway\!
item.properties|f.winterfest_coat: A supremely soft and seasonally stylish suit that radiates with wondrous Winterfest cheer. It tells everyone that when it comes to the holidays, you mean business.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_4a:
Re\: Re\: Re\: Resource allocation request, Amu-Sol 

I've contacted Internal Affairs regarding the recent theft of an everfrost pillar and the 'disappearance' of nearly 1,000 devilite data entry associates, as I believe it to be directly related to your recently denied resource allocation request. 

Disciplinary action will be required.  Additionally, please fill out the attached Personal Improvement Plan and return it as soon as possible.
support.properties|m.request_updated_mai: Your support request regarding {0} has been updated.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_3a: Punch and Vise are gremlin smiths that can change the properties of your weapons and gear.
support.properties|m.sent_mail: Sent mail with subject "{0}" to knight {1}.
item.properties|f.sacred_guerrilla_helm: A helm for those who want to bring down some beasts.
item.properties|f.kat_eye_raiment: A reclaimed raiment said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Preowa, whose artillery silenced the Grey Feather Tower Sages.
chat.properties|m.usage_invite: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nInvites a player into your current party.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_pickups: Pickups are items that are slotted into your belt seen at the top of the screen. They cannot leave the Clockworks and will turn to dust as soon as you return to town. Think of them as powerups and bonus items to use as you please.
item.properties|f.strike_needle: Plans to modify the Strike Needle for non-combat usage were shelved after a recruit accidentally riddled Lieutenant Feron's bunk with holes.
helptips.properties|m.plan_o_attack: The monitor shows readouts coming from a prototype of a massive war machine labeled "Project R".
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_2: they will kill us they will kill you
support.properties|m.subheader_step208: Hacking is when someone is trying to get a hold of your account name or password, or already has done this.\n\nThe vast majority of hacking issues, aren't actually hacking, but careless sharing of accounts or passwords. You should never share your password with anyone for any reason. Game Masters will never ask for it either.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
item.properties|f.sacred_sentinel_helm: A radiant defending doubleweave for insulating against erratic elements.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_1a: Sure, show me the shops. (Follow Tylen)
uplink.properties|m.newsletter_sub: Congratulations\! You subscribed to the Spiral Knights Newsletter\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_e: A bomb is great for dealing with a horde of monsters.
item.properties|f.fowl_cowl: A beaked mask shrouded in a simple hood. Take on the guise of your feathered friends and celebrate the new year.
item.properties|f.token_roarmulus: A special circuit board developed by gremlin engineers designed to enhance both the bark and bite of the Roarmulus Twins.
helptips.properties|m.p_dz_schematic_hei: Unauthorized access of our schematics library detected. Security team dispatched. Lockdown commenced.
item.properties|f.honor_blade_3: A ceremonial sword issued to Champions of the Spiral Order. Though intended for formal occasions, its fine edge makes it suitable for combat use.
mission.properties|o.go_shopping: Visit the Haven Bazaar and discover what it has to offer
dungeon.properties|m.split_invite: {0} has ventured on ahead, if you're quick you can still join them\!
item.properties|f.polar_day_wolf_hood: A warm hood, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending day patrols.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_b_3a: Whew, well that was much faster with you lending a hand, {0}. Listen, if you ever need a guided tour around the bazaar, just come talk to me. I can tell you anything you need to know about the shops and services here. \n\nHave a look around\! I'm sure you'll find plenty of interesting items. Thanks again\!
item.properties|f.iron_buckler: A beaten little buckler made of iron that can withstand a bit more abuse than a Proto Shield.
item.properties|e.not_use_snow_bucket: Can't use this item now. It can only be used in town or in a guild hall. There can only be 10 in use at once.
item.properties|f.ironmight_plate_mail: Superior plate mail forged from an alloy of several rare metals. It's restrictive, but incredibly strong.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_mat_2: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|r.reporting_duty_1a: Sure sounds important, tell me how it all works.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_3: Without the power of the rest of the sprites, water will never flow through this realm. It requires a focus link with the Spirit Mother to bring even the smallest of drops of water into such an oppressive world. The master of this realm has seen to it that the flames surrounding him will always burn.
mission.properties|r.alchemy_beginners_9: Let's go over it all one more time.
item.properties|f.green_shard: A shard of Valestone that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
support.properties|m.option_204_0: Names that are offensive are not acceptable. Be aware that what you consider offensive may not generally be considered offensive. So please only click here to file the complaint if you know for sure everyone would find that name offensive.
projectx.properties|e.name_invalid_space: Sorry, names may not contain more than two spaces.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We'll hold the line\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_surprise_3: Contains three randomly chosen Prize Boxes in celebration of the Spiral Order's anniversary on Cradle.  No key required to open.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_mat_5: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|o.shadow_knows: Learn about monsters that inflict shadow damage
item.properties|f.shadow_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who gain their powers using forbidden, dark arts.
item.properties|d.recover_accessory: Recovers an accessory from an item, returning the accessory to your arsenal.
item.properties|f.silver_key: A special key that can open any lockbox.  Once used, the key is destroyed.
item.properties|f.scale_mail: A shimmering set of serpentine scales woven into a suit of armor.
item.properties|f.punkin_sprout: A small sprig capable of growing into a grand gourd.
item.properties|f.warmaster_bomb_3: The perfected version of the shadowy bomb that Warmaster Seerus engineered with the sole purpose of eliminating other gremlins that stood in his way.  It is thought to have been reserved for use against other members of the Crimson Order.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_mat_0: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
conversation.properties|m.rc_bomb_1a: Had a chance to try out bombs yet? Unlike other weapon types, bombs can only be used as a charge attack. Doing anything else just causes it to fizzle out. But if you do charge them up... BOOM\! They can put a serious hurt on multiple monsters at once\!
craft.properties|m.confirm_remove_access: The accessory will be removed and destroyed. Are you sure?
item.properties|f.chaos_cowl: A hood of dubious origin that shrouds its wearer in both mystery and elemental protection.
conversation.properties|m.rc_technician_: Power has come surging back to the camp\!  You did it, {0}\!
item.properties|f.hive_box: Contains one unique hive-themed item. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.empty_room_checker_lar: An empty Guild Hall room with mixed flooring and plenty of space for furniture\!
item.properties|f.hazardous_diablo_helm: A helm worn by members of the Scarlet Scouts. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of a demon said to have broken off its own horn to use as a weapon when it faced its end.
item.properties|f.primal_buster: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it you can sense the natural energy within waiting to be unleashed.
item.properties|f.ticket_variants_3: Use this ticket at the Variant Forge to reset an item's variants to 3 random variants.
mission.properties|o.new_threat: Confront a dangerous new threat to Haven
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: I am here to listen. Let it all out.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: I worked my employees hard to get where I am today.
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: I'm either here celebrating or downing my sorrows.
item.properties|f.galactic_guardian_vest: Wearing this stunningly stellar vest allows you to guide others to safety in even the darkest corners of space.
item.properties|f.gunpuppy_helm: A helm handcrafted from salvaged Gun Puppy parts.
item.properties|f.slime_key: A slippery key that can only open a Slime Lockbox.  Once used, the key is destroyed.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest2_r7: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.armor_ankle: An accessory that can be attached to the ankle of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_h: Stick with your squad - remember it's dangerous to go alone\!
projectx.properties|d.achievement_87eae7: Revive a downed party member, giving them only half a pip of health.
mission.properties|b.in_cold_blood: Something has really riled up the chromalisks in the levels below the town of Emberlight.  Spiral HQ sent a squad in to investigate and they quickly fell off the radar. Now they've sent out a distress signal stating that they're cornered at depth 21 by chromalisks of all varieties. \n\nBiotechs speculate these chromalisks are agitated due to their proximity to the Core. Others believe it may be mating season.  Regardless of the reason, the squad needs saving before they meet their end to the likes of these lizards\!
item.properties|f.barbarous_thorn_blade: A mythical blade that lashes out with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. Those who wield it claim to feel the fiery stare of the beast upon them whenever they close their eyes.
mission.properties|m.arsenal_knight_1a: You can use the Arsenal Station behind me to change your gear. Once you head down into the Clockworks you will only be able to swap out your equipped gear at an Arsenal Station like this one, so it's best to be prepared\!
item.properties|f.polaris: It's said that the explosions caused by this stellar sidearm are so bright that you'll always be able to find your way in the darkness. Polaris shots become more powerful the further they travel.
item.properties|f.cosmic_dust: A portion of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
mission.properties|o.prestigious_opportu: Contact Intel Agent Kora and receive Prestige Mission authorization
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_3a: The Clockworks are the massive complex of gears and machinery that lies just below the surface of this whole world. It's truly an incredible sight. It is a strange and dangerous world in which we have found ourselves. Tread carefully.
dungeon.properties|m.golden_slime_prize: Each spin of the wheel rewards you with a random prize, sometimes including very special items\! Requires one Golden Slime Coin or crowns if none are available.
mission.properties|b.alone_in_dark: The spookats of Moorcroft Manor have another valuable piece of intel for us that is worth investigating.  They say that a lost soul of the former Kingdom of Almire resides in a soldier's graveyard near the Firestorm Citadel.  This soul is willing to provide us with the information on the nature of the citadel as well as how we can get through it and reach the Core. \n\nReaching him will not be easy given his location.  Graveyards are terrible places, especially at this depth.  It is highly advisable that you move through the graveyard as quickly as possible in your search for this lost soul.
item.properties|f.radiant_pulsar: A cutting-edge handgun intended for use only by the Spiral Order's best and brightest. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_bomb: Hello {0}, I'm Remi, a knight who specializes in bombs and explosives.  The recipes I have for you are pretty straightforward- producing weapons and gear that focus on blowing up your enemies to smithereens\! \n\nUsing bombs isn't a fire and forget kind of affair though.  Bombs require an understanding of timing, both before and after you drop one, in order to get the most bang for your buck.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that your squad sends in to take down many enemies at once.  Bombs are great for clearing out a mob of beasties in one swift KA-BOOM\!
mission.properties|b.p_fast_advancement: Use this Test Server exclusive mission to quickly power up your weapons and gear.  Each level of this mission is exactly the same, allowing you to change your equipped weapons and gear at each depth. \n\nOnly a few heat embers are needed to max out any item\! 'Return to Haven' before you reach the end so you can come back to this mission.
item.properties|f.woven_sentinel_helm: A helm imbued with interwoven wolver hair to protect against even the harshest elements.
conversation.properties|m.npc_mineraltec: Hmm, certain combinations seem to attract different kinds of monsters.
sprites.properties|d.dark_harness_adv: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal shadow damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 5% \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Maskeraith
guild.properties|e.statue_deploy_limit: Sorry, only {0} knight statues may be placed in a hall at once. To add this statue, please remove another one.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Having faced the jaws of the most ferocious wolvers, avoided the spikes of fully evolved jelly cubes and even the vile regurgitations of virulisks, you have no doubt collected samples from these encounters that would be of great use to Spiral HQ's research teams.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
help.properties|m.monster_1: Monsters in the Clockworks are divided into six distinct families, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Be sure to equip yourself accordingly before venturing below ground\!
item.properties|f.coliseum_room: A lively room featuring a Coliseum ticket booth, a Coliseum Rewards Supervisor, and a Krogmo Alchemy Machine.
mission.properties|r.search_continues_1a: Thank you, Lieutenant. Any more information with regard to the Alpha Squad?
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_2a: What happened here? These remains look to be hundreds of years old...
design.properties|e.location_already_pla: A room has already been installed at this location.
mission.properties|b.securing_camp: Before you attempt to investigate the monster-infested depths below the Rescue Camp, Rhendon would like to get you up to speed about taking on missions for Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
auction.properties|e.buy_must_exceed_bid: The buy price must be greater than or equal to the starting bid, or blank.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: You did it\!  That explosion took out the cannons\!
pvp.properties|m.gear_block: Your currently equipped gear disqualifies you.
item.properties|f.plated_shade_armor: A suit of fiendish fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they creep in camoflauged corners.
mission.properties|r.new_chapter_2a: What a strange world.  What else do you have for me, Kora?
mission.properties|b.sewer_stash: It seems that the Ironclaw Munitions Factory is not the only place gremlins are storing high-powered weaponry.  Intel suggests that once manufactured, weapons are moved out of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory and stored in secret weapon caches throughout the Clockworks. \n\nOne of these caches has been uncovered in one of the Clockwork's wasteworks systems.  It's likely not going to be pretty reaching it, but eliminating the weapons stored in these wasteworks could result in far fewer casualties in the future.
mission.properties|o.elemental_my_dear: Learn about monsters that inflict elemental damage
craft.properties|m.moved_treasury: Item moved to your Guild Treasury
conversation.properties|m.npc_techknight: I'm collecting samples from all over this stratum.
helptips.properties|m.tut_dash: Evade damage from monster attacks by pressing [[DODGE]].
item.properties|f.supply_standard_compac: A package of useful supplies valued by Spiral Knight research teams working deep within the Clockworks.  This standard pack has enough supplies to last a few Knights one week.
item.properties|f.obsidian_shard: A jet-black shard of unnatural stone. Holding it fills your head with imagery of a distant shore where waves crash against rocks that seem to writhe in the chill of the water.
helptips.properties|m.design:
Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to place.
Press DEFEND [[DEFEND]] to put away.
Press PREV_WEAPON [[PREV_WEAPON]] to rotate clockwise.
Press NEXT_WEAPON [[NEXT_WEAPON]] to rotate counter-clockwise.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_2a: Strangers like Quillion here sell you weapons and armor.  Each one specializes in a particular kind of item, so talk to them and find out what they carry. They're not very chatty, but they always have a fresh stock of items every day\! \n\nJust be sure that you've reached the appropriate rank to equip an item\!
item.properties|f.pig_helm: A ferocious battle helmet that smells a bit like smokey applewood on the inside.
item.properties|f.sacred_ghost_armor: A spectral suit of armor for those who are gunning for ghosts.
item.properties|l.inspect_pack: This pack contains all of the following items.
item.properties|f.sentenza: An ancient handgun forged from shadow steel. It is said to have been wielded by an evil one who possessed "angel eyes."
item.properties|f.shadow_steel: An extraordinary metal imbued with the creeping darkness of the Underworld.
item.properties|f.helm_top: An accessory that can be attached to the top of select helmets.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: Oh no\! Tell her the cakes will be ready. Erm, I'm just a little behind.  I'll make you a deal\: I'll give you some extra cake if we can keep this between you and me. I don't want to be kicked out of the party.
conversation.properties|r.biscotti_2: Again, this is really weird Biscotti, but I'll do my best.
item.properties|f.celestial_orbitgun: This planetoid projecting pistol conjures images of the birth of stellar systems. Opponents caught within its blazing maelstrom are sure to see the light.
item.properties|f.powderkeg: Careful, this thing could go off like a metaphorical powder keg.
shop.properties|m.purchaseWindowDepotAd: Out of energy? Get more in the supply depot\!
mission.properties|o.best_of_beast: Learn about the most powerful beast and slime monsters
conversation.properties|r.core_tech_1: I'd like to know how I can help.
exchange.properties|m.trade4crowns_toolt: Enter the amount of energy you want to sell, in multiples of 100
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I would like to hear about the battle sprites again.
item.properties|f.ult_evo_catalyst: A contained charge of highly unstable energy that can be synthesized by battle sprites. In doing so, sprites can evolve into their ultimate forms and harness the power of their ultimate skills.
helptips.properties|m.atg_vials: Inflict a variety of status effects on enemies by throwing VIALS at them\!
projectx.properties|i.cull_transients: Prevents display of some off-screen graphics effects\npossibly speeding up graphical performance, but may\ncause some effects not to appear.
item.properties|f.torto_skull: A cavernous, musty helm made from the remains of a Tortodrone- a reminder that sometimes it pays to not stick your neck out.
item.properties|f.firotech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires bullets of liquid flames that split on impact.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_h:
The Clockworks have been so consistent for so long\! Just ticking along like, well... you know. But now *something is happening* and I don't know what it is\!\! 

I'm so excited\! 

Bring us samples of these Mysterious Spikes and we'll make good trades for them\!
item.properties|f.honor_shield_2: A ceremonial shield issued to seasoned Spiral Knights. Though intended for formal occasions, its solid construction makes it suitable for combat use.
item.properties|f.aero_armor: A sleek-fitting aerodynamic armor made with lightweight gremlin alloys. It will reduce unwanted turbulence during chaotic dogfights.
item.properties|f.toy_soldier_coat: Tailored for duty in the battle for Toyland but also perfect for posing in parades.

Morgral'm

helptips.properties|m.atg_astation: Arsenal Stations allow you to swap your gear and access loadouts outside of safe havens like Terminals and Subtowns\!
item.properties|f.capsule_health_ultra: A capsule that restores an extreme amount of health. Never leave home without one\!
item.properties|f.chroma_tear: A crystallized Chromalisk tear suitable as a lens for focusing weaponry, or for correcting myopia.
design.properties|i.place_room: Install a room at this location.
item.properties|f.almire_tapestry: A tailored tapestry emblazoned with the elevated emblem of Almire.
item.properties|f.dark_thorn_blade: A savage sword whose strength has been fortified by an offering of souls to the beast within.
conversation.properties|m.tut_warden_2a: You and me both. Now let's get- \n\nHold on, something's not right. Brace yourself, I think we've got company\!
mission.properties|r.eye_of_needle_4a: I take it the only way to the Core is through the Firestorm Citadel?
helptips.properties|m.tglobby_equip: Inside the Clockworks, use Arsenal Stations to change your equipment.
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_5a: It would seem so.  And this place, it just radiates evil, it's almost indescribable.  It's even starting to affect the levels surrounding it- fires are breaking out everywhere. \n\nYou're one of the best we've got, {0} and if there's anyone that could lead a squad through the citadel it's you.  But even reaching it won't be easy.  We're going to need to take care of a few fires and gather a bit more intel before storming the gates.
item.properties|f.dread_skelly_suit: The most fearsome Skelly Suit known to exist. There is nothing humerus about these dreadful duds.
mission.properties|m.shocking_sentient_s: It looks like time has run out, Sputterspark.  You'd better hope your little toy works.
item.properties|f.pig_armor: Hog all the attention in this leather suit. Its durable protection may just save your bacon one day.
item.properties|f.toxic_catalyzer: A Catalyzer modified to fire dangerously radioactive projectiles. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
item.properties|f.trojan_helm: A helm of the stalwart Spiral Wardens that is said to give great comfort to other knights.  Nothing says 'here comes the cavalry' like the sight of these iron giants taking to the battlefield.
item.properties|f.moonstone_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of moonstone
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_spiraltail: Contains various unique accessories and items to celebrate the Year of the Monkey\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
invite.properties|m.description_invitati: Invite a friend to come join you in\nSpiral Knights\!\nFill in their e-mail address and we'll send them an invitation to join.
projectx.properties|m.mission_gw: Recover the recon module in the Gloaming Wildwoods.
projectx.properties|m.logoff_required: This change will cause you to log off and reconnect.

item.properties|f.vial_poison_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing debilitating toxins. It can be used to inflict enemies with Poison.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and wither the attack power of your foes\!
item.properties|f.pulsar: A high-tech Gremlin firearm originally designed for use by elite squads of Ironclaw soldiers. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
item.properties|f.prize_box_gourmet: Contains various unique costumes and weapons used by battle chefs. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|o.p_apocrea_r4: Investigate the area of the Clockworks where several knights have gone missing.
dungeon.properties|m.battle_arena_desc: Said to be watched by countless drifting souls for entertainment, Battle Arenas offer escalating challenges for the brave warriors who wish to claim the treasure of the Arena King.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_7a: Punch and Vise are gremlin smiths that can change the properties of your weapons and gear.
global.properties|e.invalid_xfer_state: An error has been detected with your knight. Please log off and back on again. If the problem persists, please file a bug report.

item.properties|m.prize_box_rose_regalia: Rose Regalia Returns Again Prize Box

helptips.properties|m.tg1_partypad_1: Head into the room ahead with the party pad. You're almost done.
mission.properties|b.eye_of_needle: After compiling the data you collected from the Owlite keep and additional intel from Recon Knights, Intel Agent Kora has prepared a debriefing for you with regard to the mass of negative energy blocking access to the Core.

conversation.properties|m.tier_1_require: Well met, {0}.  In order to proceed and explore deeper depths of the Clockworks you must first achieve Rank 4-2. \n\nReturn here once you have completed the requisite Rank Missions.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_1a: Thought you could just walk away with the artifact did you?  Hand it over now or I'll light this fuse and turn you into a million, tiny, smoldering bits\!
item.properties|f.frostbreaker_helm: A Spiral Helm modified to provide additional protection against freeze, at the expense of fire and shock resistance.
uplink.properties|m.end_survey_prompt: To help us improve the game, please rate your enjoyment of this session on a scale of 1 to 5.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_12: Vanguard, eh?  The Rangers are always looking for skilled knights like you, {0}.  After all this pomp is done, come see me if you want to laugh in the face of death and danger once more\!

conversation.properties|m.fc_court_2: I am a sprite, a force of nature summoned to this realm to extinguish the unnatural fire that is consuming it. But Vanaduke discovered and imprisoned us. I managed to escape, but the other sprites remain in his custody.\n\nNow none may proceed beyond the court as columns of shadow fire block all exits. Shadow fire can only be extinguished with the water that flows from these spirit wells. The water is the purest found in all of nature, flowing directly from the springs within the realm of the Spirit Mother herself.

mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_4: Welcome back to the Hall of Heroes, {0}.  Please speak to the heroic knights you see before you to gain access to their weapons and gear.
monster.properties|m.vanaduke_1: What's this? More wolves hungry for the blood of Almire? Our great kingdom shall never fall to the likes of beasts\!
item.properties|f.ancient_shell: A fragment of resilient Tortodrone shell. It is rumored that by sleeping on a Tortodrone shell, one can feel the subtle vibrations that call these mighty beings towards the Long Migration's mysterious final destination.
item.properties|f.grate_plate: A protective plate with peephole perforations permitting ventilation of exhalations.

item.properties|f.great_defender_c: A well-crafted costume version of a classic shield.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_1a: Hello there, {0}.  Spiral HQ has informed me that you will be needing a quick lesson in the species of monsters within the Clockworks that inflict piercing damage, yes?
sprites.properties|d.heavy_smoke: Increases the defensive power and duration of the flame barrier.
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_4: Once you reach the elevator, the mineral you are carrying gets deposited in your arsenal for use later. Everyone in your party gets everyone else's minerals, so no need to fight over who gets the best one\!
uplink.properties|t.newsletter: Subscribe to the Spiral Knights Newsletter\!
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_6a: I'll contact you again soon, good luck {0}\!

projectx.properties|d.achievement_311da7: Hit the Whammie playing the Golden Prize Wheel.

item.properties|f.raider_tunic: Treasure is at your fingertips in this coat.

mission.properties|o.the_gauntlet: Battle your way to the Firestorm Citadel through a bulwark of monstrous might
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2a: Battle sprites level up by acquiring heat, just like your weapons and gear. They can acquire heat in two ways\: absorbing it as you battle in the Clockworks and by consuming materials and synthesizing them into heat.
guild.properties|e.guild_deleted: Sorry, that guild has been disbanded.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_5a: Then I now authorize you to take on Arcade Missions.  You can access the Arcade via your Mission interface or approach the gates directly here in the Arcade itself. There is a massive world beneath your feet waiting to be explored.\n\nGood luck to you\!
guildhelp.properties|m.design_info: Design Mode allows a guild member of sufficient rank to rearrange the furniture and other infrastructure within a Guild Hall. Once in Design Mode, furniture items can be picked up and put back down again much like a Gold Key or Heavy Statue, and by default they can be rotated while held by using the Mouse Wheel. When you are happy with your rearranging, you can Publish your changes from the Command Console and make them visible to the rest of your guild.
item.properties|f.horned_owlite_shield: A sturdy shield similar to the sort said to have been carried by Owlite youth.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_coba: Well met, {0}.  I'm Jorin, a knight who has mastered the standard issue Spiral Knight gear.  The recipes I have for you produce very reliable weapons and gear. \n\nJust because your weapons don't output fancy special damage types or your armor defends from status conditions doesn't mean you can't shake it in the Clockworks.  The gear I specialize in is good for just about any situation.  It will keep you alive and packs a punch on almost any monster that comes your way.
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_2: The Forge uses the heat stored in your gear and combines it with the power of Fire Crystals to unlock its new potential.
item.properties|f.woven_shade_helm: A loose fitting helm that enables its wearer to slink through the shadows and assault unaware enemies.
conversation.properties|r.rc_instruct_2c: On second thought, I'm going to head out.
uplink.properties|m.retgift: The attached Spark of Life is a gift, sent from the Skylark straight to you\! Please use it with our compliments.
item.properties|f.vial_curse: A glass vial containing concentrated fiend essence. It can be used to inflict enemies with Curse.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and give your foes 10 years of bad luck\!
item.properties|f.valestone: A fabled mineral of a vibrant, green color said to contain the essence of all natural life.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_3: In any case it would seem that this new 'recipe' caused the cakes to turn into horrible monsters that have overtaken my kitchen and infested the Clockworks.  I'd like to have my kitchen back, so could you please assist me in destroying these horrible Creep Cakes?
dungeon.properties|m.training_grounds_de: This derelict portion of the Clockworks has been modified to train new recruits in the fine art of not dying when they have the rest of the world to explore.

It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.

mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the master of munitions of the gremlin's Crimson Order.  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.
