item.properties|f.alpha_claw_gauntlet: A protective Wolver-hide gauntlet affixed with razor sharp claws.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_gunn: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
item.properties|f.prize_box_forge: Contains valuable rarities and other assorted items. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_3: Yes, Captain Ozlo himself has ordered that we hold out as long as possible and learn whatever we can.  If we ever leave this planet, it will be because of this Core.  \n\nI am confident that aside from a potential energy source, the Core is a kind of nerve center for everything you see within the Clockworks.  You can feel it in what little air is down here; a wild, ominous sense that this is no mere machine.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We need you to get inside and take out those cannons\!
shop.properties|m.accessoryUseRecover: Want to recover your accessory? Use your recover ticket\!
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r4: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.
item.properties|f.tabard_rose: An aged, embroidered tabard that once belonged to a Knight of the Rose, a sacred order of brave and especially dashing heroes whose numerous adventures are the subject of many folk tales. The Knights of the Rose were said to be peerless fencers, believing that their blades were like the flowers of their name\: a delicate thing of beauty that hides a vicious sting.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_ghost: Ghost blocks will destroy any blocks connected to them, even unbreakable blocks\!
guildhelp.properties|u.design_wiki: A full list of available furniture can be found on our official wiki. | URL | http\://wiki.spiralknights.com/Furniture
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_5a: The attachment is corrupted and cannot be opened.
mission.properties|m.chasm_b_rhendon_1a: Looks like we've got no choice, {0}.  This gizmo isn't worth dying over.
mission.properties|b.built_to_destroy:
Once known to Spiral HQ as 'Project R,' the Roarmulus Twins have been identified as a gremlin-engineered weapon of tremendous power built with the sole purpose of destroying Haven.  Stored deep within the heart of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory, this weapon is not only protected by hordes of shock-powered constructs and gremlins, but the factory is a highly dangerous, explosive hazard itself\! 

In addition to shutting down the Roarmulus Twins, Spiral HQ would like you to recover the Alpha Squad recon module that is believed to be located somewhere within the factory. 

It is highly recommended that you form a full squad before deploying.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_1a: Listen up, Rangers\!  Grab your scarves and sharpened swords because where we're going isn't going to include a warm welcome\!  Our scouts report that Amu-Sol is a frozen wasteland filled with fiends and hungry beasts.  This fiendish city seems to be spreading its icy chill throughout the Clockworks and if we don't get in there and figure out why, it's going to be a long winter here on Cradle. \n\nLet's ride, Rangers\!
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_shade_: A helm of fire retardant fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they hide in heated hallways.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_1: You... you are not one of the lost. You must be strong to make it to this court. Please, you must help me\!
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_11b: I think I've got it Bechamel, thanks\!
mission.properties|r.pumping_up_9b: Thanks\! I'm off to train. [Complete mission]
item.properties|f.kat_eye_hood: A crudely hewn hood made to resemble a crack shot warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_0: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 0 star item.
item.properties|f.token_krogmo: A coin issued by the great King Krogmo to participants in his Coliseum.  It can be exchanged for prizes from the Coliseum Rewards Supervisor.
projectx.properties|m.mission_imf: Recover the recon module in the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.
social.properties|m.join_guild: Join your guildmate {0} at depth {1} in the {2} Gate\!
pvp.properties|m.love_review_confirm: Are you sure? Once in review, you will no longer be able to make changes. Please completely test your level before submitting. It may take up to a week to review.
item.properties|f.armor_front: An accessory that can be attached to the front of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: I'll sneak out after it's safe.  Thank you for rescuing me\!
item.properties|f.token_candy: A piece of candy made to celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival.  It can be exchanged in the Haven Town Square for various costume masks.
item.properties|f.fur_coat: An extra-toasty coat made from the hide of a furry beast.
uplink.properties|m.bid_cancelled: Your bid money has been refunded and is included in this mail.
item.properties|f.warmaster_bomb_2: A refined version of the shadowy bomb that Warmaster Seerus engineered with the sole purpose of eliminating other gremlins that stood in his way.
prologue.properties|m.preface2: We, the crew of the Skylark, fled to the stars seeking a source of incredible power, our last hope to save our homeworld.
guild.properties|i.officer_storage: Community item storage for officers and above.
conversation.properties|r.sprite_tut_1a: How do sprites level up and evolve?
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The seraphynx is a battle sprite that embodies protection and restoration. Its skills focus on supporting knights in combat\: ray of light creates a steady beam of holy light, heart attack increases the chance of hearts dropping from monsters, and angelic aura creates a light shield that protects its knight and party members within. \n\nThe seraphynx is best suited for knights who wish to protect their party and provide them aid.
item.properties|f.prize_box_rage: Contains various unique costumes and accessories crafted from thunder and lightning. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
helptips.properties|m.tut_goldkey: Pick up and use on Gold Doors\!
mission.properties|o.p_r3_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Moorcroft Manor.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_barrier: If you start feeling overwhelmed, use the force barriers like the one to your right to take a breather. Monsters and projectiles cannot pass through them.
helptips.properties|m.tut_victory: You've made it\! Walk on ahead to enter the Rescue Camp.
helptips.properties|m.activate_grim_gate: The Grim Gate will activate when all living party members are standing on it.
item.properties|f.furni_table_spiral1: A small table that aspires to one day be combined with other tables to become a big table.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Welcome to the Moorcroft Archives, traveler. Here you will find an illustrious collection of ancient grimoires from many forgotten worlds. It's quite the sight, I know\! \n\nYou're free to look around but please don't touch- some of these books are filled with incredible mystic power. You could hurt yourself\!
item.properties|f.fire_raider_tunic: Treasure is at your fingertips and ash in your wake with this soot laden coat.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_3de017: Pay a visit to Emberlight, the town of gremlin outcasts.
sprites.properties|d.iron_heart_attack: Targets destroyed while enchanted may also drop defense orbs.
support.properties|m.header_step1: You are about to file a complaint against another player for the Game Masters to review.
item.properties|f.valkyrie_mail: A priceless set of armor whose name denizens of the Underworld dare not mention.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
dungeon.properties|m.gloaming_wildwoods_: Spiral Knight recruits are advised to avoid this dark and misty forest until they are experienced with the dangers of the Clockworks. The Gloaming Wildwoods is home to packs of vicious beasts, the worst of all being the mythical Snarbolax. Said to be 'a living shadow,' the Snarbolax prefers the taste of prey that had been a state of terror before death and will often mercilessly harass its victims before delivering the final blow.
conversation.properties|r.rc_greet2_3a: I'll meet up with Rhendon before I investigate the generator.
item.properties|f.heavy_hatchet: A big blade intended to fell trees. Unsurprisingly, you can also use it to fell enemies, blocks, mineral deposits and most anything else you'd care to hit with it.
chat.properties|m.usage_grant: Usage\: /{0} number\nGives you a number of crowns.
item.properties|f.haze_burst: A powerful alchemical bomb that produces a dense cloud of intensely disorienting material.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_11a: Oh my\!  What is the connection between these gremlins and that Artifact anyway?
social.properties|m.confirm_go_solo: Are you sure you want to continue on alone?
auction.properties|m.cancel_confirm: You will get your item back but will not be refunded your listing fee.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Hail, Vanguard {0}. Kora said you had news of the Alpha Squad. Please, give us your report.
item.properties|f.grinchlin_snowball: Handcrafted by the grouchy Grinchlins of Mount Krampus, these repugnant projectiles are sure to put a damper on any Winterfestivities.
mission.properties|b.mission_sprite_2: Rhendon is waiting for you in an area of the Clockworks known as the Restless Railroad where reconnaissance has located a cache of missing battle sprites. Secure the sprites and clear the area of hostiles. You are authorized to utilize any sprites you secure in order to complete the mission.
mission.properties|m.built_to_destroy_2b:
Transmission\: 

'They continue to advance and thwart our schemes\!  How could they have discovered Project R?  Why was there no advance warning of the attack?' 

'Herex and his minions were supposed to be spying on them but they have all vanished like cowards.' 

'To defy the Iron Law is to defy the Order\!  Track the traitor down.  Herex will answer for this setback.'
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_3_1: (Lieutenant  Feron appears to have been injured) \n\nThere you are, {0}, here for the big finale, eh?
item.properties|f.beach_hat: A head-mounted personal portable lightweight shade structure.
item.properties|f.blue_shard: A shard of Moonstone that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
mission.properties|m.prestigious_opportu: Greetings {0}, and congratulations on becoming a Squire\!  Your performance has caught the attention of Spiral HQ and they have given you authorization to now take on Prestige Missions. \n\nPrestige Missions are select missions offered to you daily that offer prestige as rewards for completion.  Sometimes these missions require supplying Spiral HQ or other Knights with items and other times they will have you exploring the Clockworks.
support.properties|m.option_207_0: If you believe someone is maliciously trying to scam you, then please click here to send the complaint. You may want to inform this player they have been complained that way other players around you can hear this too and take precaution.
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_9a: Where do I find accessory tickets?
helptips.properties|m.graveyard: Graveyards are an unnatural place, a world between worlds where dark spirits gather, hungry for the life of any live soul that must pass through.  You must hurry and find the exit as fast as possible before these phantoms awaken and stalk you\!
mission.properties|r.pierce_of_cake_4a: You talked pretty fast, can you go over it-
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_2: Ok, here is the gist of it all- collect materials and recipes and turn them into weapons and gear.  Easy right?
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Lord Vanaduke \nLittle is known about the eternal Duke of the Almirian Empire. Our sensors show the mask is a source of power as well as a potential weakness.
mission.properties|o.reporting_duty: Report to Lieutenant Feron in the Haven Arcade
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_cardho: Please enter your entire name as it appears on your credit card.
item.properties|f.kamarin: A low-tech sword that's less effective at cutting than it is at crushing your enemies and seeing them driven before you.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
item.properties|f.frenzy_crusader_helm: A helm worn by mythical soldiers who are said to fight with such a frenzy they create whirlwinds in their wake.
mission.properties|m.great_escape_1a: Surprise\! Looks like you took the bait. That's good, because I needed test subjects for my latest invention.
item.properties|f.personal_height: Once used, this item will permanently change your Knight's height to the specified height.
item.properties|f.dark_shard: A shard of Dark Matter that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro4_1a: I'm going to stay here for now and locate any other Knights that have crashed in the area.  I'll meet you at the Rescue Camp to the north. \n\nAnd should you encounter anything really dangerous, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!
mission.properties|b.dreams_and_nightmar: Respond to the distress signal from the Core Terminal. We have no intel on what to expect. \nThis is a dangerous mission. Prepare for anything.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_7a: {0}, I thought you would be taller.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_lazy_gobble_: A festive fall snipe that will stay where it's placed.
conversation.properties|r.sprite_tut_2c: Where can I purchase more harnesses?
mission.properties|m.elig_ok: You are eligible for this mission.
uplink.properties|m.ironclaw_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we have intercepted gremlin transmissions from this facility that indicate they are building some kind of weapon to destroy Haven\!  It is your mission to infiltrate the facility, destroy this weapon and save Haven from destruction\! 

Known only as 'Project Roarmulus,' it is said to be impenetrable from standard attacks.  You will have to find a way to break whatever armor it is using.  Intel suggests this weapon is located deep within the facility. 

But getting to it won't be easy.  You will find that gremlins have little care for a safe work environment as live rockets seem to be fired every which way at all times.  However you should be able to utilize the 'polarity walls' you will find in testing environments to block the oncoming rockets.  Look for a purple and gold switch to toggle them. 

We've also detected another Recon Module of the Alpha Squad somewhere in this factory.  Retrieve it if you can\! 

Good luck\!
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_1: Hail\! You must be the brave knight Spiral HQ has sent to deal with these Grinchlins. Mount Krampus is not like other levels so allow me to explain to you how it works.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: The rest of us thought we weren't going to make it. But then...then the light surrounded us and we were safe. We've taken to calling it The Sleeper. We aren't sure what it is exactly, but it needs our help. This world was created to protect it but somehow The Swarm breached the Core and has been feeding on the energy and growing like a leech ever since.
item.properties|f.armor_arms: An accessory that can be attached to the arms of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
dungeon.properties|m.dark_city_desc: This once bustling city from an advanced world is now home to innumerable fiends from the Underworld. Under the light of the moon they burn their dark sigils into the ground, summoning more of their cohorts for reasons yet unknown.
mission.properties|m.intro_expansion_loc: Complete Rank Missions to gain access to Expansion Missions\!
chat.properties|m.usage_smile: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nSmile at your fellow players.
mission.properties|o.securing_camp: Find and talk to Rhendon to gain access to missions.
shop.properties|m.accessoryDepotAd: Want to recover your accessory? Buy a recover ticket\!
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_7b: Wonderful\!  I'm glad I could help you get your bearings. Good luck to you, {0}\!
projectx.properties|e.no_node_found: Could not enter instance. Please try again later.
conversation.properties|r.och_leader_4_2: It's been an honor to aid you.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r7: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
chat.properties|m.usage_sprite_ultimate: Usage\: /{0} skill ultimate\nUpdates a sprite skill's ultimate value.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_gunn: Howdy {0}, the name's Daxen. I'm a knight who specializes in gunslinging.  The recipes I have for you produce weapons and gear that focus on ranged combat... you know, shootin' stuff. \n\nHandguns allow you to hit your enemies from a safe distance, but don't offer you many options once they close in on ya.  You've got to think and shoot fast to be a good gunslinger.  The gear I specialize in will make you a dead shot, not a dead knight.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r3: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
item.properties|f.volcanic_iron: An extraordinary metal imbued with the blazing energy of magma.
item.properties|f.deadly_crystal_bomb: A large chunk of Moonstone and Valestone alloy primed with a potent explosive. Studies have shown that this bomb can be used to reduce a zombie's craving for brains by up to 100% by blowing them to pieces.
mission.properties|b.skies_under_cradle: The Clockworks are a fascinating underground complex that houses entire worlds within its colossal, iron geo-globes.  One of them that recon knights have discovered is known as the 'Aurora Isles,' a series of mysterious floating islands under a false sky. \n\nAs a newly ranked Apprentice, you now have clearance to explore the ruins within these islands and collect any useful materials you may discover.
item.properties|f.quilted_hunting_cap: A flexible helm lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. It smells like animal.
item.properties|f.divine_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
auction.properties|m.no_mybids: You have not bid on any recent auctions.
item.properties|f.winter_grave: A tremendously powerful hand cannon whose moniker should come as no surprise to anyone who happens to be viewing it from the wrong end. A charged shot can even plow through multiple enemies.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Quite the scarab nest we've stirred up this time eh, {0}? Reminds me of the time we engaged the Morai siege fleets over Isora. That was quite an all or nothing gamble. Doesn't surprise me in the least that we're the only thing standing between us and utter annihilation again.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_cj_gamepad: Gamepad used for targeting, attacking, movement, advanced commands and quickslots
mission.properties|m.cryptic_coder_crims:
Infiltrate the Complex. 
Take all schematics. 
The Nine are quiet but we will silence them. 
The Knights pursue but we will halt them. 

Only Herex comprehends the Truth. Only Herex will descend. 
There can be no other.
item.properties|f.ironmight_plate_helm: A superior plate helmet forged from an alloy of several rare metals. It'll restrict your peripheral vision a bit, but it's virtually impregnable.
mission.properties|o.king_of_ashes: Defeat Lord Vanaduke in the Firestorm Citadel and reach the Core
projectx.properties|m.antialiasing_note: This setting will take effect when the game is restarted.
item.properties|f.crystalline_defender: A durable, high quality shield clad in protective glacial ice suitable for any adventure.
board.properties|i.formparty: Create a party that anyone can join.
chat.properties|m.usage_drain: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nDrains a player (yourself by default) of all mist energy.
mission.properties|m.status_deployed: Deployed\nKnights joining a deployed party will not receive completion credit for the mission.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: By now you have likely collected some interesting materials in the first stratum of the Clockworks that would be useful to Spiral HQ.  Help advance their continued research of the mysteries of Cradle by donating materials.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: Excellent\! Which battle sprite will you choose as your companion?
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft2_r7: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
mission.properties|m.true_champion_4a: Yes, I suppose we just might.  Safe travels then, {0}.
mission.properties|o.shopping_again_b: Follow Bechamel on a tour of the Bazaar's more advanced offerings
pvp.properties|m.coins_awarded_message: You were awarded Krogmo Coins for participation in {0}\!
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_3a: Thank you, {0}.  I hope you succeed.  As you know, we believe the Alpha Squad made it this far, but it is unclear what became of them... Euclid, Parma, Grantz.... Rulen. \n\n(Lieutenant Vaelyn seems to almost drift off)
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_f: Our mission to save Winterfest ends in defeat\! The grinchlins have won, we must retreat\!
item.properties|f.brigandine: A very practical suit of armor coupled with a knitted jacket.
item.properties|f.obsidian_obelisk: A jet-black stele of unnatural stone from the realm of the Apocrea. As you gaze upon it the stone seems to writhe and pulse with an eternal energy that is simultaneously alluring and sinister in a most grotesque manner.
mission.properties|m.shadowplay_1a: Too late again\! I have already collected the power I need to use the Artifact and nothing you can do now will stop what I have set in motion.
item.properties|f.dusker_cap: A hide helm for knights that prefer to take their opponents on toe-to-toe.
helptips.properties|m.tut_welcome: We have picked up your distress signal, recruit. Your first objective is to reach Haven, where we have created an outpost. You're likely a little woozy from the crash, so I'll guide you through the basics. The road may be dangerous, so ready your sword and keep your wits about you. Good luck\!
item.properties|f.volt_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful volt bullets that split multiple times on impact.
item.properties|f.empty_room_catwalk: An empty Guild Hall room with industrial flooring and plenty of space for furniture\!
item.properties|f.quilted_demo_helm: A helm snugly lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. Sounds are a bit muffled from inside.
item.properties|f.owlite_mask: A mask of an owlite scholar. The Kats of Moorcroft have assured us with confidence that this reconstruction matches their "grotesque and feathered visage".
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_3a: Great, thanks for being a good ambassador\! \n\nLastly I need to get you up to speed on something called 'energy.'  It's very important to your mission here on Cradle.
projectx.properties|p.use_style_kit: Spend 1,000 crowns to modify your style?
helptips.properties|m.scenario_roarmulus: 'Project R' is nearly complete. We must gather more scrap\!
mission.properties|o.p_r7_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
mission.properties|m.intro_prestige_lock: Complete Rank Missions to gain access to Prestige Missions\!
mission.properties|b.p_r7_mat_4: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_1a: Hello there little one. You look as though you require knowledge of some kind.
item.properties|f.chroma_suit: A suit crafted from the hide of a chromalisk. Surprisingly, chromalisks seem to find the existence of these armors flattering.
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_3: Attack a mineral column in order to break it down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_red: A Spiral-issued light source typically installed in dangerous areas.
item.properties|f.confetti_leaf: A fantastic party favor used in forest festivities.
item.properties|f.cosmic_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_2d: I've got no other questions, I'll be off.
helptips.properties|m.lock_howto:
* There are multiple Control Points scattered around the map 
* Capturing and holding a Control Point increases your team's score over time 
* To capture a Control Point, stand on it until it changes to your team's color 
* The team with the highest score at the end of the match WINS\!
projectx.properties|d.achievement_ebcd68: Defeat the Royal Jelly squatting in the Royal Jelly Palace.
helptips.properties|m.tg_heat: Collecting Heat Embers will level up your gear when you reach an elevator.
item.properties|f.venom_fiend_mail: A plated mail said to be crafted in the image of a venomous fiend. It comes with a sinister skinsuit that pulses with a vile essence.
item.properties|f.gh_env_embers: An environment that fills your Guild Hall with falling ash and soot as if Vog himself had passed through.
item.properties|f.infernal_guardian_helm: A charred, stygian helm belonging to an abyssal warrior.
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r6: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.grintovec: Your enemies will surely enjoy the cool, refreshing sensation of being hit by a glacier.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Smashing\! Good luck to you, {0}. You'll need it- black kats are an unlucky bunch...
projectx.properties|e.cant_loadout: That loadout can't be used here.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_plump_gobble: An impressively-large gobble snipe that is taking a nice, long rest after a hearty meal.
mission.properties|r.new_threat_10a: There was an attack.  The Artifact's been stolen\!
mission.properties|r.securing_camp_b_1a: I'll head over to the Arsenal Station and equip my Proto Bomb\!
item.properties|f.polar_day_warden_coat: An insulated coat that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The fur-lined armor plating makes it ideal for hours of daytime watch duty.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_b: Don't forget your shield, it will save your life\!
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_13: Here we have Bechamel the Accessorizor, who can add accessories to your gear so long as you have a ticket.  With accessories, you can make your gear really stand out in a crowd, I highly suggest giving it a try.  You'll soon become the apple of every one's eye\!
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_5a: A recon squad has managed to track down where many of these battle sprites have landed.  Rhendon has been sent ahead to scout out three of these sites and will meet up with you in the Clockworks. \n\nYou must secure our battle sprites before they fall into enemy hands\!
conversation.properties|m.imposto_death: Abort Mission\! I'm retreating back to Haven\! Glorp\!
help.properties|m.monster_gremlin: Deal ELEMENTAL - Weak to SHADOW - Strong against ELEMENTAL
conversation.properties|m.ritual_4a: Well, that was unexpected. I'll get it right next time\!
projectx.properties|e.rank_limit: This item may not be equipped until you've reached rank {0}.
helptips.properties|m.party_nosplit_warn: WARNING\! You may not split your party during this mission.
item.properties|f.prize_box_chess: Contains one randomly-chosen Chess Mini liftable statue furniture.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|o.minerals_rock: Report to Chief Geo Knight Wegner in the Haven Arcade
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight7_1a: Initial readings are off the charts, {0}\!  We've never encountered anything like this before.  It will take some time to fully understand what this object is used for.
mission.properties|o.time_to_crafty: Alchemize a Hot Edge and Frost Gun and turn it in for inspection.
item.properties|f.divine_mantle: A heavenly cloak thought to be once worn by celestial sages.
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_2a: My knowledge is yours, little one.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_gr: A short torch filled with ghastly green fire.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_3a: That's exactly right\! The Core of the Clockworks could very well contain the energy source we need to create a new power source for the Skylark and restore it to operational condition. There's only one problem- the Clockworks themselves seem to be built like some kind of crazy death trap. \n\nReaching the Core is not going to be easy...
item.properties|f.ocarina_slime: Call up a companion cube to complete your conquest.
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_1:
Glorp\! Glorp\! Glorp\! Merry Winterfest\!

That special time of year is finally here, when a delicate blanket of wondrous white snow covers Haven and every Stranger, every snipe and every Knight fills their hearts with holiday cheer.

But to you I must tell, all is sadly not well. Lacking motive or reason, a group of shriveled-heart grinchlins have threatened this Winterfest season\!
chat.properties|m.no_such_gift: {0} has no gifts of that type.
mission.properties|o.axes_of_evil: Stop the gremlin logging operation in the Jigsaw Valley
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Devilites \nDevilites are the workhorse of the underworld. If a Pit Boss catches an idle Devilite he may promote them to an angry Overtimer or a docile Yesman.
uplink.properties|m.bid_complete: Thank you for using the Haven Auction House, your shinies are always appreciated.
guild.properties|m.motd_changed: {0} changed the message of the day\: {1}
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_1: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 1 star item.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_5a: Nice to finally meet you in person, {0}\!  Congratulations\!
admin.properties|d.load_tester: Spawns PseudoPlayer clients to test the server. Not recommended for use on production deployments\!
item.properties|f.captain_coat: A seaworthy greatcoat outstanding for spaceage swordplay.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_gre: A tall torch filled with ghastly green fire.
item.properties|f.woven_shade_armor: A loose fitting suit of armor that enables its wearer to slink through the shadows and assault unaware enemies.
mission.properties|o.sovereign_slime: Infiltrate the Royal Jelly Palace and find the mysterious energy source
mission.properties|m.another_trace_1a: Hello {0}, I'm happy to report that my equipment is back up and running\! Now I have some good news and bad news for you.  The good news is\: I've been able to track down the source of that energy signature. Here is the bad news\: the energy source has been pinpointed to a highly dangerous area of the Clockworks that Recon Knights have dubbed the 'Royal Jelly Palace.'
mission.properties|r.honor_duty_1a: It's been an honor to serve, Lieutenant.
item.properties|f.boosted_plate_mail: A suit of Spiral Plate Mail with a supercharged internal power source. The upgrade didn't make the armor any lighter.
item.properties|f.heater_shield: A shield with a built-in furnace that keeps its user toasty warm, protecting them from most freeze attacks. Many knights also use it as a makeshift stove top when out in the field.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_2a: Very well {0}, let's get right to it.  It seems the closer monsters get to the Core, the more their unique properties begin to surface.  In most cases this takes the form of their being able to inflict special damage types that require special defenses in order to withstand properly. \n\nIn Tier 2, a monster inflicting a special damage type will always produce a split normal/special damage output.  Thus, normal defense is still a somewhat valid defense choice.
item.properties|f.glacius: Mixing some advanced theories on cryogenics with the technology powering the Cooling Chamber produced this advanced armament, which is capable of flash-freezing the most formidable of foes.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_6a: Once again these sprites seem to have adapted their form to suit their surrounding environment.
item.properties|f.mercurial_demo_helm: A demo helm made from gremlin technology. It is for the bomber that wants a boost of speed, more power and a greatly reduced chance of dying by electrocution... which is probably every bomber out there.
item.properties|f.virulisk_suit: A thick set of gear crafted from the carcass of a Virulisk. Wearers will inherit some of the Virulisk's poison resistance, as well as its taste for flan.
item.properties|f.sinful_brew: A noxious drink favored by all fiends. Despite its prevalence, it's officially outlawed in the Underworld as a marketing ploy.
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: Luck changes, sometimes from bad to worse...
item.properties|f.nether_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. A tormented howl of rage can be heard on the wind when this shield smashes through your foes.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_weap_2: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
dungeon.properties|m.aurora_isles_desc: From atop mysterious floating islands, sun bleached ruins crumble under a false sky. Though the green grass and cool air feels real enough, the ever present grinding of the machine just below the surface is a constant reminder of this world's mechanical skeleton.
item.properties|f.deconstructor: A bomb specially designed for dismantling machinery, sentient or otherwise.
guild.properties|e.guild_in_default: Sorry, that guild is in-default. Try again later.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_12: Just one last shop to visit and then we're done. I've saved the best for last.
prologue.properties|m.preface1: The Morai Wars have brought us to the brink of extinction.
item.properties|f.fearless_rigadoon: The ultimate in paralyzing piercers, it's unclear whether its elegance or its wicked bite is what leaves opponents stupefied.
sprites.properties|d.frenzied_firestorm: For every monster caught in the blaze, you and your party have a chance of receiving an attack power and speed bonus.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_4: When you interact with an Alchemy Station you will open the alchemy interface where you can see your known recipe...
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_4a: Now then, greet those that have helped you become what you are today. When you are done, take the elevator back up to receive your commendation.
uplink.properties|m.wildwoods_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we've detected a recon module left by the Alpha Squad somewhere within this forest.  It is your mission to locate and retrieve the module. 

This forest is home to packs of wild beasts that have proven deadly for squads in the past. Because of this, Tech Knights have placed Beast Bells throughout the area.  Striking them should stun any beasts caught within the sound wave they produce. 

Be advised that Recon Knights have reported the presence of a terrible beast the likes which we have not seen before stalking this forest.  Known as 'the Snarbolax,' it appears as a shadowy mass of fangs and claws and seems completely immune to our weaponry.  Should you encounter it, try and find a means of escape as fast as possible. 

Good luck\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_supply_tea: Sorry I don't have much time to talk. I have to get all these supplies down to our forward outposts. People tend to forget that without knights like us running supplies down into the Clockworks, our ability to scout out areas further afield would be severely limited.  What a thankless job, huh?
mission.properties|o.vicious_viscous: Prove your valor against a legion of powerful piercing monsters
mission.properties|r.advanced_alchemy_3a: Thanks Bosco\!  I'll gather some recipes and get crafting\!
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_4a: Accept my mission and let's get to work blowing some stuff up\!
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
projectx.properties|i.style_kit: Use cosmetic items to permanently add them.
item.properties|f.big_angry_bomb: An immensely powerful bomb with a terrible attitude.
item.properties|f.piggy_banker: A small volatile bank that is sure to burn a hole in your enemies' pockets.
item.properties|f.prismatic_frosted_helm: A delicious helm made of cake created during the Spiral Knights Anniversary Celebration. It uses a strange prismatic frosting developed in Biscotti's test kitchen that prevents it from ever spoiling.  Please don't eat it.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: I will provide you with a summary of each battle sprite. In recognition of your valor in rescuing these sprites, Spiral HQ has authorized you to bond with one. This bond will last forever and is a significant responsibility. \n\nPlease think carefully before making your decision; there is no going back once you decide.
conversation.properties|m.npc_campguard_: We're resting here for a while before we journey deeper into the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.prize_box_raiders: Contains one of various unique items and accessories for raiders. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_4a: Looks like I need to get you up to speed.  We've crashed on a planet known as 'Cradle.'  Cradle is a fascinating world in that the entire interior of the planet below its surface is an ever-changing mechanical complex known as the 'Clockworks.' \n\nThe Clockworks seems to have been built by 'gremlins,' a furry race of malevolent monsters that have not taken kindly to our presence.
conversation.properties|t.af_chat_slime_: I have a delicious fruity center\!
conversation.properties|m.core_tech_3: Fresh air?  Warmth?  These depths are not an environment that many of us can stand much longer, but the Lieutenant insists that we keep at it, that maybe the surge of power from the next gate will provide us with the answer that we need. \n\nYou certainly can't argue that our Lieutenant isn't committed.  I don't think I've ever seen her close her eyes let alone sleep.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_mewkat: An adorable little spectral kitten that enjoys wandering around and mewing at just about everything it sees.
projectx.properties|m.confirm_clear: Are you sure you want to clear ALL your saved game options? \nThis includes video options and all keyboard and control mappings.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_1a: Hello there, {0}.  The name's Konway.  Spiral HQ says you're in need of some additional pointers to help you out on your upcoming missions.  Care to meet me in the Advanced Training Hall for the rundown?
mission.properties|o.shadowplay: Discover the source of the disturbance in Firestorm Citadel
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Well, I won't dishonor them by giving up now. We've come so far after all. 'Time to be a hero again\!' Right, {0}?
item.properties|f.stranger_robe: A robe once worn by one of the enigmatic Strangers.  Local Snipes seem to be drawn to the wearer.
item.properties|f.super_slime_slasher: A shovel with a wicked edge that's especially well-suited to fighting slimes in the trenches.
item.properties|f.luck_potion: A syrupy secretion said by some to strengthen serendipity. (Spiral HQ is unable to determine any actual effect.)
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_8: This gremlin comes from the colony of Emberlight, deep within the Clockworks. They're a group of outcasts that have defied King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order. We're hoping we can make a treaty with them that will allow us to use their colony as a base of operations for our missions deeper underground.
conversation.properties|n.rfc_dungeon_2a: I was imprisoned here over a thousand years ago for speaking out against my liege lord, sentenced to be here for a lifetime as my punishment.  When the fires overtook the citadel even in my passing I did not find freedom.  My soul is bound to these cursed stones.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_plump_rooste: An impressively-large Buhgok that is taking a nice, long rest after a hearty meal.
item.properties|f.ticket_variants_1: Use this ticket at the Variant Forge to reset an item's variants to 1 random variant.
dungeon.properties|m.royal_jelly_desc: The Royal Jelly Palace is an ancient castle overtaken by a legion of slime monsters. It is unclear what purpose the castle serves, though it is rumored to house a Royal Jelly, said to be nobility within the slime kingdoms. If true then the purpose of the castle is likely to serve the Royal Jelly, and nothing more.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_4: Once you safely reach the elevator, the mineral you are carrying gets deposited in your arsenal for use later. Everyone in your party gets everyone else's minerals, so no need to fight over who gets the best one\!
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_housepla: A sunny saffron plant inside a cheerful pot.
item.properties|f.snow_hat: A comfy winter hat, keeping you warm whether hunting frozen jellies or merely melting marshmallows in your hot chocolate.
item.properties|f.elemental_blaster: An enhanced blaster modified to fire elemental rounds.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_1a: Greetings, {0}\!  We have two missions of vital importance.  First, we've located an energy signature similar to the one emanating from that Artifact you found in the Clockworks.  We're homing in on that energy signature now.  Finding the source might help us understand what that gremlin schemer Razwog planned on doing with the Artifact or what the device is actually capable of.
item.properties|f.groundbreaker_armor: A suit of armor worn by knights who were among the first to brave the depths of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.recover_accessory: Accessory tickets can be redeemed at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_w: Glorp\! Glorp\! Winterfest is saved and one thing is clear\: all hearts now sing with holiday cheer\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_royalje: Here's a jelly gem for ya...
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet2_1a: Greetings, I'm Squad Leader Greta.  You must be {0}. Rhendon said we should be expecting you, and not a moment too soon.  This Rescue Camp is facing a crisis.
item.properties|f.thwacker_shield: A shield repurposed by gremlins and worn by Darkfang Thwackers. Similar to the gremlins themselves, it is resistant to fire and shock attacks. Knights who use these shields report that is impossible to completely remove all the fur stuck to it.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_1a:
(You see the lost soul of Almire standing before you.  In his face you see a profound sadness.  Staring beyond you he begins to speak without introduction.) 

Lord Vanaduke brought the fire from the mountains to our kingdom.  Everything burned.  His enemies.  Even his family. 

My family was lost too.  I fled the battle as soon as I saw the wave of flames in the distance.  I was able to reach my home just in time to see it burn.  I don't even remember how it ended.  I have no memory of my passing.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_7: Once you're ready to transmute the item, click 'Transmute' and hold your breath\!
mission.properties|o.p_r9_mat_345: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro_1a: Welcome to Cradle, recruit\! Always happy to see a knight survive a drop in one piece. We have a Rescue Camp not far from your position.  I'll guide you there- but ready your sword, there are hostiles on the road ahead\!\n
item.properties|f.schemer_scrap: A fragment of a blueprint used by gremlin schemers to construct their mechanical monstrosities. With enough of them and a little tape, you could construct a metal death machine yourself\!
pvp.properties|m.love_delete_confirm: Are you sure? The level will be deleted.
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_2a: Ah, that's right, you're a new recruit.  Most knights encounter their first sprite on the battlefield.  Chances are you've not had the opportunity to see one yet. \n\nAllow me to explain...
item.properties|f.callahan: A handgun of incredible power that can leave its target in a daze. It is said to make its targets feel far less lucky.  A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
uplink.properties|d.starter_pack: A Starter Pack is everything a Knight needs to begin their adventure on the strange, new world of Cradle. Gift it to a friend that you know will have your back\!
mission.properties|b.elemental_my_dear: Biotech Hahn has agreed to inform you about the monsters in the Clockworks that inflict elemental damage.  Contact him via comlink and hear what he has to say.
sprites.properties|d.scorching_barrier: Increases the number of orbiting fireballs and their size.
item.properties|f.punkin_pie_pan: A hot steamy pie made from real gourdlings\! Not suitable for Knight consumption, please discard at nearest friend.
item.properties|f.prismatech_alchemer_mk: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of photonic liquid at an increased rate.
item.properties|f.buccaneer_broadsider: A fearsome firearm fitted with a flintlock. The vintage mechanism's reliability has been enhanced with a bit of gremlin know-how.
item.properties|f.zee_core: A pungent mass pulled from a slimy assailant. Its aroma is an excellent remedy for insomnia, as well as nighttime sniffling and sneezing.
item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_devot: 'Wrap thy self in my embrace and succumb to my infinite love. Let your breath drift from you like candle smoke, dreaming deeper and deeper still.'
item.properties|f.fiend_portal_key: Using this will allow you to open and pass through the Grim Gate in the Ancient Grove.
mission.properties|b.p_testmission_1: Start the mission and refer to the testing notes for the depth of each floor.
mission.properties|b.faith_armor:
An apprentice named Wilks who had just arrived from a Rescue Camp has found himself in what Spiral HQ calls a 'Trap Chamber.'  These levels of most likely gremlin design seem to be specifically built to trap and ultimately eliminate those attempting to explore the Clockworks. 

Wilks probably didn't know what he had got himself into until it was too late.  Now he's stuck somewhere in the chamber and needs your help. 

Some traps can be avoided and sometimes you may find that you just have to take the hit. In saving Wilks, you will no doubt learn the true value of strong armor.
item.properties|f.prize_box_cozy: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Cozy style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.polar_day_wolf_coat: A warm coat, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending day patrols.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_a: We may not have power, but the least I can do is get a fire going to provide a little light tonight.
support.properties|m.option_210_1: If you're sure the other options didn't cover your complaint, and you're sure the player broke our Terms of Service, then please enter a short explanation here for what your complaint is.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_7b: (Your words do not seem to faze the fallen knight, whose mind seems to be lost somewhere in the glories of his past life.)
item.properties|f.bombastic_demo_helm: A finely-made helmet for the more discerning explosives expert. It won't tell you what kind of wine goes best with Nitronome, but it'll certainly keep your head looking good. And in one piece.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_5: A sprite's appetite will increase naturally over time, though slowly. To increase appetite quickly, take it for a run in the Clockworks. Absorbing heat from monsters is a great way to burn calories\!
item.properties|f.iron_wolf_coat: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Iron Wolves,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
item.properties|e.not_use_busy: Can't use this item while occupied
chat.properties|m.epicfail_format: {0} is appalled at that profound display of Epic Fail.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_4: Then you are brave as well traveler. You can find my kinsfolk throughout the whole of this court. Be very careful though, for Vanaduke's terrible minions are guarding them. Many patrol the main drag, so watch your back as you move about.\n\nOnce you find a sprite, carry them back to the sacred circle you see before you. They are no doubt weakened from Vanaduke's curse and will require rejuvenation. When six others are reunited we will form a focus link with the Spirit Mother and bring water to the wells.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_7542da: Forge an item up to level 10.
item.properties|f.autogun: A fully automatic handgun capable of rapidly firing powerful bolts of energy.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.polar_twilight_wolf_ho: A warm hood, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. It is said that the polar twilight is a wonderous sight to behold.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r6: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
item.properties|f.swimsuit_trunks: A pair of spiral issue trunks intended for coastal expeditions and fun in the sun.
conversation.properties|r.forge_knight_7: I'll look at it later. (End conversation)
item.properties|f.gorgofist: A terrifying handgun that combines the dual-crushing power of a gorgo and the mythical tortomega. Suppressing enemies has never been more fiendishly fun.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_5: I've been talking with Spiral HQ about it now for some time and they're prepared to investigate it further.  Though I don't think I'll be changing their mind about trying to open the Core any time soon.  That's still priority number one for now. \n\nAll I can say is be careful out there, {0}.  I think this world has more surprises in store for us than we know.
mission.properties|r.pioneers_7a: Tell me about Squad Recon Parma.
item.properties|f.torpor_tantrum: The ultimate sleep bomb. It's like a bedtime story, only more explodey.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_lazy_rooster: A festive new years snipe that will stay where it's placed.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_3b: Thank you for your help. When I am ready, I will enter the final gate.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_chromalisk: A timid chromalisk that seems to have lost its tongue.
sprites.properties|d.vengeful_shadow_clo: Creates an explosive disruption field around you when shadow cloak is interrupted that has a chance to stun targets.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_12b: Wonderful\!  I'm glad I could help you out.  Good luck and remember that I'll always be here to keep your armor looking unique\!
mission.properties|o.alchemy_beginners: Learn about the wonders of alchemy\!
projectx.properties|e.password_mismatch: The passwords you entered do not match.
item.properties|f.veteran_door: Installs a force barrier at the entrance of the room that can only be passed by guild members of Veteran rank and up.
item.properties|f.dangerous_diablo_helm: A helm worn by members of the Recon Rangers. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of a demon said to have broken off its own horn to use as a weapon when it faced its end.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_10a: You can find accessory tickets inside lockboxes or at the Auction House if another Knight happens to be selling them.
mission.properties|o.breaking_in_recruit: Help a group of fresh recruits survive their first tour of duty
mission.properties|o.mission_sprite_3: Secure a cache of battle sprites and return them to the Lab
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_2_7a: Are you saying these sprites learned magic spells from an old book?
helptips.properties|m.treasure_vault_sky: Relax\! Smell the flowers. Enjoy your day in the sun. You've earned it\!
auction.properties|e.search_text_short: Your search text is too short.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_1a: Well met, {0}. It is good to see you once more and under such auspicious terms.
conversation.properties|r.ritual_1b: I think I have something that might be of interest to you.
mission.properties|b.best_of_beast: After a recent promotion, Biotech Hahn has earned the title of 'Chief Biotech.' He was informed of your recent accomplishments and would like to give you a quick briefing on what you can expect from the beast and slime family of monsters as you approach the Core.
exchange.properties|m.steam_overlay_disa: The Steam overlay must be enabled in order to purchase energy.  Please ensure that "Enable Steam Community In-Game" is checked in the Steam "In-Game" settings, then restart the game.
item.properties|f.blitz_needle: For when suppression just isn't good enough, the Blitz Needle specializes in "oppressive fire".
mission.properties|r.pumping_up_2b: No thanks, I'll wander around on my own.
projectx.properties|i.limit_fps: Limit the frame rate to avoid overtaxing your video card, especially if offscreen.
item.properties|f.luminite_shard: A shard of Luminite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s:
We got enough that Anomalie let me mess around with a few. 

See, I had this handgun chassis from an old import.  Cool little launcher, but impossible to get parts for, especially the ammo. 

Well, with a little wrenching and a little creative misapplication of thermodynamics, I converted it into a pretty peppy little Spike Slicer\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_d: I have to keep these new recruits out of trouble.
mission.properties|o.crimson_chaos: Investigate a Crimson Order base that has suddenly gone silent
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_4a: If what Parma said is true then we're the last line of defense against The Swarm. {0}, I won't lie but this might change everything. We'll need to pass this on to Spiral HQ immediately. I'll round everyone up and send you a mission to accept when you're ready.
mission.properties|b.reporting_duty: Lieutenant Feron is responsible for overseeing the Clockworks mining operation in the Haven Arcade.  Report to him and learn about the situation in Haven and Spiral HQ's mission to reach the Core of Cradle.
item.properties|f.wooly_pullover: A stylish sweater for the pre-snowy season. {0}
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_r3: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.storm_rider_mantle: A legendary suit of armor thought to be worn by a god who used lightning to carve whole worlds from stone.
uplink.properties|m.tf2_start:
G'Day, loyal customer\! 

You may have recently heard that I've become the fourth richest man in America, having surpassed the fifth richest man in wealth, and having killed the previously-fourth richest man in a harpoon duel. While this is, of course, entirely true (especially the part about the harpoon duel, which was long and bloody), it's not nearly enough. Fourth place might be fine for HIPPIES who wouldn't know victory if it wandered up and offered to braid their ponytails, but it's damn well not good enough for Saxton Hale\! 

Mister Reddy, my accountant, explained to me that the best way to light a fire under the backside of Mann Co.'s revenue would be to "open up new markets". I'd relate exactly how we plan on doing that to you, but as he was talking I immediately started doing military presses to keep from dying of boredom, and missed out on the intricate details. 

All you need to know, dear customer, is that I need a good man to find his way to a town called "Haven", bravely stride into one of the many gates there and then cut his way down to the first "Clockworks Terminal". Since we couldn't find a good man, you'll have to do it yourself. You'll be amply rewarded, of course\: there's NOTHING I wouldn't do for an employee who risked life and limb on a trivial task necessitated by my selfish whims. 

Don't bother directly contacting me once you're done, as I'll be too busy kickboxing giraffes to care. One of my other employees will handle things from there. Best of luck\: you'll need it\! 

Sincerely yours, 

SAXTON HALE 
Australian 
CEO, Mann Co.

item.properties|f.padded_demo_suit: An upgraded suit for bombers that is lined with soft, stimulating padding.
conversation.properties|m.mission_collec: It looks artificial, but it seems to have a sinister awareness...
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: So far, we haven't recovered Seerus's body, but there's no way anyone could have survived that explosion.
item.properties|f.magister_robe: A ceremonial robe worn by learned masters of the arcane arts, who often leave their keys in one of the many inner pockets.
monster.properties|m.overtime_1: Go ahead and come in on Sunday, too...
helptips.properties|m.unlock: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use a Silver Key.
item.properties|f.troika: A low-tech sword that makes up for its lack of high internal power with sheer weight and size. It is capable of delivering crushing blows for those that can handle it.
item.properties|f.pepperbox: An Autogun modified to fire high-temperature bullets capable of engulfing foes.
item.properties|f.ranger_signal_flare: A flare that signals a nearby Recon Ranger to provide support fire
item.properties|f.token_jelly: Typically only carried by jelly royalty, these squishy gems are the official currency of the jelly kingdoms. Though highly prized by slimes, most other creatures simply eat them as they are quite delicious.
item.properties|f.drake_scale_helm: A helmet crafted from the scales of beasts thought to be the descendants of dragons.
conversation.properties|m.hav_snipes_2a: The snipes are the graceful, adorable, fetchingly-corpulent birds you see roaming about Haven. Some say they are the most beautiful creatures in the galaxy, but you would never hear that from the snipes themselves as they are incredibly modest.
social.properties|m.autofriend_multiple_: You have {0} friends that play Spiral Knights\! {1}
item.properties|d.gsc_vip: C O M P L I M E N T A R Y\n\nBecause you are a key casino patron, we are pleased to offer you membership free of charge.
mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft1:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, journey into the depths of a moldering sewer where intel has located a black kat nest. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!
item.properties|f.confetti: Use this item to throw it into the air and celebrate good times. Come on\!
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_7a: I'll take the artifact to the Lab.  When you're ready you should head into Haven and meet up with the rest of the crew.  I have a feeling we might be stuck on this planet for quite some time, so we might as well see what we can do to help.
item.properties|f.exp_east_1f: An expansion that adds two rooms to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.red_saber: A saber the color of the burning sun that is given to knights who have shown exemplary bravery in past actions.
sprites.properties|d.virulent_quills: Each time a quilled target is hit there is a chance to trigger a poisonous explosion.
exchange.properties|m.coinex_offer_paid: You have received {0} energy as the result of an energy trade.
item.properties|f.trinket_slot_upgrade: Once used, this upgrade opens a trinket slot for {0} days.
mission.properties|m.advanced_alchemy_2a: Basically it comes down to 'branching.'  You see, most of the alchemy you have likely seen up to this point follows a linear evolution path.  It simply improves over time and each upgrade is better than the last. \n\nBut not all items are like that.  Many of them can become multiple, completely different types of items than their original\!
logon.properties|m.under_maintenance: The game is currently undergoing maintenance.  Please check back later.
item.properties|f.holiday_hat: A festive cap that carries with it the warm spirit of the holidays. It smells faintly of gingerbread.
redeem.properties|e.max_attempts: You have tried too many invalid codes. Try again in a few minutes.
item.properties|f.furni_shelf_spiral1: A simple shelf stuffed with useful tools and devices.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_2a: Welcome to the Advanced Training Hall, {0}.  Here you will find useful survival tips to help you on your journey through the Clockworks. \n\nWould you like a tour of the facilities?
mission.properties|m.intro_expansion: Expansion Missions are special missions that must be unlocked in order to access. Completing Expansion Missions earns you exclusive rewards\!
item.properties|f.rogue_lite: Be a guiding light or a glowing spark, charging forward to leave your mark. Universally venerated, procedurally re-generated, you'll never be lost in the dark.
conversation.properties|m.casino_jelly_b: I just got back from debarber, can you tell?

conversation.properties|r.ritual_2b: I've got a really bad feeling about this, but ok...
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_1: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This particular model is a prototype version.
chat.properties|m.usage_trade: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message on the trade channel.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_3: When you acquire a recipe and use it, it consumes the recipe, but logs it in your 'known' recipes forever\!  Once it's known, you can create as many items of that recipe as you wish, so long as you have the right materials.
item.properties|f.gh_env_snowing: A beautiful environment that fills your Guild Hall with perfect snow\: the kind that gently falls from the sky and never collects on the ground, melting into gray muck.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_1a: Alright, {0}, let's get started. Looks like you and I get to go on a little sprite hunt, eh? \n\nI've aligned my tracker with the recon knight intel but something's not right. The energy signature I'm detecting is erratic, but still definitely a battle sprite. They may be in trouble, so let's hurry\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: I don't think anyone will notice I'm missing.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_1a:
Listen up, Rangers\! Spiral HQ has received a very cryptic distress signal from some completely unknown facility deep within the Clockworks. 

The way I figure, we're about to dive head first into either a perilous rescue mission or a death trap. Either way, your means of resolving the situation resides in your arsenal right now. So get geared up, and get ready for combat. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!
mission.properties|r.guardians_of_cradle: It would be my honor, Captain.
item.properties|f.drake_scale: A solid scale wrested from a brutal beast.
auction.properties|e.please_wait: The auction house is busy, please wait a moment and try again.
item.properties|f.rage_caller: A party favor of the gods, used to summon a shaft of rage from the heavens.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: It'll take forever to decipher this gremlin cryptography...
item.properties|f.flourish: A stylish saber well-appointed to foiling your enemies.
item.properties|f.prize_box_surprise_4: Contains four randomly chosen Prize Boxes in celebration of the Spiral Order's anniversary on Cradle.  No key required to open.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Two cannons have stopped firing\!  Report at once, you mongrels\!
item.properties|f.gorgomega: A terrifying shield that combines the dual-crushing power of a gorgo and the mythical tortomega. Crushing enemies has never been more fiendishly fun.
mission.properties|r.darkest_forces_3a: Well, I certainly wouldn't want to miss that.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3d: Perks are unlocked at random. Some perks are much rarer than others and will require a sprite to level up very high to unlock them all. \n\nYou can even gain perks after reaching level 100\!

social.properties|m.trade_request_pendin: You have already sent a trade request to {0}.
social.properties|m.friend_self: Sorry, you can't be your own friend.
item.properties|f.lite_shield: A lightweight knight light that offers holistic protection.
mission.properties|b.becoming_champion: Having heard of your many accomplishments and successful missions completed for Spiral HQ, Lieutenant Feron would like to speak with you.
item.properties|f.grey_owlite_shield: A resplendent replica of the shield thought to have been issued to the most eminent of Owlite wizards. Wielding it fills you with righteous vengeance.
item.properties|f.ecto_drop: A bit of ectoplasm meticulously collected from an unwilling undead volunteer. It's an unpleasant shade of green.
mission.properties|m.search_continues_1a: {0}, I cannot thank you enough.  We've already established our research base and are collecting a tremendous amount of data that we would have never had without your efforts.
chat.properties|m.usage_reboot: Usage\: /{0} minutes message\nSchedules a server reboot.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_2_2a: Well met, {0}. It is good to see you once more. \n\nNow then {0}, for your 3 Star Certification you must be currently equipped with a 3 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_rit: 'With great practice and tender care, with an eternal heart and mind so pure\: sharpen the stone, sturdy the chain, welcome the night, drink the Cup of Kings.'
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_1a: Well met soldier, and good work on reaching our base camp here in Haven. I'm Lieutenant Feron. helptips.properties|m.loading2: Armor and helms not only offer physical defense, but can also protect you from status conditions. The right combination will greatly increase your chance of survival.

pvp.properties|m.unsigned: You can sign up to play.
item.properties|f.gsc_vip: A non-transferrable membership in the Golden Slime Casino C.U.B.E. Club. Membership benefits are subject to change.
support.properties|m.item_recovered_mess: Spiral Knights support has recovered your item or items. Click below to claim.
mission.properties|m.new_chapter_1a: Congratulations on becoming a Soldier, {0}\!  I hear you really gave that Snarbolax a clobbering, well done\! \n\nWe've had an opportunity to analyze Euclid's recon module you discovered in the Snarbolax's lair.  Based on the recording, it seems that Euclid suspected something our Geo Knights discovered sometime after the crash- that the levels within the Clockworks are comprised of terrain from multiple alien worlds\!
item.properties|f.obsidian_carbine: A deadly gun made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. With every shot fired, a faint whisper is heard, believed to be the true name of its target.
social.properties|m.trade_request: {0} would like to trade with you.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest2_r6: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.valiance: This high-performance handgun is a symbol of the Spiral Order, and is proudly worn by veteran members. As it is often said, a knight need not have courage\: just Valiance.
chat.properties|m.usage_team: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message privately to your team.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_3: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This final, perfected design is truly befitting the Grand Arsenal of the great Warmaster Seerus.
sprites.properties|d.venom: Increases the potency of the poison inflicted.
item.properties|f.valiant_visor: A lightweight visor for scouting and skirmishing, often highly accessorized.
item.properties|f.punkin_cinnamug: A frothy blend of punkins and cinnamon that is sure to burn those that don't wait for this mug to cool.
