mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.
conversation.properties|m.tortodrone_hav: Spiral HQ has us investigating reports that pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter are appearing all over the Clockworks. Kora believes the Fiends are up to something. There is evidence they played a hand in the disappearance of the tortodrones.
exchange.properties|m.preview_purchasing: Purchasing is disabled on this server.  Please use the normal Spiral Knights client to purchase energy.
item.properties|f.true_love_locket: A small, heart-shaped locket with an inscription reading "Processing thoughts of you always, Love Puppy"
mission.properties|m.true_champion_1a: {0}\! Oh, {0} you made it\! Haha\! \n\nI am so happy you came out of there alive\!  I was worried sick about you\!
mission.properties|m.intro_prestige: Prestige Missions are bonus missions offered to you daily. Completing Prestige Missions earns you prestige.
exchange.properties|m.steam_success: Thank you for your purchase\! Your Energy will be delivered momentarily.
item.properties|f.magic_cloak: A wondrous robe worn by apprentices in the art of spells and sorcery.
item.properties|f.frozen_great_cleaver: A custom made Triglav designed by Biscotti, head chef of the Skylark. Though she swears it's used just for cooking, one can't help but think more than a few monsters have met it at the chopping block as well.
guild.properties|m.removing_features: Removing this expansion will lower upkeep but will also remove any installed rooms or doors in the expansion. Any furnishings in the expansion will be returned to the Guild Treasury.\n\nAdditionally you will lose the following features\: {0}
item.properties|f.sacred_keeper_helm: A cerulean hued helm for those who want to wreck some robos.
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_1: Well met soldier, and good work on reaching our base camp here in Haven. I'm Lieutenant Feron. I have been assigned by Captain Ozlo to oversee our Clockworks mining operation.\n\nBefore you lies "the Arcade," a fascinating complex that serves as our link into the heart of the Clockworks. Since you're new here, I'll give you a quick run-down of what Spiral HQ has us doing here.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_mat_2: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.barrier_cannon: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. The elemental offense of a tortodrone on the Long Migration should aid you on your own expeditions.
item.properties|f.big_beast_basher: It was suggested that this brutally sharp mining pick could probably be used to hunt both beasts AND minerals. The Clockworks were never the same.
guild.properties|m.warn_in_default: WARNING\: Your guild is in default\!
item.properties|f.lockbox_character: A special lockbox that contains one of many unique items that modify the appearance of your Knight\!  It can only be opened with a Silver Key.  Silver Keys can be purchased from the Supply Depot.
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r7: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.
mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the evil master of munitions within the gremlin's all-powerful Crimson Order  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.
conversation.properties|r.rc_virgil_2a: Why is this walkway here then?
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_1a: Tell me what you know about the gremlins.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_ora: A tall torch filled with otherworldly orange fire.
projectx.properties|i.compatibility_mode: May prevent graphical glitches and boost performance for some\nsystems, but reduces graphical quality.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_mat_1: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_3_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 4 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_1a: Welcome to the Haven Bazaar\!  It's a pleasure to meet you {0}, my name is Bechamel. Since I work here in the Bazaar, Spiral HQ has asked me to show new arrivals around this fabulous epicenter of commerce and let them know everything it has to offer. \n\nSo let's go on a quick tour shall we?  Try and keep up, I walk fast.
item.properties|f.stoic_buster: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you sense the quiet passing of the wind and can call upon the rumbling storm that follows.
chat.properties|m.usage_recharge: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nCharges a player (yourself by default) up with mist energy.
item.properties|f.hexoskeleton: Protects the thorax, abdomen, and legs. No molting necessary.
item.properties|f.shadow_blaster: An enhanced blaster modified to fire shadow rounds.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: At any given time a sprite has a 'favored item', a special material that it enjoys eating the most. Feeding one of these to your sprite is a great treat and grants the sprite a lot of heat.
uplink.properties|m.detached_accessory: Spiral Knights had a change and the attached accessory was removed from your {0}.\n\nApologies.
item.properties|f.dark_briar_barrage: A mythical object that can explode with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. The unearthly howl it produces is said to be more crippling than its blast.
item.properties|f.solid_cobalt_armor: A sturdy set of Cobalt Armor reforged for additional comfort and protection.
guild.properties|i.member_storage: Community item storage for members and above.
dungeon.properties|m.revive_member: Revive using a Spark of Life ({0})
mission.properties|b.occurance_at_owlite:
An unlikely source of intel has surfaced from the residents of Moorcroft Manor.  A few of the spookats that call it home contacted one of our visiting Recon Knights and provided details of the negative energy mass that has appeared above the Core. 

Calling it 'a place of burning hatred' and 'a prison for dark souls' they say that you can read all about it in 'one of those weird Owlite books' in an Owlite keep they pinpointed. 

If what they claim is true Spiral HQ could gain valuable intel from investigating the Owlite keep.  Just remember that these Owlite structures have all proven to be swarming with the lost souls of countless undead monsters.  Prepare accordingly.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Good luck in there, we know you can do it\!
helptips.properties|m.atg_crowns: CROWNS are used to buy items and pay for other services.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
mission.properties|b.scarlet_fortress: Entirely different from the Aurora Isles, recon knights have discovered another geo-globe containing the remains of a seemingly ancient castle.  Dubbed the 'Scarlet Fortress,' this crumbling castle is also the home to a horde of restless spirits. Proceed with caution when exploring its twisting passages.
helptips.properties|m.loading13: If you are the party leader, you can remove any player from your party. Click the status icon of the player you wish to remove and select "Remove from Party."
dungeon.properties|m.candlestick_keep.de: All that remains of the Owlite Academy, the Candlestick Keep is now a grim shadow of the once great school of magical arts.  Knights who have made it out of this cursed keep have only this advice to offer- 'stay in the light.'
item.properties|m.use_change_color: Use your {0} to change your personal color?
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_4a: Your sprite will evolve as you level it up. At certain key levels your sprite will require an Evo Catalyst be fed to it in order to level up further. Once fed, your sprite will physically change its appearance\! \n\nIt will be interesting to see how these strange, new forms of battle sprites evolve in time.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_3: You will find ore deposits in all levels of the Clockworks, and you must attack them in order to break them down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
item.properties|f.bio_helm: An air-tight helm designed by biotechs for collecting field samples or working in toxic greenhouses.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_15: I'd like to see the shops. (Follow Tylen)
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r9: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
conversation.properties|r.tut_warden_1a: Great, I'm looking forward to a hot meal.
item.properties|f.ancient_plate_mail: A suit of artifact armor that is said to have been worn by titans. Though it offers amazing protection, its incredible weight makes it cumbersome to wear.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Then scour the Clockworks for those wretched kats and destroy them\! Even if they ate the books you will be able to recover the Ancient Pages. These pages can be given to Montague in exchange for rewards. Help us and we'll help you\! \n\nBlack kats can be found randomly when encountering spookats in Tier 2 and Tier 3 (Arcade Gates and Missions). There is also a daily Prestige Mission that likely leads to a black kat nest.
helptips.properties|m.lock_guard: Protect and heal yourself and teammates from damage with the Guardian Shield\! \n\nKeep enemies at bay with increased resistances to damage and attack with faster swords and bombs\!
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: Well, we now know there were massive citadels housing Almire's armed forces and great estates for its noble houses. It must have been quite a sight to see. We assume the rest of the kingdom is still a smoldering ruin somewhere. It is possible that some of it might have survived...though given the anecdotal evidence we think it is unlikely at best.
support.properties|m.option_203_0:
You have to be 13 years or older to play this game. If someone admits in chat that they are under 13 then please click here to file the complaint against them.

Do NOT use this option if you simply believe the player to be underage, as there has to be proof in the last few minutes of chat. If there is no proof, then you should drop the complaint. 

Please use common sense, if they claim to be 4 years old while typing perfectly as an example then that's clearly not true and you should not file the complaint.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.token_spirit: An otherworldly brand placed upon a soul claimed by the mysterious Apocrea. Removing it allows the captured soul to escape imprisonment within the terrible realm of the Apocrea.
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_fiend_: I've got a case of the Mondays.
item.properties|f.skolver_coat: The ultimate in Wolver-hide clothing, this coat has been expertly crafted to give your melee attacks extra power.
mission.properties|m.breaking_in_recruit: Gremlins\!? Am I reading this data right? An ambush\!? How were they able to trick our sensors?
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_3: Hi there, {0}\! As Head Chef of the Skylark I've been assigned to oversee the nutritional development of our new sprite companions. They seem to have really diversified themselves down there in the Clockworks. It will be interesting to see how they develop. \n\nDo you have any questions about feeding and caring for your sprite?
item.properties|f.prize_box_blooming: Contains various unique costumes and accesories to celebrate the blooming nature of spring.  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.arctic_rogue_mask: A mask said to be crafted by an arctic rogue. The shattered ice will conceal your identity during clandestine arctic expeditions.
item.properties|m.trinket_tip_locked: Trinket Slot (Buy Trinket Slot Upgrade to Unlock)
mission.properties|r.cwt_mintut_1: Minerals? You mean these colorful rocky pillars?
mission.properties|r.winterfest_danger_1: I need all the help I can get, tell me all you know.
item.properties|f.advanced_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. This orb is exceptional and can be used to craft very powerful items.
item.properties|f.black_kat_mask: An impressive mask instilled with the might of Kat Nappers, the undercover sleeper cell of the Kat Tribe.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_divine: A bright, heavenly theme that will make it really hard to lose your keys.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_1a: What's this? You still have your body. Perhaps you can help us.
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_4a: We need you to explore the surrounding levels and collect any intel you can.  You can start with an Owlite castle of some sort that recently surfaced near this anomaly.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_a: I just need to rest a bit before moving on.
item.properties|f.vog_cub_cap: A thick hat that smells heavily of barbecue. Barbecued what? Don't ask.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_4: I mean that the Core isn't a big battery that runs this world, but rather it and the whole of this world is a massive prison designed to keep something from ever leaving. \n\nThink about our geo-scans of Cradle just before the crash- they show it as being composed of hundreds of massive slabs of other worlds, almost like plates of armor.  Then you have the Clockworks, the most unnatural thing I've ever seen.  An entire world whose sole purpose seems to be stopping anyone from ever reaching its Core.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
mission.properties|b.p_apocrea_r4: Several capable knights have gone missing in a seemingly normal area of the Clockwork Tunnels. Spiral HQ suspects foul play and has assigned you to investigate the level.

conversation.properties|m.sl_guard_2: Recon Knights who have ventured within these strange, new worlds claim to feel a dreadful darkness enveloping them at every turn.  There's something else happening here and we need our most elite knights to investigate.
mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the master of munitions of the gremlin's Crimson Order.  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_3a: Our recent intel from Recon Knights suggest that gremlins are planning something big.  We believe they are developing some kind of weapon they're calling 'Project R' that will be targeting Haven itself.  Spiral HQ and the Strangers themselves are requesting that you investigate the matter given your performance in the Royal Jelly Palace.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r6: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!

help.properties|m.clockworks_1: The Clockworks is your gateway to the planet's Core\! It's filled with a huge variety of worlds and populated with monsters and treasure beyond your imagination. Beware, however\: the deeper you go below the surface, the tougher and smarter your opponents will become\!
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_4: That's the kind of spirit I like to see. It works like this\: you use the gates up ahead to explore the Clockworks and retrieve special minerals. Then you deposit those minerals back in to gates to change the Clockworks below, creating new, unexplored levels.\n\nWe believe the minerals are the key to opening a path to the Core, we just need to discover how to use them\!

mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_danger:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

On behalf of Impostoclaus, Spiral HQ has located the base of operations of the nefarious Grinchlins. It's time to take the fight to them and end their Winterfest terrorism once and for all. But it won't be an easy task. 

Those who accept this mission must climb Mount Krampus, a perilous trek filled with Grinchlin ambushes and icy deathtraps. Along the way you will find shelters that allow you to collect Grinchlin treasures and escape the mountain, or press on toward the summit for even greater rewards\! Just be warned\: Grinchlins and their allies are a stingy lot and will not drop ANY loot. All the treasures to be found on Mount Krampus are at the shelters. And should you pass on them for greater rewards ahead, you risk losing everything if you fail\! 

Some say that on the very summit of Mount Krampus lies a stash of Grinchlin loot that may contain treasures none have ever seen before...
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.

mission.properties|m.legion_almire_2a:
An excerpt from the accounts of Lord Brandell, High Chancellor of Almire\: 

Like so many of its people, Law and Order have fled Almire.  Only Justice remains, but she too has been twisted by the cursed flames that ravage our kingdom.  Justice is now the burning scepter of our once great Lord Vanaduke.  Justice is swift, unflinching, merciless. 

My position has afforded me much in my life.  I used to love the view that my tower offers. From these lofty heights I thought of myself as the first one to greet the spring season, the first to smell the life in the air as the flowers bloomed.

mission.properties|b.silent_legion:
Guardian Knight Arkus was one of the finest warriors serving the Spiral Knights until some time shortly after the crash.  As one of the first to search for the Alpha Squad, Arkus's own squad perished in a grisly battle with a horde of dust zombies.  Since then, Arkus has blamed himself for their loss, saying that he betrayed his Guardian's Oath to protect his squad. 

Arkus now journeys into the Clockworks alone, never risking the loss of another squad and we believe, somehow trying to find the squad he once lost.  As these expeditions began to appear self-destructive, Spiral HQ issued him a direct order to cease. 

Arkus ignored these orders and has gone deep into the Clockworks and not returned.  Not wanting to lose the last member of his squad, Spiral HQ is asking you to pursue him to his last known whereabouts, some kind of mysterious statuary at depth 26.

mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_b_: The inhabitants native of Haven are called 'Strangers.' You can't miss them- they're the towering, cloaked figures with masks. Despite their intimidating appearance, they have been extremely helpful to us and mostly keep to themselves. The odd, little birds in town certainly seem to like them anyway\!
mission.properties|m.cryptic_coder: Schemer Razwog\: Work away from the others. The Order must never know we have the artifact. Find a way to power it. Bring it to me. Do not betray me.  I will know. \n\n-H
item.properties|f.furni_library_lectern_: A podium displaying a magical tome filled with arcane symbols, esoteric formulae, and few particularly rude doodles.
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: From the tomes we have recovered, we've learned that Firestorm Citadel was once part of a much larger kingdom known as Almire thousands of years ago. Although it was bordered by other aggressive nations, Almire was renowned for the martial prowess of its many legions. These legions kept the kingdom safe for many years. Alas, they weren't enough.
item.properties|m.accessory_multi: This accessory occupies two locations\: {0} and {1}.
conversation.properties|m.fc_bridge_1: Few make it across the bridge traveler. Perhaps you stand a chance of surviving, or perhaps... no, even the good sprites below will be swallowed by Vanaduke's flames. It is hopeless.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_7a: Grantz was the real veteran of the bunch.  A seasoned Guardian, Grantz specialized in keeping his squad safe, namely by crushing anything that would mean to do them harm. \n\nGrantz took his Guardian's Oath very seriously, often putting himself directly in harm's way in order to protect another.  The guy was selfless.  I imagine that if disaster truly befell the Alpha Squad, Grantz didn't let it end without one hell of a fight.
item.properties|f.prize_box_slime: Contains various unique costumes and items that augment the Jelly series of gear. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.vial_stun: An ornate glass vial containing shimmering flash pellets. It can be used to inflict enemies with Stun.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and your foes will be too stupefied to give chase\!

conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_3a: Gremlins are a race of creatures who are incredibly adept at creating and dismantling all manners of machinery. They are at once a legion of brilliant artificers and a force of powerful destruction.

{0}\! You did it\!  I've got my kitchen back\! 

Remember, you can exchange the Cake Slices you receive for awesome cake helms from Maskwell in the Haven Town Square. It's just like that old baker's saying, 'Wear the hide of your fallen foes to prove your might as a warrior\!' 

Ok, maybe I just say that.

Tier 3 fiends and undead are nothing to sneeze at, in fact they're among the worst creatures you'll find so close to the Core. \n\nDevilite management seems to be the worst at these depths and that results in some very violent devilites.

mission.properties|m.target_acquired_3a: We have pinpointed its location to be in the deepest level of a gremlin facility known as the 'Ironclaw Munitions Factory.'  The factory is used for the production of all manners of gremlin weaponry and is highly dangerous, even to the gremlins working there. \n\nYou must prepare yourself for heavy resistance from shock-powered constructs and gremlins.
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_3b: Thanks for the info tall guy, see you around town.
mission.properties|m.best_of_beast_3a: Should you find yourself facing beast and slime monsters in Tier 3, be aware that they are capable of pure piercing damage.  Only the best piercing-resistant gear will keep you alive in the face of these powerful, piercing predators. \n\nOnce you've completed your upcoming missions we'll talk again.  Good luck, {0}.
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_3a: It is hard to know exactly as so much of what is within seems to hold their origin from different worlds. Some appear to be from realms of great antiquity, no doubt once home to innumerable old gods and creatures.\n\nThis world is an unnatural one. What you see within it was never meant to be here. The great histories of so many worlds endlessly churning through the cogs of this great machine... I find it quite sad.
item.properties|f.woven_pathfinder_helm: A flexible helm built for mobility and interlaced with slime fibers to protect against prickly and thorny foes.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_4a: Uh, I think these sprites are studying these old books. I didn't even know they could read\! \n\nAnyway, I'll stay here and protect these sprites. I see more empty transport crates; not good. You go on ahead and clear the area of hostiles so that a rescue squad can arrive safely.
item.properties|f.wicked_whisker: A whisker won from the great Kat Tribe hero, Margrel. They were traditionally worn as a ward against Owlite magics but now represent the triumph of goodly magical arts over evil.
uplink.properties|m.newsletter_resub: If you had previously subscribed to the newsletter, just confirm your email address and resubscribe to claim your Proto Crest accessory\!
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_2b:
Additionally, HR has requested an updated org chart as soon as possible. It is our understanding that all Pit Boss duties, administrative and otherwise, have been turned over to a 'Maulos of the Eternal Frost,' is that correct? 

Cheers, 
Morgral'm 
Assistant Supervisor of Resource Allocations, Undercorp
item.properties|f.volcanic_plate_shield: A superior shield imbued with the elemental essence of flame. It is so resistant to high temperatures that it's a mystery how exactly it was forged in the first place.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_4_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 5 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.

...This world has seen few greater tragedies than the fall of the great Kingdom of Almire.  Once a vibrant, beautiful realm of lush forests and sweeping plains... 

...neighboring kingdoms declared war... 

...seeking the power needed to turn the tide, Lord Vanaduke of Almire fled into the mountains...
mission.properties|b.heart_of_matter: Lieutenant Vaelyn led the first squad into the Clockworks that attempted to located the Alpha Squad.  She is a talented squad leader thought to be on par with Euclid himself.  Vaelyn has never given up her search and is now attempting to put together an on-site Core research team in order to better understand the very place where the Alpha Squad's trail is thought to end.

sprites.properties|d.angelic_aura: Creates protective aura around you that also protects any party members within it.

pvp.properties|m.refunded: You have been refunded your Coliseum entrance fee of {0} crowns.
projectx.properties|m.find_rhendon: Find and talk to Rhendon to gain access to missions.
item.properties|f.golden_solstice_ring: An enchanted ring that embodies the spirit of the solstice. Its glittering golden luster shines brightest during the summer months.
guild.properties|i.buy_expansions: Purchase more space for the Guild Hall. Increases upkeep.
guild.properties|log.door_placed: Placed a {0} for {1} crowns, replacing a {2}.
item.properties|f.prize_box_nemesis: Contains various unique items representing good and evil. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
sprites.properties|d.crystal_harness_adv: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal elemental damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 5% \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Seraphynx
mission.properties|r.apocrea_2_3a: I will try. Tell me what to do.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_1b: What services can I find here? (Follow Tylen)
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_6a: I've heard some of the other Biotechs mention how much they wish to get the Skylark operational once again and return home.  I hear they're very grateful to Knights like you, {0}.
item.properties|f.grand_tortofist: A handgun empowered by the limitless fury of a tortodrone. While wielding it you can feel the berserk energy within eager to be unleashed.
chat.properties|m.usage_mute: Usage\: /{0} player name\nBlocks messages from the specified player.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_4a: (The lost soul continues to stare beyond you, saying nothing.)
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_9a:
Ok, back to business then. 

Punch can add Unique Variants, a kind of special bonus to your weapons and gear for a price. But his methods are, er... chaotic.  You never really know what you're going to get. 

Vise is a little more precise.  He can unbind your weapons and gear for a price, allowing you to sell or gift the item again\!
item.properties|f.rock_jelly_shield: Crafted from the most adamant of slimy specimens, it also functions as an emergency source of calories for stranded knights.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_4_2: With the Biotechs' help, I should be on the mend and fit for duty again in no time.  {0}, I can't stress enough how important this victory is for all Spiral Knights.  You've helped us deal a mighty blow to the Crimson Order by destroying their Grand Arsenal. \n\nThanks to you, gremlin forces will not have any more of these massive war machines for some time. And with our Technicians studying what is available in Seerus's personal quarters we may end up gaining valuable insights into gremlin technology or even the location of the rest of the Crimson Order\!
item.properties|f.almire_bench: A balanced bench built for Almirian officials.
item.properties|f.dark_chaingun: A machine gun capable of firing a barrage of searing, shadow bolts.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: I just put in another bulk order for office supplies. We keep running out.
mission.properties|r.apocrea_1_4a: I won't let them take me so easily.
item.properties|f.vial_freeze_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing glacial wind. It can be used to inflict enemies with Freeze.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and chill your foes right in place\!
item.properties|f.brute_jelly_helm: A hardy helm crafted from overly oppressive ooze.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_4a: Even though you have defeated Vanaduke, it appears as though the curse he brought down upon this kingdom still lingers. It requires all of our power to keep these raging shadow fires in check.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: What are you doing\!? My cakes\! My pretty cakes\! Unacceptable\!
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_3_11: I'll put an end to their scheme.
item.properties|f.nodeslime_shield: This weathered wobbling wall can withstand a walloping when wielded by unwaveringly willed warriors.
mission.properties|r.alchemy_beginners_9: I think I've got it, thanks\!
item.properties|f.empty_room_checker_sma: An empty Guild Hall room with a checkerboard pattern on the floor.
exchange.properties|m.offertobuy_tooltip: Enter the amount of energy you want to buy, in multiples of 100.
mission.properties|m.steam_overlay_disab: The Steam overlay must be enabled in order to purchase expansions. Please ensure that "Enable Steam Community In-Game" is checked in the Steam "In-Game" settings, then restart the game.
shop.properties|m.name: Name
conversation.properties|m.tut_warden_3a: Nicely done, {0}\! It seems you know your way around the battlefield. \n\nCome on, let's head to the camp. Maybe you can help us figure out just what the heck is going on here.
exchange.properties|m.opening_paypal: Opening PayPal checkout in your browser...
item.properties|f.ultra_poison_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly toxic orbs that can cripple hostiles
design.properties|e.regenerating: Design Mode is regenerating. Please try again in a moment.
monster.properties|m.fired_3: Ahh, I'm gonna have to fire you. OK?
mission.properties|o.p_apocrea_r7: Investigate the area of the Clockworks where several knights have gone missing.
item.properties|f.hunters_lodge_room: A monster hunting lodge curated by the great hunter, Armero. Contains a guild alchemy machine containing monster trophy recipes. Guild alchemy machines use resources from the Guild Treasury and deposit results into the Guild Treasury.
item.properties|f.jack_froster: Usher in a winter wonderland with this nose-nipping, nasty surprise that is perfect for giving your foes a bad case of frostbite.
item.properties|f.round_helm: A svelte helm that's just waiting to be accessorized.
item.properties|f.static_diskgun: A shockingly powerful handgun that creates a storm of electrified disks. Diskgun shots return once reaching their apogee.
guild.properties|log.upkeep_paid: Upkeep paid\! {0} crowns removed from the guild treasury.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_overgrown_1: I'll leave the next few areas to you. They are pretty overgrown, so keep your eyes peeled for monsters in the tall grass. Some of them are pretty adept at hiding in the shadows. Gives me the creeps just thinking about it really.
item.properties|f.galactic_guardian_helm: A commemorative helm that pays tribute to the countless brave Isoran guardians that have protected spacefaring crews in their adventures across the stars.
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_4: When using the Forge, you will see a list of any items that are ready to level up. Selecting an item will show you how it can be enhanced.
projectx.properties|m.equip_loadout_lock: There are unbound items in {0}. Equipping this loadout will automatically bind them. Are you sure?
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_9b: Great, then I will go ahead and give you credit for this mission. \n\nRemember, if you would like to come back for more training, The Advanced Training Hall is located in Haven Town Square.  Take care out there, {0}.
projectx.properties|m.check_email: Check your email in the Uplink panel.
craft.properties|m.confirm_unbind_heat: Unbinding will remove all heat from the item. Are you sure?
conversation.properties|r.rc_instruct_1b: No questions, just actions. I'm off now.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_3a: Yes, at this point you must begin forming an arsenal that protects you against special damage types. \n\nYour current missions will have you facing monsters with piercing damage attacks.  Thus, you must begin acquiring helmets, armor and shields that defend against piercing damage.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_5: Minerals are used to create sprite food in the Laboratory. Sprite food is very important to the development of your sprite, so grab those minerals when you see them\!
item.properties|f.polar_twilight_wolf_co: A warm coat, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. It is said that the polar twilight is a wonderous sight to behold.
item.properties|f.plasma_capacitor: The addition of an advanced Spiral power source gives this bomb a shockingly large blast radius.
item.properties|f.cryotech_alchemer_mkii: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of extremely low temperature material at an increased rate.
item.properties|f.heavy_plate_mail: Thick armor reinforced with more metal plates than a Clockworks vending machine. It's a little uncomfortable.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_1_6a: They look like dragons from fairy tales.
item.properties|f.stranger_cap: A hat once worn by one of the enigmatic Strangers.  Local Snipes seem to be drawn to the wearer.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest2_r4: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
exchange.properties|m.trade4energy_toolt: Click here to accept the listed trade, and buy energy with crowns.
item.properties|f.ice_queen_crown: A regal crown resembling that of the ever-frigid Ice Queen.  In addition to providing great defense, it is said to dramatically boost one's ego and create a cold detachment from those around them.
dungeon.properties|m.lobby_desc: A lobby before entering a gate where knights can strategize and gear up for the adventure to come.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_8a: Yes, quite. These sprites have adapted the power to cloak, to use the very shadows around them for subterfuge. Between that and their newfound skills in toxins and debilitations, I'd say they could be quite handy on the battlefield.
mission.properties|o.chilled_to_bone: Investigate the shadowy remains of the Candlestick Keep
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
logon.properties|m.network_error: Either there is a temporary network outage or the server is not yet fully operational. Please wait a moment before reconnecting.
guild.properties|i.veteran_storage: Community item storage for veterans and above.
item.properties|f.volatile_catalyzer: Removing the safety overrides from a piece of Gremlin technology is a good way to lose a limb. In this case, it probably won't be one of yours. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_mat_4: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.prize_box_dazed: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Dazed style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
projectx.properties|m.please_relaunch: Please quit and re-run the game to check your new options.
mission.properties|o.p_heart_of_ice_r9: Discover the source of the terrible blizzards emanating from Amu-Sol
chat.properties|m.usage_lbroadcast: Usage\: /{0} (en fr it de es) message\nBroadcasts message to everyone using the specified language.
item.properties|f.polar_night_wolf_coat: A warm coat, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending night patrols.
mission.properties|r.best_of_beast_3a: Roger that Hahn, talk to you soon.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_5a: I'll stay here and protect these sprites. Some of these sprite transport crates are empty. I think someone or something is after them. \n\nYou go on ahead and clear the area of hostiles so that a rescue squad can arrive safely.
item.properties|f.prize_box_surge: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Surge style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_2a: You stand within the Hall of Heroes, where the best of the Spiral Knights offer what they can to aspiring knights.  Knights like you yourself once were when you first emerged from your drop pod and found your way to Haven. \n\nAnd after so many successful missions, daring rescues and exemplary performance in battle, you now stand fit to join these heroes.
item.properties|f.ancient_plate_shield: An antique shield whose origins have been lost to the passing of time.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_3: You will find ore deposits in all levels of the Clockworks, and you must attack them in order to break them down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_4: We've doubled the amount of patrols around Haven in case there is another attack, but I have a feeling that those gremlins already got what they came for...
mission.properties|o.explosive_plot: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
item.properties|f.sacred_hex_armor: A phantasmal suit of armor for those who are aiming for the infernal.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_stri: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r4: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
mission.properties|b.the_collector: There have been scattered reports of a large, mechanical entity we have named the 'Collector' who has been intercepting our knights and taking both them and the sprites they were tracking and imprisoning them in a well-guarded compound deep within the Clockworks.  Armed with your new sprite, your mission is to find this 'Collector' and rescue the knights and sprites it has taken captive.
item.properties|f.surge_breaker_shield: A reliable shield that'll help keep you grounded in battle.
item.properties|f.super_fire_barrier: Surrounds you with potent fiery orbs that can set hostiles ablaze
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_1: Hello there, {0}\!  My name is Bosco and I'm here to give you a rundown on the basics of alchemy. \n\nIt's pretty simple stuff really, thanks to these Alchemy Stations.  They do all the heavy lifting for ya\!
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_blu: A tall torch filled with bizarre blue fire.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_elem: Greetings {0}, I'm Archilus, a knight who utilizes gear that offers high elemental damage defense.  The recipes I have for you produce armor and shields that protect you from the elemental attacks of constructs and gremlins. \n\nElemental resistant armor and shields are adapted from Owlite technology.  Though the Owlites themselves no longer exist, their amazing elemental mastery lives on in this gear.
item.properties|f.cutter: A bandit's sword with a vicious row of jagged teeth.
item.properties|f.radiant_sun_shards: A solid chunk of solar-charged Luminite with an explosive surprise inside. Devilites hate surprises.
projectx.properties|m.queue_position: You are at position {0} in the logon queue.
item.properties|f.nameless_poncho: A nameless poncho worn by a nameless hero of legend.
mission.properties|m.the_flickering_flam: We were in the middle of receiving a report from Lieutenant Vaelyn's team at the Core Terminal when our signal was disrupted. It took some time, but I've managed to pinpoint the source of the disruption. It's coming from that strange device you discovered near Vanaduke's throne room in Firestorm Citadel.  It seems like someone has activated it.
mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_4a: I'd like to help however I can.  Where is Spiral HQ now located?
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_steam_cont: Menu key toggles between mouse mode
item.properties|f.purring_cap: A curious cap made to resemble a mewkat. It is said to grant the wearer nine lives.
item.properties|f.furni_statue: A commemorative statue that may be placed in a Guild Hall. Up to {0} statues may be placed per hall.
support.properties|m.option_208_1:
If a player has already taken over your account, you will need to contact us via our support form to recover your account again.

Be aware we need proof of who owns the account, and we can only get this by confirming how the account was paid for.

Click here to start recovering your paid account which was taken over.
helptips.properties|m.atg_button: Standing on a BUTTON can open locked doors.
item.properties|f.heavy_gear: A weighted gear that previously assisted in the operation of an enormous machine.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_2a: Once I make it to Haven I really can't come back?
item.properties|f.trojan_armor: The armor of the stalwart Spiral Wardens is said to give great comfort to other knights. Nothing says 'here comes the cavalry' like the sight of these iron giants taking to the battlefield.
item.properties|f.ronin_gasa: A lost straw cap once belonging to a lordless swordmaster.
mission.properties|m.elig_ok_replay: You are eligible to replay this mission.
item.properties|f.stellar_sentinel_helm: This helm was was once worn by Isoran starfarers of eons long passed that stood watch over extrasolar operations. With this equipped, you feel like you understand the machinations of the universe.
item.properties|f.prize_box_dangerous: Contains various unique items used by Desna's elite Recon Rangers. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
projectx.properties|m.reboot_msg_downtim: The game will be unavailable for a short time during scheduled maintenance.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: Greetings, {0}\! Now that I've had sufficient time to research the battle sprites you rescued I can give you a proper evaluation of each. \n\nDespite their well, strange appearance, we have concluded that these 'new' battle sprites are not only suitable for combat but may have even further enhanced capabilities as a result of their transformation.
chat.properties|m.usage_clear: Usage\: /{0}\nClears your chat display and history.
mission.properties|r.collector_prisoner_: Can you make it back to Haven?
item.properties|f.swimsuit_wrap: A spiral issue sarong draped over a one piece suit intended for coastal expeditions and fun in the sun.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest2_r9: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.prize_box_spiralhorn: Contains various unique accessories and items to celebrate the Year of the Ram\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.omegaward: The pulsing elemental plates of this shield instantaneously react to adverse climates protecting you from even the most extreme cold or heat.
item.properties|f.shade_armor: A suit of armor infused with dark matter that allows its wearer to shoot straight and surprise foes from the shadows.
item.properties|f.plate_shield: A heavy iron shield adept at deflecting impacts that would otherwise leave you stunned.
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_3: These shelters will offer you two choices\: exit the mountain and claim some Grinchlin treasure, or press on further up the mountain. \n\nShould you press on, you pass on the loot in that shelter, but will find even more treasures at the next shelter.
mission.properties|r.honor_duty_2a: I hope her findings produce something meaningful.
item.properties|f.mad_bomber_suit: Some people have axes to grind. Others have points to make. This armor is for those of us with explosive tempers.
dungeon.properties|m.final_test_desc: The final gate available at the Rescue Camp, this gate crosses the chasm and leads into Haven. There is no going back once completed.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_bystande: Careful in there.  Looks like they had a big one with them...
item.properties|f.sinister_skelly_mask: An upgraded Skelly Mask sure to spook any spineless monsters lumbaring around the Clockworks.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_3a: Soon you will find yourself in one of the traps set by the Apocrea. If you are powerful enough to escape then you may be able to save some of the other lost souls along the way.
mission.properties|o.crossing_chasm: Cross the perilous chasm and connect with Spiral HQ in Haven
item.properties|m.heat_bonus: Doubles the amount of heat you will acquire.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_fire: A fiery theme that's sure to keep your Guild Hall warm and toasty... or sweaty.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3c: See Riley here in the Lab to purchase new harnesses. Once purchased, a harness is automatically added to your harness list in the battle sprite interface. \n\nAdditionally, any time you purchase a direct upgrade to a harness you own, it will be replaced by the superior harness.
mission.properties|o.the_flickering_flam: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
helptips.properties|m.unlock_gold: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use the Gold Key.
item.properties|f.sunset_duster: A sturdy set of leather clothing made for a pilgrim with true grit.
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_3c: Most of them will attack you on sight, but there are some; outcasts from the colony, that have taken refuge in the towns below the surface. Theirs is a hard life, hated by their own kind and no longer in a world they call home.
mission.properties|m.shocking_sentient_s: The Sparkcaster Deluxe is almost stable, I promise. I need a little more time, Warmaster.
item.properties|f.exp_east_2f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.circuit_breaker_armor: Armor with a hacked elemental core aimed at resisting shock. However, this non-standard modification creates other elemental weaknesses.
town.properties|m.haven_desc: A peaceful town that is home to the Strangers. These salvagers offer the Spiral Knights sanctuary in return for the treasures that they acquire while investigating the Clockworks. Haven is also heavily populated with snipes, bulbous little birds with a curious means of locomotion.
mission.properties|b.first_contact: You have escaped your crash pod and reached a Rescue Camp just as the sun set across the alien landscape.  Using your comlink, it is now time to establish contact with Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.miracloth: A marvelous bolt of sublimely supple fabric.
mission.properties|b.work_idle_hands:
Devilites are a type of fiend that seem to have a very rigid corporate structure that governs their every action.  Recon Knights have discovered a series of devilite 'offices' throughout the Clockworks, typically found in the remains of an alien city. 

Analysis of the data collected from these offices indicates that devilite corporations are outsourced by gremlins in order to design and manage various projects that include weapons specifically engineered to target Spiral Knight squads. 

It's time these devilites were issued pink slips and their fiendish projects cancelled.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_10: Your sarcasm has been noted. \n\nNow then, about those empty sprite transport crates; we have confirmed foul play.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_giantswor: Etched within the side of the blade appears to be some kind of map of the stars.
mission.properties|m.elemental_my_dear_3: Magic?  What?  No, I'm talking about a psychic energy manipulation here, try and stay with me.  In any case,  elemental damage is produced by construct and gremlin family monsters.  Additionally, construct monsters tend to be weak to elemental damage themselves and gremlins to shadow damage. Keep this in mind. \n\nNow then, is there anything else you require?
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_3a: It's just a feeling really.  I hear it from some of the other knights as well\: a feeling like we... belong here, like maybe the crash occurred for a reason. \n\nBut that just can't be, right?  In any case, I'm rambling now.  Back to the mission\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_lab_by: We formed a barricade around the Artifact but it was overrun. I'm sorry...
pvp.properties|m.love_upload: Select the level type you'd like to upload.\nNote\: the file selection dialog will not be visible if you are playing full-screen.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_bl: A short torch filled with bizarre blue fire.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_12: I admire your courage but if initial reports of this construct monster are accurate, you'll need some additional help. I'll prepare a selection of battle sprites to be ready for bonding to you, {0}. We'll talk again once I've made the proper preparations.
conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: We were studying that meteorite when those lichens appeared\!
item.properties|f.hololite_helm: A bascinet favored for its versatility, safety, and ease of modding.
item.properties|f.shadow_key: A mysterious key that grants a party entrance to Shadow Lairs.  A Shadow Key is destroyed once used.
conversation.properties|m.casino_royalje: Three lichens slide into a room...
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_15: Well, that about covers the basics of the Bazaar.  It's a really fantastic place to find just about anything you need. \n\nDo you want me to go over it all again or do you think you've got it?
mission.properties|o.p_r9_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
item.properties|m.open_box_prompt: Prize Boxes contain random prizes inside.
conversation.properties|m.hav_entryknigh: Did you come from the chasm?  How?
item.properties|f.kat_claw_cowl: A magnificently crafted cowl said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Scraith, first to scale the walls of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Can't...go on...
item.properties|f.umbral_blaster: An enhanced shadow blaster designed to neutralize alien bioforms.
chat.properties|m.complain_self: You can't file a complaint about yourself.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roar: An unarmed, half-scale reproduction of the end product of Project Roarmulus. Without armaments, it's really only good for cheering up a dreary room.
support.properties|m.option_201_1: If you're convinced this qualified as spamming then click OK to file the complaint.
item.properties|f.dim_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within flickers like a tiny candle.
chat.properties|m.usage_force_bug_report: Usage\: /{0} <knight name> [description]\nForces a bug report to be submitted from the player's client.
item.properties|f.bottomless_stocking: An interdimensional tear in this fuzzy fabric sock swallows any item placed within it.  It even swallowed the stitches.
item.properties|f.arthro_pod: A streamlined helmet fashioned after the tough chitin of a beetle's carapace.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_1a: Come in, {0}\! I can't believe it\! I lost your signal completely when you entered the Core Terminal. What happened down there?
mission.properties|b.p_r3_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_5a: Done here?  Yes, though there's just one more thing I wish to add.
item.properties|f.quicksilver_helm: A fine helmet made out of what was once a Quicksilver.
item.properties|f.nodeslime_armor: A variegated veiling ward worn by vehemently venerated victors.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_1a: There you are, {0}\!  I was beginning to think you wouldn't show up\! \n\nOk, let's get to work securing this place.  But first, you'll need to equip that Proto Bomb I gave you.  Head over to the Arsenal Station behind me and equip it.
helptips.properties|m.tg_end: Hey, you made it\! That's just great, really. You just saved me a whole lot of paperwork, so thanks. Hope those retrodes weren't too much of a surprise. Head on over to the elevator and we'll call this expedition complete.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_shield: Up ahead is another great opportunity to use your shield. Remember, you can defend with your shield by pressing and holding the X key.
exchange.properties|m.crowns_tooltip: Go to the exchange where you can trade Crowns for Energy or Energy for Crowns.
item.properties|f.shock_raider_tunic: Anti-static fur lines this raiders coat.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_3: Do you have any more questions about feeding and caring for your sprite?
item.properties|f.azure_guardian_helm: A noble helmet reserved for the most senior members of the Spiral Order. The technique which weaves dragon scale seamlessly into the metal is a closely guarded secret.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_wandering_sn: A curious snipe that will explore its surroundings.
projectx.properties|m.cs_instructions: Please select the control layout you would like to use.
item.properties|f.vial_poison_super: An ornate glass vial containing debilitating toxins. It can be used to inflict enemies with Poison.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and wither the attack power of your foes\!
projectx.properties|i.full_inspect: Allow other knights to inspect all your equipped items.
helptips.properties|m.atg_togswitch: Switches can open AND close doors.
conversation.properties|m.rc_injured_b: One of those mechanical monsters got me.  The cursed thing's claws tore right through my armor\!

item.properties|f.freezing_vaporizer: An alchemical bomb that produces a cloud of ultra-low temperature mist.

By exploring these levels and transferring your combat data back to Spiral HQ, all knights would ultimately benefit from your dangerous experience. \n\nIt is highly recommended that you equip yourself with piercing resistant gear with piercing and shadow damage weapons\!
item.properties|f.fireburst_brandish: An upgraded Brandish infused with the elemental essence of fire.

item.properties|f.gram: An extraordinarily heavy sword whose weight will slow down even the swiftest of knights. That said, just imagine what it'll do to anything you hit with it...

conversation.properties|m.casino_royalje: I just flew in from Moorcroft and boy are my royal cores drained.
item.properties|f.spiral_scale_mail: Durable, light mail that provides protection from piercing attacks.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_overgrown_2: Looks like you know how to handle yourself. That's good, because the final area is just ahead.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
item.properties|f.furni_drawer_spiral: A small set of drawers filled with a variety of important items.
item.properties|m.add_more_success: Add more fire crystals to increase chance of forge success and bonuses\!
item.properties|f.frost_gun: A modified Proto Gun augmented with a low intensity, alchemical freezing agent.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: So, you have chosen the fiery drakon, battle sprite of those who prefer frontline, destructive combat? \n\nOnce you choose there is no going back\!
item.properties|f.dangerous_hound_coat: A battle-ravaged coat worn by the squad leaders of the Recon Rangers, nicknamed 'hounds.' The name was likely coined due to their incredible tracking abilities or perhaps the fact that they fight like wild dogs in battle.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_welcome: Welcome back to the Training Grounds. This last level will teach you the last few important things you will need to know as an explorer of the Clockworks. Head up the ramp and let's begin\!
dungeon.properties|m.jigsaw_valley_desc: Appearing to be sky islands ripped apart and put back together again as if it were a puzzle this world can sometimes be confusing to navigate. Unfortunately it seems to also be home to a host of mindless slimes and constructs who do not seem to mind its erratic layout.
mission.properties|o.vile_engine: Locate and destroy the bizarre slime generators below the lichen colony
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_6: Our geological research is ongoing, so there may yet be other fascinating uses for these strange and powerful minerals.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
guild.properties|e.cannot_invite_gm: You cannot invite a Game Master to join your guild.
item.properties|f.humbug_hat: A horrible hat worn by those who truly loathe the magic of Winterfest. The only possible explanation for this feeling is having a heart two sizes too small.
item.properties|d.furni_lay: USE\: Have a quick lie down.
item.properties|f.shadow_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who gain their powers using forbidden, dark arts.
conversation.properties|r.arc_mintut_6: Sounds great\! Thanks for the info\!
item.properties|f.furni_chair_spiralfiel: One standard-issue Spiral Order seating unit, capable of providing standard-issue comfort for one Spiral Knight.
item.properties|m.gsc_vip: Golden Slime Casino C.U.B.E. Club Membership
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
chat.properties|m.usage_fire: Usage\: /{0} name attr value attr value...\nFires an effect in the scene.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_7b: You may only select one ultimate skill per sprite skill so choose wisely\! Also note that selecting ultimate skills will further change the appearance of your sprite. \n\nWith all these options, your max level sprite is sure to look  and behave differently from the rest\!
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_5a: You don't understand, do you? You simply don't have a choice.
item.properties|f.padded_hunting_coat: An upgraded coat for hunters that is lined with soft, stimulating padding.
mission.properties|r.pioneers_11a: I'll do my best to recover the recon module and destroy the Snarbolax\!
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_keyboard_m: Keyboard used for targeting, attacking, movement, advanced commands,
chat.properties|m.usage_sgo: Usage\: /{0} scene name\nMoves to the named scene.
item.properties|f.draped_armor: A stylish suit of armor that adds a touch of class to battle.
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_4: I'm saying that we know this entire world isn't natural, and I for one don't believe that those hordes of miserable gremlins, no matter how industrious, could have built an entire world.  They had to have been aided by something far beyond their measure and perhaps whatever that is lies within the Core. \n\nThe same goes for the Alpha Squad.  They wouldn't just disappear, even within the furthest depths of the Clockworks.  They were our very best.  It was this Core that swallowed them.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: If only there were some way to open up those gates\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_supplies_a: Those supplies came just in time.
item.properties|f.dread_captain_cutlass: A custom curving cutter kept keen on careless castaways.
item.properties|f.token_forge: A small wisp of the essential spirit of technology and progress. It is of extreme value to the Spiral Order. Take it to the Token Trader in the Haven Bazaar\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_rhendon_1a: What the heck do you think this thing is, {0}?  Must be important if that Razwog guy got so bent out of shape when you snatched it. \n\nServes him right for trying to kill you and all\!
item.properties|f.slime_trinket: A curious circle coated with calcified slime.
dungeon.properties|m.revive_desc: Use a Spark of Life to regain full health and perform an ENERGY BLAST\!
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_11a: Well, that about covers the basics of the Bazaar.  It's a really fantastic place to find just about anything you need. \n\nDo you want me to go over it all again or do you think you've got it?
mission.properties|b.p_r3_mat_1: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_5a: Ok, practice a few bomb attacks and then head in there and destroy those monsters\!
guild.properties|log.mist_added: Deposited {0} energy to the energy well (new total\: {1}).
item.properties|f.grey_feather_cowl: A downy hood made for scholars who like to get out into the field. It's softer than the most luxurious of pillows, yet extraordinarily protective.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_6a: Bombs are special in that they have no standard attack.  A bomb can ONLY be used as a CHARGE ATTACK, so make sure to evade monsters while charging\! \n\nFeel free to give it a try.  Just remember to equip it at that arsenal station up ahead.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_mail: An impressive mail instilled with the might of Kat Clawers, the fearsome frontline fighters of the Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|o.go_shopping_b: Help out a knight in trouble
mission.properties|o.welcome_to_haven_b: Contact Intel Agent Kora via Comlink
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_1a: What's this? Another poor soul ripe for harvest by the Apocrea?
sprites.properties|d.golden_harness: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal piercing damage. \nCan be used by\: Seraphynx, Maskeraith
item.properties|f.power_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_pathfi: A hardened set of armor, reinforced with volcanic alloys, made to protect against the toastiest of monsters while exploring the unknown.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_5: Favored items can be alchemized using this very alchemy machine you see before you. All it takes is two of any one material and some minerals from the Clockworks. Easy\!
item.properties|f.toy_soldier_crown: A gleaming crown worn by elite Toyland units and those who smell faintly of varnish.
mission.properties|o.laboratory_visit: Visit the Lab and meet with Biotech Morlin
item.properties|f.guild_members_150: Allows your guild to recruit up to 150 members\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight5_1a: {0}, have you seen these minerals in your travels yet?  They're fascinating\! You should ask Chief Geo Knight Wegner about them.  I hear he's the expert on minerals\!
item.properties|f.grim_repeater: Used only by the most elite of the Spiral Knight rangers, this devilish machine gun earned its name from the incredible speed in which it hands out shadowy tickets to the afterlife.
mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.
support.properties|m.subheader_step201: Spamming is when someone repeats text or sends long lines of random characters with the sole purpose of annoying others because it fills up the chat screen so they can't chat normally.\n\nIt's important that you only file a spam complaint when the spamming was so bad that you couldn't chat with others. For example a couple of lines of a few characters, while not necessary perhaps, is not bad enough to file a complaint for. Also if the repeated lines are far between (like 10 seconds between) then it also won't prevent people from chatting, even if it may be annoying that they're just writing nonsense.
item.properties|f.super_poison_barrier: Surrounds you with potent toxic orbs that can cripple hostiles
exchange.properties|m.billing_declined: Your card has been declined. Please check that the information you have entered is correct.
item.properties|f.hazardous_brigandine: Padded armor that seems to emphasize the high mortality rate of the elite Scarlet Scouts. Scarlet Scouts need to travel light and fast in order to stay ahead of lesser skilled squads.
monster.properties|m.punkin_intro_2: What does the Punkin King have for thee...?
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
item.properties|f.confetti_slime: When thrown, it looks like little pink jelly cubes.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_d: This is my first expedition into the Clockworks\!
mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_2a: An official order from Herex, the Whispering Venom\: \n\nProduction of Compound 42 is to cease immediately.  While a formidable poison and no doubt useful in achieving a... 'higher' power amongst the Order, it seems to have formed an intelligence well beyond the scope of a standard bio-toxin.
social.properties|m.confirm_unfriend: Are you sure you no longer want to be friends with {0}?
item.properties|f.volt_breaker_shield: A Circuit Breaker Shield modified for increased protection against shock.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_vana: The sinister mask formerly worn by Vanaduke, Lord of the Firestorm Citadel. It's far too big for a knight to wear.
item.properties|f.enamorock: A strange stone that makes you have warm and fuzzy feelings inside just by holding it.
mission.properties|b.alchemy_mastery: Bosco in the Haven Bazaar has more information for you regarding the highest level of alchemy available to you.  Mastery level alchemy will be instrumental in your survival as you attempt to reach the Core of the Clockworks.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_5a: Along the north wall here we have all sorts of blocks, switches, doors, and buttons from the Clockworks. If you want to overcome the devious and deadly mechanisms down there I suggest you become familiar with how these work\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_technician_: According to these scans there should be some kind of power source in the depths below the camp, but it's being diverted somehow...
mission.properties|b.the_gauntlet: One final battle stands in your way before reaching the Firestorm Citadel. Thought to be devised by Lord Vanaduke himself, this unrelenting gauntlet is teeming with all manners of dark creatures and culminates in a nightmarish battle arena that must be conquered in order to gain access to the gates of the Firestorm Citadel. \n\nThis mission will take everything you've got and requires a full arsenal of powerful weapons and gear.  If Lord Vanaduke is testing you, give him the fight that he's asking for and show him what a true Champion can do\!
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
chat.properties|m.usage_advance: Usage\: /{0} [number of floors]\nAdvances the party ahead one or more floors.
mission.properties|o.rescues_and_recycli: Shut down the gremlin deconstruction site and rescue the captive knights
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_2: Thank you for defeating the Snarbolax. Too many of our squires met an early end because of that beast. I can rest easier knowing that threat is now behind us. \n\nI look forward to hearing about your future exploits, Soldier\!
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Herex slipped away\! I lost sight of him as things went black. It felt like a thousand hands were pulling us away. As if something didn't want us to follow.
item.properties|m.item_permanent: This item cannot be sold or traded.\n
item.properties|f.polar_twilight_warden_: An insulated coat that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The fur-lined armor plating makes it ideal for hours of scanning the horizon during polar twilight.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_securi: Please check that the CVC or CVV security code is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
help.properties|m.support_4: To report a bug in the game, press F2. Keep in mind that bug reports are not answered, but they include non-personal debug information that helps track down the root of the problem. If you need assistance from a GM, please file an in-game support request.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_6a: I'm curious... what do you think is behind their masks? Wait, no, I don't want to know.
mission.properties|o.alchemy_mastery: Discover the potential of master level alchemy
item.properties|d.energy_well: USE\: An energy bank for use by guild members.
conversation.properties|t.af_chat_beast_: Maybe they want to play catch?
mission.properties|o.spark_roar: Prove your valor against a legion of elite elemental monsters
item.properties|f.exp_west_5f: An expansion that adds two rooms to the western side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.angelic_helmet: A beautiful costume designed exclusively for great heads.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_3a: Once again the sprites have changed and this time they're really creeping me out\!
item.properties|m.add_more_bonuses: Add more fire crystals to unlock chances for bonuses\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_polar: Contains various unique costumes and accessories popular in the polar regions. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
helptips.properties|m.statue_secret: Heavy statues can be lifted and placed on pressure pads to reveal secrets and treasures\!
mission.properties|o.p_apocrea_r9: Investigate the area of the Clockworks where several knights have gone missing.

mission.properties|r.arc_mintut_6: Sounds great\! Thanks for the info\!
item.properties|f.justifier_hat: A finely-made hat for handgun experts who think nothing of spending a few crowns more on a high-quality piece of gear.
logon.properties|m.non_public_server: The game is not currently open to the public.
item.properties|f.moonstone: A fabled mineral of a brilliant, blue color said to contain the knowledge and origins of all worlds.
item.properties|f.snarbolax_cap: A shadowy cap made from the hide of a sinister Snarbolax.  Even looking at it too closely is dangerous.
item.properties|f.force_buckler: A Proto Shield modified to resist stunning impacts.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
mission.properties|r.darkest_depths_5a: Thanks Kora.  I'll do my best.
helptips.properties|m.atg_eblocks: EXPLOSIVE BLOCKS will cause damage to anything around them if hit.
pvp.properties|m.name: Name
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The drakon is a battle sprite that embodies fiery destruction. Its skills focus on direct assault\: firebolt creates an explosive projectile, flame barrier surrounds its knight with protective fireballs, and firestorm creates a massive wave of flames. \n\nThe drakon is best suited for fearless knights who prefer frontline, destructive combat.
mission.properties|o.great_escape: Infiltrate the gremlin prison, free the captured Knights and stage an escape
uplink.properties|i.crystal: The amount of energy to attach.
item.properties|f.skelly_shield: A bedeviled buckler best used for blocking bad energy.
item.properties|f.tailed_helm: An expressive helm proving that two plumes are always better than one.
item.properties|f.avenger: A holy sword created in another time to arm knights who fought against the legions of the Underworld.
projectx.properties|m.love_opt_in_notice:
By enabling this option, you will gain access to knight-created arenas.
You can browse, test, and play community-made content, as well as upload your own.

All arenas are subject to approval by coliseum crew before becoming part of the playable pool.

helptips.properties|m.clockwork_tunnels: There are strange sounds and energies emanating from the Clockworks. Delve deep and unravel its mysteries but be careful not to get caught in the mechanisms.
auction.properties|m.search_ready: Press 'Search' to execute your current search query.
item.properties|f.cobalt_helm: A high-performance helmet of the Spiral Order suitable for any adventure.
mission.properties|b.crossing_chasm: In order to reach Spiral HQ's base of operations in Haven you will need to descend into the Clockworks and cross a massive chasm.  The journey will be a dangerous one and it is recommended that you have everything you need before departing. \n\nCompleting this mission will leave the Rescue Camp behind you.
item.properties|f.flare_popper: While never intended to be used in a party, Recon Rangers like to shoot signal flares into the air to celebrate missions where everyone comes back alive. Sadly, any Ranger will tell you that far too few of them are ever sent burning into the sky.
item.properties|f.swift_flourish: An upgraded Flourish for knights who make a point of dispatching opponents with a bit of flair.
item.properties|f.indestructible_giftwra: Presents wrapped with this Grinchlin gag can never be opened again. Leave it to Grinchlins to ruin complimentary gift wrapping services for everyone.
item.properties|f.spiral_cloak: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.furni_counter_spiral: A modular piece of counter that can be combined in infinite ways. Always be careful when working with infinity.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_2_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 3 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
item.properties|f.dragon_scale_mail: Mythical armor crafted from the scales of a creature of legend.
projectx.properties|m.enqueued: Please be patient; we are currently experiencing high server load.
