mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_4: Mount Grinchlin is an oppressive environment and few knights likely have the fortitude to reach its summit. If you feel things getting too rough, take the exit\! Otherwise you risk losing everything\!
mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_1: No problem, from the top then...
shop.properties|m.cart_costume_own: Warning\! You already own this exact costume.
conversation.properties|m.npc_campguard_: I'm here keeping watch.  You never know when monsters might attack.
item.properties|f.prize_box_lucky: Contains various lucky and rare items. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_3a: Wow, it sounds like you've already had quite the adventure, {0}\!  Spiral HQ will most certainly be interested in that artifact you recovered.  It's remarkable that you were able to face off against a gremlin in the Clockworks and survive.
pvp.properties|m.cancelled: All pending coliseum games were cancelled. Please sign up again.
item.properties|f.sacred_keeper_armor: A cerulean suit of armor for those who want to wreck some robos.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research
mission.properties|b.p_r4_weap_2: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
item.properties|f.stoic_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you sense the quiet passing of the wind and can call upon the rumbling storm that follows.
item.properties|f.brute_jelly_shield: A thick shield made from the remains of particularly ill-mannered slimes. It is durable, light, and delightfully berry-flavored.
item.properties|f.bolted_blade: An upgraded Proto Sword reinforced with bronze bolts scavenged from the Clockworks.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We wouldn't have made it past that artillery without your help\!
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
helptips.properties|m.atg_statustraps: Beware\!  Some traps can cause damage AND inflict harmful status effects.
item.properties|f.auto_turret_kit: Deploys an auto turret that fires at nearby hostiles
mission.properties|m.legion_almire_3a: Now only death and smoke hang in the air, even from these great heights. And the fires; the unnatural fires that seem to burn eternal, the fires that turn even the most pious men into horrible nightmares, I know that these fires shall soon take me as well. \n\nI will not give my former Lord the gift of my own life.  It is not his to take, to twist. This shall be my final order.  This shall be my Justice.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_5a: I'd like to go over your energy tutorial one more time.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_9b: (There is no trace of the gremlin or the Artifact.  This gremlin seems very adept at covering his tracks.)
item.properties|f.riftlocker: A deadly handgun said to be capable of sundering heavy armor with a single shot. These firearms proved instrumental during the siege of Isora in breaking through the war machines of the Morai.
item.properties|f.scary_skelly_shield: A small, spooky shield to safeguard you from shadow.
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_07: Uh-oh\! The truck have started to move\!
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_mail: An impressive mail instilled with the might of Kat Hissers, the unstable bombers of the Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_b_: You made it, {0}\!  I'm happy to see you arrive here in Haven safe and sound.  I'll confirm with Spiral HQ that you will now be undertaking missions in Haven. \n\nTo start, I've issued you a few missions that will help get you acclimated with all that Haven has to offer.  Be sure to say hello to the Strangers as you begin exploring.
item.properties|f.maskeraith_pod: A sprite pod containing a level 1 Maskeraith Battle Sprite. \n\nThe Maskeraith is a battle sprite that embodies the shadows. Its skills focus on subterfuge and deadly toxins.
item.properties|f.gm_helmet: An impressive indigo helmet that's the indisputable indication of one of the Spiral Order's incredible Game Masters.
item.properties|f.pollinator: A rare, advanced handgun produced by biotechs with captured Gremlin technology. It fires pollen particles that cling to the enemy, causing explosive damage and also the sniffles.
item.properties|f.prize_box_gremlin: Contains various unique costumes and items crafted by Gremlins. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
social.properties|m.earned_crowns: become the new Crown King, having earned {0} crowns in the past 7 days\!
item.properties|f.volcanic_pepperbox: When encamped in dangerous territory, the Volcanic Pepperbox is perfect for roasting both marshmallows and enemies.
item.properties|f.virulent_seedling: This small, dangerous plant has been weaponized by biotechs so that it spreads a cloud of toxic spores on detonation. Don't let the size fool you, it packs several kiloaudreys of power.
conversation.properties|r.rc_instruct_3b: Thanks for the information, I'll be off now.
conversation.properties|m.npc_techknight: Good data is like a good pudding, you can never have too much of it.
mission.properties|o.new_chapter: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
mission.properties|o.p_r3_mat_0: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: The Alpha Squad's sacrifice will not be in vain. I will immediately order our forces to undertake special Operations Missions all over Cradle. If there are forces trying to free The Swarm, we'll have to stop them.
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_2d: Actually, I have to run. Maybe some other time...
logon.properties|m.machine_tainted: This computer has been used by a banned account and cannot be used to create new accounts.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_9a: Handy, I'll keep it in mind.  What else you got?
mission.properties|r.another_trace_3a: You can count on me, Kora.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_surviv: The watcher of the Wildwoods...the horrible Snarbolax\!
item.properties|f.dark_matter: A fabled mineral dark and ominous in color said to contain the essences of both chaos and nothingness.
item.properties|m.hatch_egg_prompt: The Battle Sprite inside will bind to you upon opening.
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_constr: I need your clothes, your boots and your motorcycle.
item.properties|f.quilted_hunting_coat: A flexible coat lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. It smells musty.
mission.properties|r.go_shopping_b_2a: Sure, let's head to the bazaar.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_16: Another tour? No problem, follow me\!
pvp.properties|m.love_reupload: Uploading a new file for the selected level.
item.properties|f.guild_members_100: Allows your guild to recruit up to 100 members\!
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_4: Visit the Hall of Heroes wearing 5 Star gear and receive certification
projectx.properties|e.no_lead_node: Service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
mission.properties|o.return_of_ur: Stop the devilites from summoning an army of nightmarish trojan warriors
item.properties|f.grey_feather_mantle: A cloak for renowned Owlite scholars, this feathery frock is filled with the wisdom of the ages... and is super soft\!
item.properties|f.sunset_stetson: A sturdy hat for gunslingers that shouldn't cost you much more than a fistful of crowns.
item.properties|f.graviton_charge: A small explosive charge with mysterious origins. It is capable of generating a vortex of crushing gravity.
item.properties|f.jelly_shield: A strange looking shield created from jelly matter. Like many slime monsters themselves, it provides the user with exceptional defense against piercing damage.
item.properties|f.potocrowns: An unlucky thing for your foes to find, it explodes in a painful blow.
item.properties|f.ascended_calibur: Made of a rare alloy of sun silver, knights talented enough to possess Caliburs as fine as this one typically bond with and name their blades.
item.properties|f.gh_env_rain_shower: The perfect environment for Guild Halls without fire insurance or whose members are simply too lazy to ever water their plants.
uplink.properties|e.unvalidated: Your email address has not been validated. An email has been sent. Please follow the link in the email and once validated, return here and try again.
item.properties|f.stagger_storm: Though it was originally developed by the Spiral Order to harmlessly subdue dangerous species, how you deal with foes unfortunate enough to be caught in the storm is entirely up to you.
lottery.properties|m.lottery_award: Congratulations to {0} for winning {1} in the Birdsong Trading Co. giveaway\!
conversation.properties|m.hunter_2a: Smashing\! Then perhaps you and your mates will be of service to this lodge. You see, the alchemy machine you see before you can craft magnificent monster trophies for your Guild Hall. \n\nThe alchemy machines uses materials and crowns from your Guild Treasury and deposits the results into the Guild Treasury as well.
item.properties|f.prize_box_electric: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in an Electric style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.valestone_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of moonstone.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_weap_3: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
conversation.properties|r.sl_guard_3: I'll get a Shadow Key and start investigating\!
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r3: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
mission.properties|o.guardians_of_cradle: Join Spiral HQ and discuss what to do next
item.properties|f.replica_mask: A plastic {0} mask made to celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival. It's not well made and eventually falls apart.
mission.properties|r.pioneers_4a: Tell me about Squad Leader Euclid.
item.properties|f.defender: A durable, high quality shield of the Spiral Order that is suitable for any adventure.
social.properties|m.friend_party_full: Oops\! {0}'s party is no longer accepting new members.
item.properties|f.salamander_mask: A mask crafted from the hide of a Salamander.
item.properties|f.sacred_guerrilla_armor: A sturdy suit of armor for those who want to bring down some beasts.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_2: During your travels in the Clockworks you will encounter five special minerals\: crimsonite, moonstone, valestone, luminite and dark matter.
sprites.properties|d.high_heat: Increases the offensive power of the flame barrier.
item.properties|f.jelly_mail: A squishy set of armor made from slippery slimes that simply oozes with style.
mission.properties|b.shopping_again: Bechamel has already given you a tour of the Haven Bazaar that included where to acquire new weapons, armor and recipes.  Now it's time to pay him another visit and learn about some of the more advanced services the Bazaar offers. \n\nYou will pay a visit to Punch and Vise, Brinks and even visit Bechamel's own shop\!
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r6: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_7a: Indeed.  Though their cellular identity is still wholly that of a battle sprite.  My hypothesis is that somehow they rapidly evolved to survive in their new environment, but how?  Our technology could never do something like that...
conversation.properties|r.tortodrone_hav: Thanks for the tip\! I'll track down those glyphs.
social.properties|m.trader_busy: Oops\! That player is otherwise occupied.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Get inside, use the elevator...blow up whatever is controlling those cannons\!
logon.properties|m.too_many_attempts: You have made too many login attempts. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.
mission.properties|r.time_enough_at_last: Yes, you must be Edger.  Your squadmates requested that I come find you.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_8a: Parma was the youngest of the bunch, a very talented Recon, but with little combat experience.  She and I went to academy together and I can remember the day when the simulator technicians had thought their program was busted due to Parma's performance.  She actually apologized\! \n\nBut still, I'm worried about her.  From the reports that I've read, the Clockworks are unlike anything we've ever encountered.  I only hope that as she keeps them informed of what's ahead, that they will watch her back.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_6a: This is astounding\! The battle sprites you recovered from the Sunset Steppes have somehow morphed into a new entity\!
mission.properties|b.search_continues: Lieutenant Vaelyn would like to thank you for opening up a path to the Core and allowing her to set up an on-site research base.
conversation.properties|m.atg_guard: Greetings\!  Beyond this door you will find the advanced training hall. As a Spiral Knight, you are free to use it to practice your skills and learn more about the Clockworks.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_cj_keyboar: Keyboard used for targeting, attacking, movement, advanced commands,
item.properties|f.frenzy_rider_mantle: A legendary suit of armor thought to be worn by a god who used frenzy to carve whole worlds from stone.
conversation.properties|m.af_hungry: I could sure go for a snack\!
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of slime and beast family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions.  He has specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'very informative lecture' that was given to you 'free of charge' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
conversation.properties|m.final_test_kni: I see.  This will be very interesting information for Spiral HQ.  Our base camp in Haven is just up ahead.  Head on up the elevator and meet the other Knights who survived the crash like yourself. The techs in the Lab will be eager to study that artifact.  They'll see to it once you get to Haven. \n\nDon't worry about the others in the Rescue Camp.  Thanks to you, we have a functioning elevator system to reach them.  You've saved them all\!
item.properties|f.feral_shell: A shield alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. Even the sharpest wolver claws merely glance off this compact carapace.
mission.properties|r.apocrea_1_1a: What is this place and what are you talking about?
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_9a: Okay then, let's start from the top.
item.properties|f.prize_box_volcanic: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Volcanic style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.elite_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. Orbs like these are used by elite knights to craft items of exceptional quality and power.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
logon.properties|m.steam_invalid_ticket: Invalid Steam UserID Ticket. Try logging out, quitting Steam completely and trying again.
item.properties|f.blight_needle: It's a proven fact that even the most virulent of toxins is a lot more contagious if it's fired indiscriminately over a large area.
conversation.properties|r.atg_guard: Thanks\! I'll go see what's inside.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_bouncer: Only C.U.B.E. Club members may access the High Wobbler Lounge.
monster.properties|m.vanaduke_defeated: We shall never fall\! We shall... never...
mission.properties|b.p_apocrea_r6: Several capable knights have gone missing in a seemingly normal area of the Clockwork Tunnels. Spiral HQ suspects foul play and has assigned you to investigate the level.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_c: Can you believe this?  This entire chasm is filled with a giant machine of some kind.  It seems to go down forever. \n\nI wonder if the entire planet is like this?
item.properties|m.item_locked: This item is bound to you.\n
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r3: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
conversation.properties|r.hunter_1a: I've seen my share of danger, and I like it.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_6a: Good luck to you. Travel swiftly and avoid their grasp.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_3a: Amazing that after all this time we didn't know the truth. I mean, we've suspected for a while now that this planet was some kind of prison but who could have guessed that this 'Swarm' was just waiting for someone to stumble across the Core and free it?
item.properties|f.rename_guild: Allows you to choose a new name for your guild. This item can only be used by a Guildmaster and is destroyed once used.
item.properties|f.mining_hat: A sturdy, old helmet once used to dig for precious minerals. It offers a little more defense than a Spiral Helm.
mission.properties|b.pioneers: After the crash of the Skylark, Captain Ozlo selected an elite squad of Spiral Knights to be the first to enter the Clockworks.  They were never seen again.  Contact Intel Agent Kora and learn how you will play a role in solving this mystery.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_169085: Defeat Lord Vanaduke in the heart of the Firestorm Citadel.
mission.properties|r.becoming_champion_1: I'll fight to the very end, Lieutenant.  I know what's at stake.
conversation.properties|m.npc_minerknigh: They say these minerals power every gate in the Arcade.
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_sig: 'Through my eyes you will see the path to ages. Pure is my gaze, free from the lies of reality.'
conversation.properties|m.lab_harness_1a: I'm Riley, Morlin's assistant.  I'm in the process of inventing a way to enhance our battle sprites even further.  Check back later once you've acquired a permanently-bonded sprite.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 2 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_3a: No, you won't be able to return. Once you reach Haven your training is complete and your new objective will be to aid the Spiral Knights who are now based in Haven.
item.properties|f.down_puffer: A puffy, downy jacket. Superior insulation is provided by snipe down feathers. (No snipes were harmed making this jacket, feathers were gathered non-intrusively from free-roaming snipes.)
mission.properties|m.advanced_alchemy_1a: We meet again, {0}.  Spiral HQ has asked me to introduce you to some advanced alchemy.  Don't worry, this won't take long.  I've got an old mecha knight to work on anyway.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_12a: Hmm, most of our sensor equipment seems to have been damaged.  It might take some time to get things working to the point where I can track down the Artifact.  While we work on that, you should get in contact with one of our Biotechs, Hahn.  He's a little rough around the edges, but he can help you prepare for the challenges you'll likely face. \n\nI'll contact you later as soon as I have my tracking equipment back online\!
item.properties|f.quilted_demo_suit: A suit snugly lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. It smells a bit sweaty.
item.properties|f.furni_shelf_manor_book: An unassuming shelf filled unworldly tomes of unspeakable power.
item.properties|f.polar_night_wolf_hood: A warm hood, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending night patrols.
projectx.properties|m.opening_billing_ur: Opening energy depot site in your web browser...
projectx.properties|e.need_higher_rank: Must be Rank {0} to level up\!
sprites.properties|d.golden_harness_adv: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal piercing damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 5% \nCan be used by\: Seraphynx, Maskeraith
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_1: Hello. I'm Wegner, Chief Geo Knight of the Skylark and head of geological studies within the Clockworks.
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r9: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.raging_avenger_helm: A helm worn by heavenly guardians who watch over a kingdom hidden atop a magma-covered mountain.
pvp.properties|m.coins_awarded_subject: Krogmo Coins earned in The Coliseum\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_campguard_: Welcome to our camp\! Have a seat by the campfire if you want a little break.
mission.properties|o.rotting_metropolis: Discover the fate of the lost squad in the toxic city
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_3: That's exactly right\! The Core of the Clockworks could very well contain the energy source we need to create a new power source for the Skylark and restore it to operational condition. There's only one problem- the Clockworks themselves seem to be built like some kind of crazy death trap.\n\nReaching the Core is not going to be easy...
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_4a: Vatel here will sell you a selection of recipes as well as personal color changers and other items.
item.properties|f.gremlin_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a gremlin.  It's so convincing, you just might receive an invitation to the Colony\!
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_3a: Energy is a very special power that is constantly emanating from the core of this world. It is totally stable and will never be lost unless traded or spent. (You can see how much energy you have on the energy module in your arsenal.)
conversation.properties|m.rescue_door_sk: Great timing\! You're free and clear. Good luck\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_11: A recon squad has reported a large construct monster the likes of which we've never seen before making off with several battle sprites. We believe the gremlins to be behind it all.
guild.properties|m.confirm_demote: Are you sure you want to demote {0} to {1}?
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
sprites.properties|d.drakon: The drakon is a battle sprite that embodies fiery destruction. Its skills focus on raw, offensive power.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_3a: Let's put it to good use right away. \n\nYou can accept Missions by clicking the 'Mission' button at the top of the screen and accept the mission I've given you.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_4a: (Kora pauses) \n\nSpeak of the devil, Rhendon is calling now; says it's urgent. Patching him through...
chat.properties|m.usage_zone: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message on the zone channel.
item.properties|f.prize_box_surprise: Contains a randomly chosen Prize Box in celebration of the Spiral Order's anniversary on Cradle.  No key required to open.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_7: On very rare occasions I've found jellies that haven't attacked us on sight. I'm removing the barbs off this one now. They're kind of cute when they aren't trying to impale you\!
helptips.properties|m.atg_pplate: Pick up and place a STATUE on a PRESSURE PLATE to keep doors open.
item.properties|f.arcana: An exceptional handgun that fires powerful, elemental shots that many Spiral Knights refer to as 'magic missiles.'
item.properties|f.furni_spiralorder_sund: Supply canisters containing everything a Spiral Knight needs to get going in the morning.
item.properties|f.monster_spike: A shimmering accretion found during energy storms. Clockworks creatures go wild for it.
mission.properties|r.search_continues_4a: What will you do now, Lieutenant?
item.properties|f.crystal_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in an alloy of Moonstone and Valestone. Its soothing shade of cerulean has been clinically proven to both calm knights and annihilate the undead.
conversation.properties|r.mission_crimso: Thanks for the intel. I'll check it out.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_6: Many recipes require an equip-able, leveled item.  These are called 'special items' in a recipe and you are free to select the special item you wish, provided it's the correct item. \n\nThis is useful if the recipe calls for an item that you have two copies of, but one is superior.
conversation.properties|r.almire_histori: What have you learned about Almire?
mission.properties|m.built_to_destroy_2a:
Crimson Order Directives\: 

- It is the DUTY of every Gremlin to repel the metal intruders\! 

- Every Gremlin must work to destroy Haven. Cradle belongs us\! 

- Every Gremlin must remain LOYAL to King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order. The Iron Law must be obeyed\!
item.properties|f.wolver_mask: A simple mask made from wolver pelt.
item.properties|f.book_of_dark_rituals: An ancient grimoire filled with unspeakable eldritch rites. Just like any cursed tome, there is likely some twisted individual out there who wants it for extremely nefarious purposes. Trade with caution.
social.properties|m.invite_persona: Select the player you wish to invite\:
sprites.properties|d.enduring_light: Increases the duration of the ray of light.
exchange.properties|m.mobile_tooltip: Opens a page in your browser where you can buy Energy with your mobile phone.
support.properties|m.subheader_step2: We have saved the chat log already waiting to be added to the complaint, so there is no need to hurry from here. Please carefully choose the correct option matching what the player did\:
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_10: Congratulations {0}.  The Geo Knights owe a great deal to your efforts.
item.properties|f.gremlin_suit: A special suit tailored by a gremlin's touch to fit the frame of a knight. It protects the wearer while providing a full range of motion for thwacking, knocking, or mending.
item.properties|f.elemental_cloak: A fine robe with numerous forms of elemental protection woven right into the fabric.
item.properties|f.chilling_duelist: Start settling disputes at the crack of dawn with this cold, custom handgun.
item.properties|f.red_shard: A shard of Crimsonite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
dungeon.properties|m.firestorm_citadel_d: All that remains of the once great kingdom of Almire, the Firestorm Citadel houses the legions of lost souls burning in the flames of a forgotten war, endlessly rekindled by the twisted spirit of their former lord.
chat.properties|m.usage_cry: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nCause your knight to cry.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r4: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
auction.properties|m.featured: Featured auctions are held by the Haven Treasury. \n\nThey often contain rare, unique or limited time items.
item.properties|f.obsidian_obstacle: A baleful shield of obelisk fragments bound by Apocrean ritual. Every time the fragments align, dark memories echo in your mind.
item.properties|f.moonstone_shard: A shard of Moonstone that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
item.properties|f.jelly_glue: A viscous compound developed by Biotechs to allow for the study of slime creatures. When mixed with slime and jelly matter, it allows for reshaping without losing its form. Though reserved for scientific purposes, the process is generally regarded as 'super fun.'
pvp.properties|m.love_reupload_layer: Uploading a new file for the selected level. Other layers may be updated\!
sprites.properties|d.dark_harness: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal shadow damage. \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Maskeraith
item.properties|f.deadly_dark_matter_bom: A large chunk of Dark Matter primed with a potent explosive. This bomb would be in stark violation of the Spiral Order's safety handbook if they hadn't lost the last copy in the crash.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_mouse_move: Keyboard used for advanced commands, quickslots and chat
item.properties|f.confetti_summer: When thrown, this summer confetti makes you feel all warm inside.
mission.properties|b.whipping_mishandlin: After Recon Knights discovered a fiendish city known as Sol' Fork, Spiral HQ deployed a research team to station itself in the heart of the city and study the devilites within.  Their findings have become the basis for our understanding of devilite culture and their motives for working with gremlins. \n\nThis research team is in desperate need of supplies in order to maintain working on-site.  It would be of great help to Spiral HQ's continued research to have a squad enter the city and deliver the necessary supplies.
item.properties|f.gran_faust: An upgraded Faust forged from pristine-quality shadow steel. Its charge attacks are powerful enough to curse its wielder, but that hasn't stopped Devilites from treasuring these rare blades even more highly than their meager vacation time.
auction.properties|e.no_preview: Sorry, this item cannot be previewed with your current equipment.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft1_r4: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
mission.properties|o.another_trace: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
auction.properties|e.auction_bid: The auction may not be cancelled, it already has a bid.
mission.properties|b.ending_in_fire: A strange energy anomaly has been been detected in the levels just above the Core.  Contact Intel Agent Kora for details.
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_1a: Congratulations {0}\!  Knight Elite huh?  Wow, you must be proud\!
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r4: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_11a: I'd like you to give me the tour once more.
item.properties|f.pierce_blaster: An enhanced blaster modified to fire piercing rounds.
item.properties|f.sinister_skelly_suit: A bony barrier that throbs with malevolence. Anyone skeptical of this suit's power deserves a good ribbing.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_mat_234: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
chat.properties|m.usage_kick: Usage\: /{0} player name\nKicks a player offline.
item.properties|f.prisma_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful prisma bullets that split multiple times on impact.
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_2: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 2 star item.
help.properties|m.clockworks_2: The depths below Haven can be classified into three progressively challenging Tiers. Be sure to equip Tier-appropriate gear when venturing forth, and remember\: the greatest treasures the Clockworks have to offer are far underground near the planet's Core, so delve deep\!
item.properties|m.use_harness: Use this item to add the {0} as an available harness for your battle sprites? \n\nOnce installed, all sprites capable of using this harness can select it via your sprite manager. This action cannot be undone.
item.properties|f.nightshade: A hazardous herb that's bad for most beasts, but tasty to a teeming variety of toxic creatures.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I'm not sure, tell me again about the battle sprites.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Trespassers within my Arsenal?  I'll see to it you go... quietly.
projectx.properties|m.confirm_return: Are you sure you want to return to {0}?
item.properties|f.celestial_saber: A special saber said to resemble Isoran spacefarers of old as they sliced across the night sky. With this equipped, your foes are sure to see stars.
projectx.properties|m.achievement_obsole: Legacy\: Can no longer be achieved.
item.properties|f.battle_chef_hat: A hat worn by the knights who work in the Skylark's galley. Not to be trifled with, these chefs are blade masters on and off the battlefield.
item.properties|f.magic_hood: An enchanting hood for knights who dabble in divination and contemplate conjuring.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_5: It will take a little time to get all of our equipment fully working again.
conversation.properties|m.barracks_boost: Want to earn even more Krogmo Coins with every match?
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_battlesta: An elegant display commemorating a knight's promotion to the rank of Champion.
item.properties|f.furni_chair_manor: An exquisite chair, cunningly crafted for cozy comfort.
item.properties|f.gremlonium: A highly advanced compound created by gremlin engineers to power their most devious machines.  It constantly emits an unsettling hissing sound.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft1_r9: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
mission.properties|o.p_r7_mat_234: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.cooling_cell: A small device used in complex machines to keep them from overheating. Also handy to keep in your pockets on hot summer days.
item.properties|f.grim_buster: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. Shadows seem to seep from the barrel whenever it is brought to bear.
item.properties|f.luminite_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of luminite.
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_2: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This particular model is a more stable version that blew up gremlin test subjects far fewer times than the prototype.
mission.properties|b.breaking_in_recruit: After braving the depths of Firestorm Citadel, Spiral HQ believes you have earned a much deserved break. As a newly anointed Vanguard of the Spiral Knights, Lieutenant Feron believes you are the perfect candidate for training a group of raw recruits how to survive the dangers of this world. Your mission is to link up with the recruits on the surface of Cradle and help them survive their first tour of duty.
item.properties|f.nitronome: An advanced explosive issued to only the most elite Spiral Knight grenadiers. It's made from a synthetic substance that ticks ominously even when unarmed.
mission.properties|m.true_champion_2a: Well, as far as I'm concerned this is only the beginning for you, {0}.  You are a true Champion of the Spiral Knights.  And since I haven't been reassigned, I suppose it's just the beginning for 'us' as well\!
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_1_1: Well met, {0}\! Glad to see Spiral HQ sent us some reinforcements, and not a moment too soon\! Our backs are against the wall and we need your help\!
uplink.properties|m.firestorm_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, at your current depth establishing communications is difficult- I hope you receive this message.  You currently stand in the Firestorm Citadel, some kind of ancient fortress that this planet apparently like to collect.  It is an incredibly hostile region of the Clockworks, you will not last long without the right gear and a talented squad. 

We have detected a faint signal that indicates some kind of artifact of the Alpha Squad's expedition is located within the throne room of this citadel.  We need you to recover this artifact- it could be a valuable clue for discovering their current whereabouts. 

I won't lie to you, no squad that has taken this mission has managed to return from the citadel.  As you have no doubt seen, the place burns with an unnatural fire and a legion of similarly unnatural horrors roam every hall.  Now may be a good time to turn back and craft some fire-resistant gear.  A trial by fire will only get you burned. 

Good luck\!
chat.properties|m.usage_party: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message to all party members.
helptips.properties|m.branch_battle_warn: Two paths lie before you. Which one will you take?
helptips.properties|m.candlestick_keep: Beware the horrible Grimalkins that lurk in the dark\!  These cursed wraiths cannot be destroyed and the only thing they truly fear is the light of the enchanted candles.  Light them with embers and take refuge in their shining embrace.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_mat_01: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_b_1a: Hi there {0}\!  Wow, you've made Soldier already?  You're really moving up fast in the ranks. \n\nAnyway, I'm Bechamel, and I'm here to give you a tour of some of the Bazaar's more advanced services. To start, do you want to learn how to even further power up that gear of yours?
mission.properties|r.collector_prisoner_: Yes, but can you tell me what happened?
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
helptips.properties|m.zone: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to exit current zone.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Hello {0}, it seems you had few problems with the oozing hordes and their like which can no doubt be chalked up to a good education on their behaviors prior to the mission.
logon.properties|m.tos_1: By logging on, you acknowledge and accept the
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_14: You can find accessory tickets inside lockboxes or at the Auction House if another Knight happens to be selling them.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_mat_123: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.owlite_wand: They say the wand chooses the wizard, so don't let this one see your cute friend.
mission.properties|m.built_to_destroy_1a: "The Nine see all, hear all. Obey the Iron Law."
item.properties|f.owlite_shield: A wooden ward carved with the crude image of a long-lost Owlite.
item.properties|f.ash_tail_coat: This well-made hide coat is self-heating, protecting the wearer from freeze attacks. The secret? A tiny pinch of blaze pepper.
item.properties|f.fused_demo_suit: An upgraded Demo Suit fused dangerously with the unstable core from a powerful Blast Cube. Even still, you should feel a lot safer wearing this.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_2b: What sort of challenges await me in the final gate?
mission.properties|b.oilers_in_boilers:
A boiler room beneath Moorcroft Manor has been overrun by a legion of oily slimes known as 'oilers' that seem to enjoy fiery conditions.  This could prove disastrous for any levels in close proximity should the slimes enter the boilers and cause an explosion. 

Moorcroft Manor serves as an invaluable connection point into Tier 2 and its departed residents have been the most gracious of hosts.  It is in Spiral HQ's best interest to send a squad in to deal with the smoldering slimes before they create a firestorm that seals off our access to Tier 2. 

It is up to you to locate the oilers and remove them from the boilers\!
helptips.properties|m.lichenous_lair: Lichens are strange, alien varieties of slimes thought to have arrived on this world in a large meteor.  While a single-cell colony is mostly harmless, they can quickly combine into a most terrible foe.  Keep them from mingling\!
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_2_2: Those heavy cogs are in our way, and from intel reports, the only way to open them up is from inside two adjacent gatehouses.  I will not waste needless lives battering at the gatehouse from the front.  I'll need you to find a way around.  Flank the defenses, get inside the gatehouse, and open up the gates\!
item.properties|m.forge_max_in_flight: Waiting for previous forges to finish...
chat.properties|m.usage_helpme: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades that you need help\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Be careful confronting the Warmaster\!
mission.properties|m.honor_duty_3a:
Aye, as do we all. 

Now then, {0}, you need to prepare for what's to come.  Reaching the Core is only the beginning for us.  I suspect that Spiral HQ will be issuing you many more missions in the future that could only be taken on by someone of your ability. 

And finally, it is my pleasure to inform you that you will soon be awarded one of the greatest honors of the Spiral Knights, the rank of Vanguard.  I will see you in the Hall of Heroes.
social.properties|m.levels_completed: become the new Level Leader, having completed {0} levels in the past 7 days\!
item.properties|f.cautery_sword: A sword adapted from a medical tool, its heated blade reduces tissue damage. It is very formidable at destroying monsters of the slime family.
mission.properties|o.dreams_and_nightmar: Prepare for the worst and journey to the Core
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_2a: Perfect\!  I'll keep the artifact and burn you to the ground all the same\! \n\nHahaha\!
item.properties|f.nightblade: A short slicer infused with the essence of the Underworld.
helptips.properties|m.loading17: Check out forums.spiralknights.com. Be a part of the conversation\!
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_1: SITUATION RESOLVED. PLEASE EXIT THE FACILITY.
social.properties|m.party_invite: {0} has invited you to join their party.
logon.properties|m.no_new_free_account: You cannot create any more free accounts from this computer.
mission.properties|r.new_chapter_3a: Thanks Kora, I'll do my best\!
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: We've recovered what little remains from Owlite Keep concerning the Kingdom of Almire. Combined with the snippets we've gotten from the nature sprites within Firestorm Citadel itself, we are starting to get a clearer picture of Almire's history.
helptips.properties|m.tg_shield: Press [[DEFEND]] to raise your shield and block attacks.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I'm not ready to choose yet.
item.properties|f.ghost_bell: A small, silvery bell worn by considerate ghosts that alerts the living when they are close by.
design.properties|i.name_room: Name the room at this location.
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_2a: Yes, I see that we're already back to-
admin.properties|m.load_tester_disabled: Disabled\: to enable, enter a 'pseudoPlayerPassword' in the server configurator.
sprites.properties|d.violent_heart_attac: Targets destroyed while enchanted create an explosion.
helptips.properties|m.sprite_cooldown: After using any sprite skill, a cooldown is required on all skills before using them again.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_6: Our geological research is ongoing, so there may yet be other fascinating uses for these strange and powerful minerals.
mission.properties|o.target_acquired: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
conversation.properties|m.npc_teaser_kni: This last mission sure was a strange one. We were clearing the way to an elevator when we saw some odd structures off in the distance. We couldn't see any way to reach them though.  I guess we'll just have to keep an eye out for them in the future.  The Clockworks is ever-shifting after all.
item.properties|f.super_freeze_barrier: Surrounds you with potent icy orbs that can freeze hostiles in their tracks
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_1: Well met {0}, it has been some time since I first met you having just arrived from the Rescue Camp.  You've come along way since then, rising to the rank of Defender Elite no less. \n\nYou are a gifted soldier, {0}.  I have no doubt you will soon be a Champion amongst the Spiral Knights and instrumental in our solving the great mystery that is the Core, restoring the Skylark and returning home.  You have proven that you have what it takes to face the legions of dark forces that lurk below the surface.
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_1a: Hello there little one. You look as though you require knowledge of some kind.
item.properties|f.spiraltail_mail: A simple simian mail typically worn at parades to provide prosperity and lend luck.
item.properties|f.cosmic_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
mission.properties|b.vile_engine:
Somewhere below a level that lichens have taken to inhabiting lies a strange facility of unknown origin that seems to be used for the production of toxic slime monsters. The 'slime generators' are capable of rapidly producing slime monsters that then quickly populate nearby levels. 

Squads in neighboring levels have already reported overwhelming numbers of toxic slimes, making it impossible to lead expeditions beyond depth 23.  It is time a knight of your caliber form a squad to infiltrate this strange facility and shut down production of these vile creatures. 

Any data that you could collect as to their origin would be highly valuable to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.spiral_hood: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.super_blaster: A supercharged Blaster well-suited to longer expeditions down into the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.electron_vortex: An Electron Bomb modified with a payload of unstable organic essence. Foes caught in its punishing blast radius are cruelly referred to as "thunderstuck".
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
item.properties|f.shroom_cap: It's no small truffle, you'll be cute as a button in this fungi looking cap.
dungeon.properties|m.final_test_2_desc: The route to Haven is suspended high above a perilous clockwork chasm. Prepare yourself, danger is sure to lurk around every corner\!
item.properties|f.power_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
mission.properties|r.guardians_of_cradle: I know, Vaelyn. I feel the same way.
conversation.properties|r.biscotti_1: This all sounds really strange, but I'm happy to help if I can.
social.properties|m.autofriend_single_ma: Your {0} friend {1} just started playing Spiral Knights as {2}\! Unfortunately, that knight already has a full friend list, so you were unable to be auto-friended.
sprites.properties|d.shadow_cloak: Grants you partial invisibility and a defensive boost for a limited time. Shadow Cloak is cancelled if you take damage, attack, or perform any other action.
mission.properties|r.explosive_plot_3a: It's because the Strangers took us in that they're now targeted...
conversation.properties|m.sl_guard_4: Good luck to you then.  Shadow Lairs will be the greatest challenge you will face yet.
support.properties|m.delete_mail: Deleted mail from knightId\:{0} with subject "{1}".
mission.properties|m.new_threat_8a: Pah\!  I am no mere gremlin.  I am the thousand eyes that watch you in the darkness.  I am the hissing blade that whispers your doom.  Tear down every wall and cog in this accursed place and you will find only shadows. \n\nI cannot be stopped by the likes of you\!  Hsst\!
item.properties|f.brute_core: An oozing blue lump from a particularly potent gelatinous opponent.
mission.properties|r.go_shopping_6b: I think I've got it Bechamel, thanks\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet2_4a: Please {0}, help us restore power to the Rescue Camp so that we can set up a defensive perimeter.  We cannot afford to lose any more recruits to the creatures of the night\!
dungeon.properties|m.goahead_title: Go on ahead of your party?
projectx.properties|e.name_too_consec: Sorry, names cannot contain the same letter in a row more than twice.
mission.properties|r.target_acquired_1a: I understand that Spiral HQ has uncovered the nature of Project R.
helptips.properties|m.recon: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to activate Recon Module.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Euclid volunteered to help The Sleeper. I'm sure he's in here somewhere battling The Swarm even as we speak. As for Rulen...Vaelyn I'm sorry. He disappeared shortly after Euclid made his decision. I haven't been able to find him ever since.
mission.properties|m.another_trace_2a: The place is as strange as it sounds.  Apparently, monsters within the slime family actually have a ruling aristocracy of elite slimes.  These 'Royal Jellies' are enormous, selfish and ill-tempered slimes that live in opulent palaces that we can only guess have been squatted in as we do not believe slimes are capable of building structures.
logon.properties|m.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please log in on the website again and relaunch the game.
item.properties|f.no_door: Removes any door presently installed and leaves the room open for anyone to enter.
item.properties|f.vial_stun_super: An ornate glass vial containing shimmering flash pellets. It can be used to inflict enemies with Stun.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be too stupefied to give chase\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_hearts: Break these blocks to receive hearts. Hearts restore your health. You cannot pick them up unless you need them.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_zip: Please check that the ZIP or postal code is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_8a: Yes, it seems that these sprites have mastered the ability to focus their powers on skills that protect their knight. Given that and their appearance I've dubbed them 'seraphynx.'
mission.properties|r.apocrea_1_2a: What do you mean? Who are the Apocrea?
item.properties|f.empty_room: An empty Guild Hall room with standard flooring and plenty of space for furniture\!
mission.properties|o.p_r4_mat_2: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
social.properties|m.party_full: Oops\! That party is no longer accepting new members.
item.properties|f.spiral_sallet: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_7a: Discoveries on the planet grow stranger by the day. Now our sprites are adapting the form of some kind of phantom.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro2_1a: ...come in, {0}, are you there?  This is Recon Knight Rhendon\!
item.properties|f.starlit_demo_helm: An illuminated helm strengthened against soporific smogs. It's surprisingly soft inside.
mission.properties|m.another_trace_4a: Good luck, {0}.  Be sure to thoroughly prepare before attempting this mission.
redeem.properties|e.invalid_code: The code you entered was not found. Please double-check it and try again.
item.properties|f.impostoclaus_hat: A fabulously festive Winterfest hat that makes the wearer look like the great spirit of Winterfest, Impostoclaus. Glorp\! Glorp\! Glorp\!
item.properties|f.black_kat_cowl: A cursed cowl that is brimming with dark energy. It is said to resemble the great Kat Tribe hero, Margrel, the one who opened The Book of Grey Feathers and brought about the Kataclysm. It brings great misfortune to anyone who dares to wear it.
item.properties|f.deep_sea_cuirass: A suit of armor with iridescent scales that seem to move like shimmering waves. The armor is rather uncomfortable to wear as it is naturally cold and wet at all times.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_vana: A magnificently preserved royal seal of the lost kingdom of Almire. It probably belongs in a museum.
board.properties|i.playprivate: Create a party that only friends and guildmates can join.
helptips.properties|m.wolver_den: Wolvers are a highly adaptable pack beast whose predatory instincts are only matched by their quick reflexes.  They play with their prey by dancing about and finally striking from behind.  Keep a blade handy.
item.properties|f.wild_buster: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it, you can feel the fierce energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_9a: Rulen was recruited as the technical genius that Captain Ozlo believed would be required for navigating the vast, mechanized world of the Clockworks.  His primary responsibilities included everything from disabling locks to repairing armor to wrecking sentient constructs.  He was additionally the lead on analyzing the Core once the squad reached it.
item.properties|f.nova_driver: It'll take more than a wish to save you if you're the unfortunate target of this all-powerful pistol with the strength of the stars themselves.
dungeon.properties|b.i_agree: I will never talk about C.U.B.E. Club
item.properties|f.confetti_equinox: When thrown, this spring confetti bursts with freshly sprouted grass and fragrant flowers. No rain required\!
item.properties|f.spiral_draped_armor: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: Don't know how long before our forcefield gives out...
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_3: In town, you can access the Forge at any time.  In the Clockworks, you can access it by using an Arsenal Station.
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last: I don't know about that... I'm fine here amongst all these ancient tomes.  I've got plenty to read, more than I ever could in a lifetime.  But I suppose that won't be a problem. \n\nPlease, just head on back to Haven.  Let my squad know that I'm ok and that I'm safe.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: Required items will appear once your sprite is ready to level up. After your sprite has consumed enough heat, a 'required material' notice will appear above the feeding tray. This material MUST be fed to the sprite in order for it to advance further.
guild.properties|log.room_placed: Placed a {0} for {1} crowns, replacing a {2}.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_6b: Once you've applied all your skill points and achieved a very high level with your sprite, you will begin to select your 'ultimate skills.' Ultimate skills are improved versions of your sprite skills. Each sprite skill has two options for an ultimate skill.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research: By now you have likely collected a few material samples from your early expeditions into the Clockworks.  Spiral HQ is requesting some of those materials for their ongoing research of the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks.
mission.properties|b.shocking_sentient_s:
Recon Knights have uncovered a secret weapons facility that according to the intel we have available, could belong to a high ranking gremlin of The Crimson Order.  It is heavily fortified by a small army of electrified constructs who have no doubt been programmed to defend the facility at all costs. 

While it is unclear if this weapons stash actually belongs to a gremlin of The Crimson Order, it is no less worth infiltrating and neutralizing the weapons stash. 

It is advised that you prepare yourself with elemental damage and shock resistant gear before deploying.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2d: Battle sprites gain perks at certain levels that you can equip within the battle sprite interface. Perks provide bonuses to your stats.
item.properties|f.slicer: Energy spikes go in. Flying razor disks of barely-understood primordial energy come hurtling out\!  And look out for that extra-peppy boomerang effect...
item.properties|f.surge_breaker_helm: A reliable helmet that's charged with protecting your skull from any unpleasant jolts.
projectx.properties|e.name_invalid_dash: Sorry, there must be two letters surrounding any dash, and two dashes maximum.
item.properties|f.furni_library_lectern_: A podium perfect for pondering over many a quaint and curious volume of forgotten lore.
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro3_2a: I'll scout ahead then\! Be careful, Rhendon.
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: But I come to warn you\!  Crimson Order not stop with Roarmulus Project.  Crimson Order desperate to destroy all enemies. Tall ones, little ones, and outcasts.  All enemies to Crimson Order\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_winterfest: Contains various unique Winterfest prizes. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_vials_1: Vials are one type of pickup. When thrown they release the alchemical agents within creating an elemental explosion. You can give them a try in the next room.
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_1a: Clearly I really should know all about this, tell me more\!
support.properties|m.subheader_step2_gif: We have saved the offending gift box message already waiting to be added to the complaint, so there is no need to hurry from here. Please carefully choose the correct option matching what the player did\:
item.properties|f.deadshot_mantle: A poncho for a pale rider with sights set on taking down the bad, ugly, undead denizens of the dark.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research
item.properties|f.splinter_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in a synthetic mineral. Prone to shattering, the otherwise useless material in this bomb is perfect for giving foes a nasty splinter.
conversation.properties|m.npc_minerknigh: Spiral HQ wants us to haul these minerals back up to Haven.
projectx.properties|m.remove_loadout_pro: Are you sure you want to remove {0}?
conversation.properties|r.core_lead_4: But I thought there was no way inside it?
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Warmaster Seerus is crazy\!  I should escape to Emberlight.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_charge_3: Now that you know how to perform a charge attack, let's apply that to a more advanced battle. Charge your weapon and unleash at the right moment when the enemy is exposed. Good luck\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_8a: Yes.  It would seem as though we have much to learn of this place. \n\nRhendon's report noted that many of the sprites were missing from the site. He suggested foul play.
item.properties|f.prize_box_rose_regalia: Contains various unique Rose Regalia costumes and accessories. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
conversation.properties|m.hav_guardian_1: Welcome to Haven, {0}, we've been expecting you.
item.properties|f.wyvern_scale_helm: Made from the scales of rare Clockworks beasts, this sturdy helmet is resistant to even the highest of temperatures.
item.properties|f.ice_queen_mail: A regal suit of armor resembling the ever-frigid Ice Queen.  In addition to providing great defense, it is said to dramatically boost one's ego and create a cold detachment from those around them.
item.properties|f.night_cap_tailed: A comfortable cap for knights to wear at night. Sure to give the wearer peaceful dreams all night.
chat.properties|m.usage_goodbye: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nBids your fellow players farewell.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_f: They say you're going to travel down this elevator and into the chasm below. You're a heck of a lot braver than I am...
item.properties|f.light_shard: A shard of Luminite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
item.properties|f.vial_shock_super: An ornate glass vial containing hyper-charged electric fluids. It can be used to inflict enemies with Shock.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes a real ZAP\!
item.properties|f.mandolin: A spike-shredding, high-capacity, overclocked double disk launcher.  Experimental spike energy seems drawn to orbit itself... and drawn back toward the launcher with extra potency\!
conversation.properties|r.atg_greeter_1b: No thanks, I'll explore the place myself.
item.properties|f.token_snarbolax: A long, razor-sharp tooth plucked from the mouth of a Snarbolax; a memento representing a Knight's triumph over the monstrous stalker of the Gloaming Wildwoods.
sprites.properties|d.meteoric_firebol: Increases the size of the firebolt's explosion.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_b631f6: Power up a derelict Mecha Knight.
item.properties|f.iceburst_brandish: An upgraded Brandish infused with the elemental essence of ice.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_8a: Just one last shop to visit and then we're done. I've saved the best for last.
projectx.properties|e.name_too_short: Sorry, valid names must be at least 4 letters long.
item.properties|f.fiery_vaporizer_mkii: A Fiery Vaporizer modified to disperse combustible material over a wider range.
item.properties|f.shogun_helmet: A grand helmet worn by warriors who long ago united a land under the banner of the rising sun.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_4a: Heh, don't look now, {0}, but there's a ghost over your shoulder\! Let's hope these sprites haven't invested all their power into good looks. \n\nUse that one to clear the path ahead so a rescue team can get through safely\!
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_3a: The Apocrea are stuff of nightmares\: a terrible legion of otherworldly phantasms whose only ambition seems to be trapping and devouring the souls of all life. \n\nThough you may venture beyond this nexus, you will undoubtedly fall into one of their traps along the way.
item.properties|f.royal_jelly_mail: A viciously viscous set of armor crafted painstakingly from the most noble specimens of quivering slime.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3a: Feeding your sprite materials is the fastest way to level it up. Talk to Biscotti here in the Lab for more information on sprite feeding.
item.properties|f.breach_blaster: An enhanced pierce blaster designed to break through hostile armor.
conversation.properties|r.fc_court_4_acc: Free 6 Lost Sprites? I can do that\!
item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_sight: 'Through my eyes you will see the path to ages. Pure is my gaze, free from the lies of reality.'
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_h:
You see that shimmery aurora? 

We have no idea what that is\! 

And while it's pretty from here, we're reading intense energy spikes in some regions down below\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_lever_alt: Switches can open doors. Try throwing a pot or shooting this one with your handgun\!
sprites.properties|d.firestorm: Summon the power of true dragon fire to burn everything in your path.
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_2a: At the rate you're going you just might, {0}\!  Though based on new intel it would seem that's not going to be easy.
support.properties|m.option_208_0: If a player is trying to get your account name or password from you right now, or already did and is admitting to this in chat, you should click here to file a complaint.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_7a: It's unclear, {0}. Given Rhendon's report, I'd say they learned something from the old arcane tomes you discovered near these sprites. Fascinating that they appear to have adapted their combat abilities because of this.
helptips.properties|m.atg_switch: Switch out of reach?  Throw a pot or shoot it with a gun\!
item.properties|m.unlock_slime_prompt: A Slime Key (or Silver Key) is required to open this Lockbox. Lockboxes contain random prizes inside.
item.properties|f.crest_of_ur: A crest from the lost Legion of Ur, an elite band of fiendish warriors said to have once conquered the Underworld. Whomever holds it can faintly hear the sound of drums and the clomping of hooves.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_4: Once you safely reach the elevator, the mineral you are carrying gets deposited in your arsenal for use later. Everyone in your party gets everyone else's minerals, so no need to fight over who gets the best one\!
mission.properties|m.new_threat_2a: And speaking of gremlins, we're starting to get an alarming number of reports of gremlins mobilizing in the Clockworks below Haven.  We don't have too many details yet, but given the relations we've had with them so far, our guess is they're preparing for an attack.
mission.properties|m.best_of_beast_2a: Yes well, let's get started then. \n\nTier 3 is closest to the Core and much like how high level items respond to its power, so do monsters.  Many of them take on new forms and are considered at their most dangerous.  You must prepare before taking on each mission.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_6a: Here we have an alchemy station that you'll no doubt become very familiar with as you upgrade your arsenal.  But no need to worry about that too much as Spiral HQ is likely to give you a mission later on that explains everything. \n\nWell, that about does it for your first tour.  Do you want me to go over it all again or do you think you've got it?
item.properties|f.toxic_core: A solid, pulsating lump that oozes with vitriol.
mission.properties|r.darkest_forces_1a: Yes, my next missions will have me facing fiends and undead.  Sounds fun.
item.properties|f.capsule_remedy: A small capsule that refreshes its user. It can be used to remove all status conditions you're afflicted with.\n\nDon't panic\! Remedy capsules can be a life saver, if you remember to use them\!
chat.properties|m.usage_sound: Usage\: /{0}\nToggle all sounds between full and silent.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_b_: Great, thanks for being a good ambassador\! \n\nI'll contact you again soon, good luck {0}\!
exchange.properties|m.billing_spending_l: You have reached your spending limit. Your card has not been charged.
item.properties|f.gunslinger_hat: A mighty fine piece of headgear worn by pistol-packing warriors from a forgotten time. It's perfect for dueling, searching or drifting across high plains.
mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.
mission.properties|r.creators_and_create: So all constructs in the Clockworks were created by the gremlins?
mission.properties|b.high_temperature_ho:
Intel had reported a gremlin deconstruction crew dismantling a portion of the Clockworks in order to generate scrap resources for use in their Project R. Using powerful welding torches, they are truly burning the place to the ground. 

One of the squads investigating the site has gone missing and is believed to be now held in captivity at the site. 

Infiltrate the fiery deconstruction zone and rescue the captive knights.  But be warned, the deconstruction crew are said to have a powerful security construct hidden somewhere on site.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_6a: It was for this reason that Ozlo selected him to take a small squad down into the unknown depths of the Clockworks.  After all, if you cut your teeth battling under Morai typhoon fire you could probably handle anything right? \n\nBut maybe the Clockworks proved too much for even his ability.  We just don't know.
item.properties|f.celestial_shield: Cradle's equinox inspired the dual nature of this specialist shield, which protects against the dazzling light of day and the chill of night in equal measure.
mission.properties|f.p_tip: Prestige Badges are displayed next to your knight name.  They are automatically awarded when enough prestige is acquired.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_1a: Hi there {0}\!  Wow, you've made Soldier already?  You're really moving up fast in the ranks. \n\nAnyway, I'm here to give you a tour of some of the Bazaar's more advanced services. To start, do you want to learn how to even further power up that gear of yours?
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last:
Yes, it is isn't it?  I should not have come here alone.  I should have stayed with my squad. 

(Edger looks off into the distance) 

I don't even remember how it happened.... maybe I never will.  But it didn't hurt.
helptips.properties|m.terminal_1: Welcome traveler, this is a Clockwork Terminal. Take a moment to rest and change your gear. \n\nUse the elevator either to return to Haven or delve into a more dangerous stratum of the Clockworks.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_shield_2: As your shield absorbs damage it will turn from green to red and eventually break. Once it's broken you cannot defend until it regenerates, so be careful\!
mission.properties|o.p_r4_weap_2: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
helptips.properties|m.event_module: Warning\! An unidentified place of interest lies beyond this gate. By entering you will not be able to turn back until you complete the challenges within.\n\nHowever, should you manage to come out victorious you will be rewarded for your bravery. Enter at your own risk\!
item.properties|f.woven_sentinel_armor: A suit of armor imbued with interwoven wolver hair to protect against even the harshest elements.
item.properties|f.flame_soul: A powerful essence left behind when a creature perishes during a blind, fiery rage.
item.properties|f.exp_center_2f: An expansion that adds a large central meeting room to the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.snarbostuffing: A dense, fluffy stuffing made from a special polymer that doesn't break down when exposed to the cursed fur of the Snarbolax. It's perfect for creating trophies or adorable, cursed, stuffed toys.
social.properties|m.party_dissolved: Oops\! That party no longer exists.
mission.properties|r.eye_of_needle_5a: Roger that.  So you've got some missions lined up for me?
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_expira: Please check that the expiration date is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
mission.properties|b.alien_ooze: One of our field research teams is under siege from a large colony of lichens. Lichens are an alien species of the slime family thought to have come to the Clockworks via a meteor that crashed on to the surface of Cradle.  This particular species of slime is formed from innumerable smaller slimes that form mobile, sentient 'colonies.' \n\nLichen colonies can further combine to form larger and larger versions of themselves, rapidly evolving a range of deadly claws and barbs.  Prevent them from combining at all costs and save the research team\!
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_2a:
Re\: Resource allocation request, Amu-Sol 

You are receiving this mail as a result of an incorrect/cryptic entry in your recent resource allocation request.  Please provide a detailed summary of your projected use of the following requested resources\: 
- 999 'Open minded' devilites 
- 50 barrels of 'whatever frostifurs eat' 
- A 'towering pillar' of everfrost and 'all the frozen souls it brings forth'
arena.properties|m.revive_desc: Use a Spark of Life to revive early and gain an edge in battle.
craft.properties|e.cant_use_accessory: This item is not compatible with this accessory type.
item.properties|f.emberbreak_helm: A Spiral Helm modified to provide additional protection against fire, at the expense of freeze and shock resistance.
item.properties|f.shadowtech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires bullets of concentrated shadow that split on impact.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_1aa: More questions about battle sprites? How can I assist you?
item.properties|f.ice_axe: A technical climbing tool that can pick apart monsters with precision.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_roarmulus: The monitor shows readouts coming from a prototype of a massive war machine labeled "Project R".
sprites.properties|d.five_alarm: Increases the duration and size of the firestorm.
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: The Nine see all, hear all.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_6a: Hold fast, traveler. You stand in the court of the Kingdom of Almire. Do you not hear the trumpets sound the return of our mighty legions? Are you not in awe of the prestigious heraldry of our great houses and statesmen?
item.properties|f.bucket_of_flawed_snowb: This bucket seems to have an endless supply of Flawed Snowballs. Unfortunately, they will start to melt when exposed, so you better use them fast\!
mission.properties|o.p_r7_mat_3: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.
item.properties|f.love_puppy_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a love puppy.  It's so convincing, your friends just might want a kiss\!
guild.properties|m.not_in_guild: Sorry, you're not presently in a guild.
conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: Everyjelly is welcome at the Golden Slime\!
uplink.properties|m.rank_mig: Spiral Knights has recently undergone a change that has added new mission rewards to missions you have already completed. They are attached.\n\nEnjoy\!
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_3a: I have another question for you.
item.properties|f.sacred_pathfinder_armo: A reinforced suit of double padded armor that is sure to stop the sharpest of foes.
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_3b: A "gate" is an entry point into the Clockworks. They take the form of the lifts you see before you. Each gate has a display monitor showing the gate's unique icon as well as a control panel that allows the user to enter the gate. This gate here will always take you to the same place, but other gates have shifting floors beneath them. In those, you never quite know what's next\!
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
item.properties|f.almirian_crusader_helm: A helm once worn by the elite royal guard of the kingdom of Almire. Its ivory color was a symbol of Almire's purity, both in the land and in the hearts of its people.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.
helptips.properties|m.rescue_door_sk: I've almost got this door open. While I'm working at it, rescue the captive knights in the area\!
item.properties|f.dark_matter_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in Dark Matter. Since its original discovery, Dark Matter has been put to a variety of uses, from powering Spiral technology, to rearranging Gremlins on a subatomic level.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_1a: Hello {0}, I've been meaning to talk to you for some time, but it seems Spiral HQ is keeping you very busy.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_r3: Meet with Biscotti in her kitchen and provide 'baking assistance.'
helptips.properties|m.tg3_charge_2: To perform a charge attack with a sword or handgun, press and hold ATTACK. After attacking you will begin to charge your weapon. Once it reaches maximum charge release ATTACK to unleash your charge attack.
