mission.properties|o.terminal_meltdown: Destroy the fiery monsters in the fuel depot and prevent an explosive disaster
mission.properties|r.best_of_beast_2a: I understand my upcoming missions will have me facing mostly beast and slime monsters.
conversation.properties|r.hunter_2a: Ah, so it's a team effort?
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r9: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.mug_misery: A cursed drinking utility that can only be used by a truly wicked soul. Those that possess it are said to bring grave misfortune to those around them.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_1_2: Our advance has ground to a halt because of that artillery on the walls pinning us down.  Earlier, we staged a diversion to allow a small squad of knights to break through the front to silence that artillery...but they seem to have failed.  Now they're trapped in there, and we're stuck out here\! \n\nI need you to break through the front lines, get inside the artillery control center, and find a way to take out those cannons for good\!  Meanwhile, I'll get the troops reorganized so we can follow up your assault.  Good luck in there, soldier\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet2_2a:
In short, this camp has no power and the sun is setting soon. Last night all manners of horrible monsters came after us in the dark.  We couldn't see and had no power for our defensive turrets. 

...we lost a lot of recruits. 

We need to channel power to the Rescue Camp so that we can set up a defensive perimeter before night falls\!
item.properties|f.spitfire: A modified Proto Gun augmented with a low intensity burst of flame.
social.properties|m.earned_prestige: become the Most Prestigious, having earned {0} prestige in the past 7 days\!
item.properties|f.radiant_silvermail: An upgraded set of Silvermail that is said to shine brightly even in the darkest of hours.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.voltech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires highly charged ionic bullets that split on impact.
pvp.properties|m.coins_earned.n: You have earned {0} Krogmo Coins playing {1}\!
mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_4a: Yes, I feel the same way.  We owe it to them to put an end to this gremlin threat as quickly as possible. \n\nI've lined up several missions for you that will take you to locations where gremlins seem to be gathering resources for Project R.  Your briefing should explain everything.
item.properties|f.mechaknight_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a mecha knight.  It's so convincing, your friends just might try to deconstruct you\!
mission.properties|o.whipping_mishandlin: Deliver the supplies to the research team within the fiendish city of Sol' Fork
helptips.properties|m.tg3_end: Seems like you have a good grasp on the basics. I think you're ready to join the rest of the recruits in the Sparrow Gate. There you will learn how to work as a party. There's a lot of recruits out there depending on you now. Great job\!
item.properties|f.kat_eye_mail: An impressive mail instilled with the might of Kat Seekers, the skillful grenadiers of the Kat Tribe.
item.properties|f.wrench_wand: A heavy hand tool favored by Gremlins. It's good for both tightening bolts and cracking skulls.
mission.properties|m.intro_reward_arcade: Select a gate to view the gate map and enable options for starting your expedition\!
item.properties|f.vial_fire_super: An ornate glass vial containing a molten mixture. It can be used to inflict enemies with Fire.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and turn 'em into toast\!
guild.properties|m.invite_message: Enter an optional message to include with your invitation\:
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: (For the first time since you've known him, Hahn is silent. He seems to be contemplating your findings very carefully.)
item.properties|f.grim_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. Shadows seem to lengthen and cling to it whenever it is brought to bear.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_or: A short torch filled with otherworldly orange fire.
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r7: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
conversation.properties|m.hav_greeter_1a: Welcome to Haven, little one. Please join your friends in procuring shinies from the Clockworks. Shinies are always appreciated by the Strangers.
prologue.properties|m.helmsman_warning: Captain\! Energy signatures are shifting\! I've never seen anything like-
helptips.properties|m.tg_doors: Doors can be opened in many different ways.
mission.properties|r.best_of_beast_1a: Well thanks Hahn, it's almost as if-
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_3_8a: I assume you've named them as well?
item.properties|f.frostbreaker_armor: Armor with a hacked elemental core aimed at resisting freeze. However, this non-standard modification creates other elemental weaknesses.
guild.properties|m.published: The Guild Hall has been updated\!
conversation.properties|r.test_greeter_1: I shall do my best in this test\!
item.properties|f.rigadoon: A stunning saber that will leave your opponent quite off their guard.
mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft3:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, intel has located a black kat nest beyond an area with electrifying resistance. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!
chat.properties|m.usage_zgo: Usage\: /{0} zone name\nMoves to the named zone.
item.properties|f.fiery_diskgun: A handgun powered by an infernal engine that launches molten disks in rapid succession. Diskgun shots return once reaching their apogee.
helptips.properties|m.loading5: You can see what your friends are up to by clicking on the social button in the bottom left corner of your screen. You can even instantly join them if there is room in their party.
mission.properties|r.target_acquired_3a: I'll be sure to get my hands on the appropriate gear for the job.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: Tell me about the other battle sprites.
guildhelp.properties|l.storage_console: The Guild Storage can be accessed from the Command Console. | action | console
mission.properties|b.p_r4_mat_2: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.volt_breaker_helm: A Circuit Breaker Helm modified to provide further protection against shock.
helptips.properties|m.atg_treasure: GREEN Treasure boxes contain crowns and other useful items\! RED Treasure boxes are rarer than green blocks and contain better items\! HEART boxes contain hearts that will restore your health.
item.properties|f.gold_wolf_coat: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Gold Wolves,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
item.properties|f.fur_cap: A toasty fur cap forming the visage of a wild beast.
item.properties|f.mad_bomber_mask: A sturdy helmet designed to keep out explosions, radio waves and high-tech mind control devices. At least, that's what they *want* you to think it does.
item.properties|f.storm_warrior_helm: A helm worn by a fabled sword master so skilled, he could cut through lightning as it struck the ground.
dungeon.properties|m.vip_tos:
This C.U.B.E. Club Membership Agreement constitutes a binding legal document between the undersigned (the "knight"), Golden Casino Holdings LLC (the "Casino"), and the entire slime community ("slimes").

 I. General Terms and Conditions
  1. Membership in the C.U.B.E. Club is for personal use only and can not be transferred to other knights, Devilites, or other Clockwork creatures.
  2. Selling access to your ability to spin is prohibited.
  3. Keep your arms and legs inside the Casino at all times.
  4. Please do not drop items into the core.
 II. Description of Benefits
  1. Benefits are varied and may be changed at any time.
  2. Lounge access is not guaranteed and limited by availability.
  3. Buffalo Wings are not included.
  4. All disputes will be arbitrated by the Casino floor manager and all decisions are final.
 III. Winnings, Payments, and Fees
  1. Winnings may be paid in Golden Slime Coins at the discretion of the Casino floor manager.
  2. No additional fees are collected at this time.
 IV. Promotional Awards
  1. Sale promotions\: Reduced prices for members, if any, will be displayed plainly in the shop interface.
  2. The Gift Shop reserves the right to modify, alter, discontinue or terminate these promotions at any time for any reason whatsoever without notice to the end users. No whiners.
 V. Restrictions and Conditions of Use
  1. As a condition of your use of the club services, you agree not to use club facilities or interfaces for any purpose that is unlawful or prohibited by the terms, conditions, and notices included in this Membership Agreement or any relevant Licence Agreement, or anything generally regarded as uncouth by the slimes.
  2. The Spiral Knights Terms of Service supersedes these terms where applicable.
  3. The knight agrees to all terms and conditions enumerated here, and those not enumerated here. The slimes may add new conditions at any time that require complete retroactive compliance.
 VI. Termination of Account
  1. The Casino has the right to terminate your membership for violating any terms or conditions, precise or vague, enumerated herein or generated at the time of infraction. You've been warned.
 VII. Disclaimer of Warranty; Limitation of Liability
  1. Your use of the Casino is at your sole risk. You click it, you bought it.
  2. The Casino nor the general slime community shall not be liable in contract, tort, negligence or otherwise for any loss or damage whatsoever arising from or in any way connected with your use of the Casino.
 VIII. General
  1. This Membership Agreement is governed by the laws of Haven and the laws of Cradle. You hereby irrevocably consent to submit to the jurisdictions of the Courts of Cradle and Haven.
  2. This agreement was written by a few slimes with little grasp of legal language beyond what they saw when watching A Few Good Men. Thus, any parts that don't make sense are usually blamed on the other guy. Any good parts left over are still good. They don't go bad just because we screwed up on the other badder parts. There's a word for that concept and the fact that we don't know it is one of the bad parts.
uplink.properties|m.login_event: Hail, {0}\! Thanks for playing Spiral Knights\! As part of a special event, please accept the attached rewards to aid you in your adventures\! \n\nAnd don't forget to check out the Supply Depot for more rare items and special offers\!
item.properties|f.scary_skelly_mask: An upgraded Skelly Mask infused with the elemental essence of fear. Wearing it makes the hair on the back of your neck stand up.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
item.properties|f.winged_helm: A helm whose design evokes an almost heavenly beauty.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_5b: Get energy and do amazing things- got it\!
sprites.properties|d.maskeraith: The maskeraith is a battle sprite that embodies the shadows. Its skills focus on subterfuge and deadly toxins.
uplink.properties|e.no_gift_self: You can't send a gift to yourself.
item.properties|f.cracked_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. Though cracked, it still glows ever so faintly.
guild.properties|x.rename_desc2: The renaming item will be consumed.
conversation.properties|m.npc_campknight: Have a seat and rest a while.
item.properties|f.phial_phear: A glass tube containing a small dose of phearium, a strange chemical said to induce panic into anyone who even gets so much as a whiff of the stuff.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikedata_: What might the gremlins be doing with all of these spikes?
mission.properties|m.new_threat_5a: {0}, something big is going down at the Lab.  You need to get here immediately\!
exchange.properties|m.offertosell_toolti: Enter the amount of energy you want to sell, in multiples of 100.
pvp.properties|m.lockdown-info: Battle for domination of control points utilizing special class mods that completely alter your Knight's abilities\!  Lockdown participants can be divided by tier or play an open match. Check today's game modes\!
helptips.properties|m.tg3_lift_1: It's time to flex those muscles\! Some objects you encounter can be lifted and carried or thrown. Walk up to these clay pots and press ATTACK when you see the action icon.
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_2a: Awesome\! I'll break it down for you in three easy lessons\: what it is, how it's used, and how you can get more.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_bomb: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_1a: You made it, {0}\!  I'm happy to see you arrive here in Haven safe and sound.  I'll confirm with Spiral HQ that you will now be undertaking missions in Haven.  To start, I've issued you a few missions that will help get you acclimated with all that Haven has to offer.  Be sure to say hello to the Strangers as you begin exploring.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: Productivity is up two percent since I started mandatory overtime.
mission.properties|b.shadow_beast:
Spiral HQ has detected a recon module left by the Alpha Squad somewhere within the Gloaming Wildwoods.  It is your mission to locate and retrieve the module. 

The Gloaming Wildwoods is home to packs of wild beasts that have proven deadly for squads in the past. Because of this, Tech Knights have placed Beast Bells throughout the area. Striking them should stun any beasts caught within the sound wave they produce. 

Be advised that Recon Knights have reported the presence of a terrible beast the likes which we have not seen before stalking this forest.  Known as 'the Snarbolax,' it appears as a shadowy mass of fangs and claws and seems completely immune to our weaponry.  Should you encounter it, try and find a means of escape as fast as possible.
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_2a: I will share with you what I know, little one.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_sentin: A helm reinforced with volcanic plating to defend against a range of elements.
logon.properties|m.steam_error: We experienced a problem authenticating with Steam. Please ensure that the Steam client is running and that you are not logged in elsewhere.
item.properties|f.lockbox: A special lockbox that contains one of hundreds of unique items\!  It can only be opened with a Silver Key.  Silver Keys can be purchased from the Supply Depot.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_3_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 4 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
sprites.properties|d.heart_attack: Enchants a group of targets. If enchanted target is destroyed, it has a chance of dropping extra restorative hearts.
item.properties|f.peppermint_repeater: This holiday hand cannon is the proper piece to pepper your opponents with hot lead of holiday cheer.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
auction.properties|m.listing_tip: The listing fee is refunded upon sale; a fee of {0}% of the sale price will be taken.
item.properties|f.vial_freeze_super: An ornate glass vial containing glacial wind. It can be used to inflict enemies with Freeze.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and chill your foes right in place\!
mission.properties|b.terminal_meltdown: Drawn to the Firestorm Citadel, a horde of fiery slime and beast monsters have swarmed a nearby fuel depot putting the depot and our access to the citadel at risk. Should these monsters spread the fires into the fuel drums, the whole place will go up in flames. \n\nSpiral HQ needs you to enter the depot and put out the fire before time runs out and an explosive disaster is triggered\!
item.properties|f.punch_n_vise_room: A busy room where Punch and Vise can be called upon to unbind and rework your equipment.

You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_2a: What the- are these...battle sprites? Something has happened to them, they've changed into some kind of creature.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!

mission.properties|b.blades_fallen:
Not every knight who enters the Clockworks returns to feel the sun on their face once more.  Within the perilous depths of the Clockworks, those that brave its dangers always face the reality that every expedition may be their last.  Sometimes their bodies can be recovered and other times all that is left is remnants of their gear. 

Just outside of Haven, Spiral HQ has built a soldier's graveyard where fallen knights can lay to rest.  As a Spiral Knight, you must face the reality of death in order to understand its gravity. 

Deliver the remains of an unknown knight, a sword, to a memorial within the graveyard.  But stay alert- dark energies resonate from the graveyard, attracted to the countless souls it houses.

mission.properties|b.shadow_knows: Biotech Hahn has suggested that given your recent promotion, you are ready to learn about the nefarious monsters within the Clockworks that inflict shadow damage. Contact him via comlink and see what he has to say.

item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_influ: 'Speak with the one, true voice and they will listen. Quiet as a child's whisper, roaring like the death of this world.'

mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft2:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, journey into a fiery furnace where intel has located a black kat nest. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!

conversation.properties|m.casino_imposto: Oh, haven't seen you around here before\!
mission.properties|m.honor_duty_2a: I've read your report of the Core, it's fascinating.  What an impossible structure and to think that the Alpha Squad might actually still be alive but... inside that thing is just incredible. \n\nI understand that Lieutenant Vaelyn has already led a team to the Core terminal and is establishing a base of operations for research.  This is of great value to all Spiral Knights and we have you to thank\!
social.properties|m.join_friend: Join your friend {0} at depth {1} in the {2} Gate\!
mission.properties|b.rescues_and_recycli: A 'Deconstruction Zone' is a gremlin work site where gremlins seem to tear apart existing levels and use the components to build new levels. Their ability to rapidly engineer levels and machines is incredible, surpassed only by their hostility to anyone who crosses their path. \n\nRecon Knights have discovered that a squad may have observed their engineering marvels a little too closely as they are now being held captive in one of the deconstruction sites near depth 10.  It is unclear what the gremlins have in store for these knights or if they simply plan on letting them perish along with the rest of the level they are dismantling.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_5a: Energy can only be obtained by purchase with a real money transaction or for trade via the Exchange. To purchase or trade for energy, simply open the Supply Depot and click the 'Get Energy' button.
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_6a: Thanks Hahn.  Tell those other Biotechs I appreciate it.
mission.properties|m.intro_arcade: Arcade Missions allow you to explore the ever-changing Clockworks without specific objectives. Visit the Haven Arcade to discover how you can transform the Clockworks to suit your needs\!
item.properties|f.super_shard_bomb: A shard bomb stuffed with even more depleted Crimsonite. The choicest cure for a combative creature is clearly a crystal to the cranium.
mission.properties|r.elemental_my_dear_1: Yes, but this time you need to let me-
item.properties|f.heavenly_iron_armor: A powerful suit of armor said to be crafted from angelic shields.  It retains many divine properties celestial beings possess but lacks their weakness to fire.
item.properties|f.starlit_hunting_coat: An advanced, star-soaked hunting coat that will keep you awake even as it coddles you in downy comfort.
craft.properties|e.no_accessory: There is no accessory of this type on this item.
mission.properties|o.strength_unity: Defend the Geo Knights from a monstrous assault
logon.properties|m.peer_shutdown: The peer to which we connected is shutting down. Please wait a moment before trying again.
item.properties|f.heavy_splinter_bomb: A solid chunk of synthetic mineral with an explosive surprise inside. Wolvers hate surprises.
item.properties|m.in_style_kit: (This modifier is also present in your style kit.)
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_4a: Yes, I can think of no greater tragedy.  Good luck then, {0}.
item.properties|f.silver_coil: An electromagnetic mechanism made of an extremely conductive metal.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_4a: Hey, it looks like one of the sprites has taken a liking to you\! Well, let's not let that extra power go to waste, I'll stay here and protect these sprites. You use your new friend to help clear the rest of the area of hostiles.
mission.properties|r.laboratory_visit_3a: Sounds very useful. How do I get one?
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft2_r6: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Royal Jelly \nThis massive gelatinous cube has a short fuse and loves to throw his weight around. When his royal tasters are absent a poisoned parfait would be a royal pain.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
item.properties|f.faust: A powerful, cursed sword forged in the Underworld. Its powerful charge attacks can sometimes curse the one that wields it.
mission.properties|r.target_acquired_2a: If you know where it is, I'll put a stop to it.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
item.properties|f.warmaster_bomb_1: A potent bomb brimming with dark energy that Warmaster Seerus engineered with the sole purpose of eliminating other gremlins that stood in his way.
mission.properties|b.shadowplay: Even after Lord Vanaduke's defeat at your hands, Firestorm Citadel continues to burn with accursed flames. Though the nature sprites have been steadily making progress in fighting the flames, something or someone has recently caused a violent resurgence in its destructive power. Spiral HQ requests that you gather together a crack squad of knights and return to the collapsing ruins of Firestorm Citadel in order to discover the source of the disturbance.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_final: Just one more room lies between you and the elevator out of here. Remember what you have learned so far and you'll do just fine... at least that's the theory. Try not to die, ok?
item.properties|f.ultra_fire_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly fiery orbs that can set hostiles ablaze
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
item.properties|f.quicksilver_mail: A fine set of mail made out of what was once a Quicksilver.
mission.properties|o.toy_soldiers: Destroy the Mecha Knight factory's production center
item.properties|f.gh_theme_shock: A high-energy theme that fills the air with electricty. Side effects include constant static shock from touching absolutely anything.
mission.properties|o.mission_sprite_1: Secure a cache of battle sprites and return them to the Lab
item.properties|f.arcane_salamander_mask: A Salamander Mask imbued with magical power.  It is thought to be made from the familiars of powerful witches.
mission.properties|m.search_continues_3a: Perhaps.  It certainly could be when you look at it.  We'll need to study it further.
item.properties|f.fowl_cowl_vol: A beaked mask shrouded in a scorched hood. Herald in the new year in this elemental gown.
item.properties|f.celestial_ore: An extremely rare metal of great power said to be from the heavens above.  It is often completely wasted on crowns and jewelry for slime royalty.
item.properties|f.spine_cone: A ferocious device that is positively bursting with briars.
item.properties|f.adv_evo_catalyst: A contained charge of highly unstable energy that can be synthesized by battle sprites. In doing so, sprites can evolve into even more advanced forms with even more powerful skills.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Oh {0}, it's horrible, just horrible\! \n\nA terrifying swarm of black kats came out of some dark portal deep within the Clockworks and have raided the Moorcroft Archives\!
item.properties|f.rocky_core: A delicious gummy treat with an impenetrable rocky shell. More than a few teeth have been lost by knights attempting to get at the gooey interior.
help.properties|m.tier_2_monster: Monsters split their damage between NORMAL and one other special damage type (PIERCING, ELEMENTAL or SHADOW).\nMonsters utilize STATUS EFFECTS more often. Equip armor with FIRE, FREEZE, SHOCK or POISON resistance\!
item.properties|f.furni_candles_small: A scattering of small candles that adds a bit of classic ambiance to any room.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_button: If a door won't open, search under blocks for a hidden floor button to open it.
mission.properties|m.once_only: This mission can only be played once per day.
guild.properties|x.rename_desc1: Your guild may only be renamed every 30 days.
conversation.properties|r.fc_bridge_2: I'm not here to make trouble with Vanaduke.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_5a: We discovered a town known as 'Haven' and have set up a base of operations there. The locals have provided us with food, shelter and power.  It's not Isora, but it's home for now. \n\nI've pinpointed your location.  Unfortunately you'll need to cross a massive chasm in order to reach Haven.  Perhaps now that your camp has power there is an elevator somewhere leading into the Clockworks.  You may just be able to reach us that way.
item.properties|f.exp_west_1f: An expansion that adds two rooms to the western side of the Guild Hall.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2b: As a sprite levels up, they will learn new combat skills as well as gain skill points.
item.properties|f.raging_dragon_helm: An enchanted helm crafted into the visage of a beast who some believe razed the world in its passing\: its rage became magma rain, its breath a typhoon.
item.properties|f.hailstone: A small rock that's always a little cold to the touch. It's great for chilling beverages without diluting their flavor.
mission.properties|m.collector_prisoner_: My rescue team was ambushed by some giant mechanical horror. We didn't stand a chance. I'm glad you got here when you did, otherwise I don't know if we would have made it.
item.properties|f.sinister_skelly_shield: A kite shield haunted by a benevolent ghost. It should help you put up a spirited defense against shadow.
item.properties|f.philoso_feather: A large, grey feather plucked from the greatest of the Owlite magicians.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_9a: If so, we must prevent further damage.  Now please, there are yet more sprites to be rescued.  And who knows what we'll discover when we get there\!
help.properties|m.controls_options: You can change your current control scheme from the Options menu.
item.properties|f.heavy_plate_shield: A huge reinforced shield perfect for brushing off blows and fending off foes.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_3a: At 4 and 5 star level, gear offers the best protection you can find and weapons pack the biggest punch.  If you want to stay alive where you're heading, you need to start building an arsenal of 4 and 5 star gear. \n\nAnd remember- as items reach 5 star they typically can branch even more than before.  Your combat options are about to really open up.  Plan your arsenal with care.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_4_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 5 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
mission.properties|m.great_escape_3a: One was clearly not enough last time... so now there are two\! TWO\! Brilliant\!
mission.properties|o.p_r6_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Sneak around and see if you can get inside that gatehouse\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeresea: It's even more beautiful down here\!
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r7: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s: Spikes go in. Flying razor disks of barely-understood primordial energy come hurtling out\!
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_2c: What lies at the core of the Clockworks?
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_r4: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.plated_pathfinder_armo: A hardened set of armor made to protect against even the most voracious monsters while exploring the unknown.
helptips.properties|m.battle_arena: Each stage of a battle arena is more challenging than the last, but a victory always earns you a chance to cut your losses and move on.  The only rule is, everyone must fight at least once\!
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_2: I've heard Spiral HQ has lined up for you some missions befitting a true Champion.  But in order to become one, you'll need the right gear. \n\nI am entrusting you with the tools you will need to become such a Champion.  With these recipes, you can craft the highest caliber of gear of the Spiral Order.  With it you can finally wear the armor of the Azure Guardian, wield the might of the Leviathan Blade, and face anything in the protection of the Aegis.
projectx.properties|m.shutdown_message_d: When the server is refreshed, you will be transfered to another instance. If you are currently in the Clockworks, please finish your Mission or Expedition before the refresh to prevent interruption.
guild.properties|e.already_withdrew: You have already withdrawn from an energy well today and must wait 24 hours.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeresea: I love getting out in the field.
logon.properties|m.version_mismatch: Your client needs to be updated. Please quit and restart.
item.properties|f.frozen_pulsar: A highly advanced pulsar that can produce a blizzard-like blast of ice once its rounds mature. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_2a: Nice to meet you, {0}.  What's your situation?
item.properties|f.wildfire: An elite handgun that can offer a tremendous surprise for the enemy on the battlefield as its small charges of energy transform into raging wildfires. Wildfire shots become more powerful the further they travel.
mission.properties|b.time_enough_at_last: A knight named Edger has gone missing while exploring the Scarlet Fortress.  Given that this crumbling castle is swarming with spookats and jelly cubes, his squadmates fear for his safety and have asked a more experienced knight like yourself to investigate. \n\nLocate Edger within the fortress and bring him back to Haven\!
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_2a: That mass of negative energy we've been investigating is a portion of an ancient kingdom called Almire, the very same realm described in that Owlite tome you discovered\!
item.properties|m.weapon_tip_locked: Weapon Slot (Buy Weapon Slot Upgrade to Unlock)
uplink.properties|m.auction_incomplete: We're sorry, but the item you tried to sell was not sold.\n\nTip for sellers\: Always sell shiny items that everyone wants at super good prices.
item.properties|f.proto_bomb: A small bomb used by Spiral Knight recruits to learn the art of blowing things up.
item.properties|f.holiday_present: A perfectly wrapped pile of presents that is sure to please anyone who opens it.
chat.properties|m.usage_come: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades to come to you.
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro4_1a: I'll scout ahead then\! Be careful, Rhendon.
item.properties|f.power_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
item.properties|f.obsidian_crusher: A peculiar bomb made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. Despite it being a bomb, some are drawn to holding it and 'solving' it as if it were some kind of puzzle.
item.properties|f.spiral_soaker: A deadly squirt gun sure to soak even the driest of foes.
helptips.properties|m.loading15: To add a friend to your friends list, simply click on that friend and choose "Add as Friend." To see the list of friends and what they are up to, click on the Social button.
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro_1a: Roger that, I'm on my way\!
item.properties|f.barbarous_thorn_shield: A mythical shield imbued with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. It's said that the beast can use the glowing orbs on the shield's face to see and stalk weak-hearted wielders.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_bystande: We almost didn't make it out alive. One moment everything was fine and the next thing we know gremlins are bursting out of the ground\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_charge: Hold [[?ACTION]] until fully charged and then release to attack\!
projectx.properties|d.achievement_efbf39: Hit an opponent with a snowball in Lockdown.
item.properties|f.mighty_defender: An advanced Spiral Knight shield, reinforced for battle and beautifully embossed for the stories afterward.
conversation.properties|m.vise_seerus:
Hello there lad\!  
Taking on ol' Seerus aye?  Careful now, he's not right in the head. Proper imbalanced that one.  

He and I go way back, but not in any way worth remembering.  Should your mission prove successful, see if you can bring me back a little souvenir.  I'll make ya something nice for your troubles.
chat.properties|m.emote_self: You can't do that to yourself.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Parma\! Your Scout\! You're alive\! Where are you\!? We need to get you back to Haven.
exchange.properties|m.billing_steam_erro: Steam Error\: User account is unable to make purchases at this time.
social.properties|m.friend_request_pendi: You have already sent a friend request to {0}.
item.properties|f.raider_helm: A pristine raider helmet, save for a few dings.
helptips.properties|m.branch_path_warnin: You are safe, for now. Two paths lie before you. Listen to the recon modules here and choose your path.
conversation.properties|m.hunter_4a: That's the spirit\! Give those monsters what for\!
mission.properties|b.p_r4_mat_012: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_2b: All traces of Compound 42 should be eliminated, along with the facility and any engineers not part of the inner fold. Remind the scorchers who find these orders uncomfortable that those who disobey shall soon hear my whisper in their ears. \n\nSeal the doors and burn everything to the ground.
item.properties|f.box_elite_trinket: Contains various elite, five-star trinkets and a Trinket Slot Upgrade. Items are randomly chosen. No key is required to open.
support.properties|m.option_202_0: We realize this player may be ruining some of the fun you're having, but the best way to deal with such annoying players is to ignore them so you don't have to bother with them again. Click here to ignore {0} instead.
item.properties|f.silvermail: Strong, yet light armor for knights who've sworn an oath to hunt down and destroy the undead, wherever it may lurk.
item.properties|f.slime_slasher: A sturdy shovel modified to dole out a little extra damage to slime family monsters.
helptips.properties|m.atg_heat: Pick up HEAT to level up your items and make them better over time\!
item.properties|f.frenzy_plate_mail: A legendary suit of armor said to imbue the wearer with the frenzy of a thousand demigods.
dungeon.properties|m.starlight_cradle_de: Beneath a moonlit sky azure islands drift in a sea of stars. These islands are home to creatures that are more than happy to creep upon those that succumb to this world's endless lullaby.
item.properties|f.swiftstrike_buckler: A small, easy to use shield that enables the user to perform fast attacks.
item.properties|f.wolver_cap: A lively hat made from significantly less lively Wolver hide.
steam.properties|e.already_converted: You have already converted one account to your Steam account. You cannot convert another.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_cloak: A crudely crafted cloak made to resemble a cut-throat warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
conversation.properties|r.impostoclaus_1: Not on my watch. I will save Winterfest\! How can I help?
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_3a: Once the charge aura has reached maximum charge, release the ATTACK button and unleash a devastating charge attack\!
item.properties|f.auction_room: A businesslike room providing access to the Haven Auction House.
redeem.properties|m.instruct: If you have a special code to redeem a reward, you can enter it here\:
item.properties|f.prize_box_hunter: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Hunter style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Hang in there\!
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_1_1a: I was told I am to receive Star Certification here?
item.properties|f.furious_fork: A good chef knows when to flip burgers. A great chef cooks burgers while they flip them.
item.properties|f.moonstone_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of moonstone.
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_2a: Yes, Project R appears to be in fact two massive weapons known as the 'Roarmulus Twins.'  Designed by one of the Crimson Order itself, the Roarmulus Twins are some kind of construct cannon that the gremlins intend on moving up the Clockworks into the Haven Arcade\! \n\nBased on what the schematics suggest, their power far exceeds standard gremlin weaponry and could be truly devastating to Haven, Spiral HQ and the Strangers should it reach the Arcade.
item.properties|f.prize_box_c: The complete collection of {0} costumes and accessories. One item will be randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|o.shopping_again: Follow Bechamel on a tour of the Bazaar's more advanced offerings
item.properties|f.deadshot_chapeau: A mythical hat for those that never miss their mark. It's rumored to have been made from cloth that was previously interred.
mission.properties|b.darkest_forces: Hearing that your next missions will have you facing the likes of fiendish and undead monsters in the depths of Tier 3, Chief Biotech Hahn has requested you contact him before deploying for your latest missions.
chat.properties|m.usage_ready: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades that you're ready.
item.properties|f.punkin_pie_slice: A hot steamy slice of pie.
item.properties|f.cryo_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful cryo bullets that split multiple times on impact.
lottery.properties|m.lottery_mail_winner: Congratulations {0}, you have won a Birdsong Trading Co. giveaway\! Your prize is attached.
item.properties|f.warm_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within burns strong enough that it feels warm to the touch.
support.properties|m.option_201_0: Instead you could simply click here to ignore {0} so you won't have to listen to them again.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Roarmulus Twins \nThese giant gun puppies showcase impenetrable armor and high powered munitions. Their skin is so thick they are only vulnerable to fraternal firepower.
item.properties|f.snarbolax_coat: A shadowy suit made from the hide of a sinister Snarbolax.  Even looking at it too closely is dangerous.
chat.properties|m.usage_grin: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nGrin at your fellow players.
conversation.properties|r.rfc_court_2a: Speaking of 'below', how do I get there now?  This place is collapsing\!
item.properties|f.twisted_targe: A tulgey targe that will give your sword thrusts some teeth.
item.properties|f.striker: A fast sword favored by members of the stealthier branches of the Spiral Order.
projectx.properties|m.heatsummary: Heat levels up your weapons and gear and  makes them stronger.
item.properties|f.plated_pathfinder_helm: A hardened helm made to protect intrepid explorers while they explore the unknown.
item.properties|f.vile_seal: A small scrap of ancient parchment imbued with dark magicks. It is believed that they grant power to those with evil souls.
mission.properties|b.sovereign_slime:
The source of the strange energy signature is believed to be located somewhere in the Royal Jelly Palace, the home to one of the members of the slime aristocracy, the Royal Jelly. 

The might of these sovereign slimes is not to be underestimated.  Should you find yourself facing this hot-tempered highborn, you would be wise to be equipped with the appropriate gear and backed by a full squad of experienced knights. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with pierce resistant gear and shadow damage weapons before deploying for the Royal Jelly Palace\!
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_3c: Something of immense power, little one. There is an enormous energy signal coming from the center of the Clockworks, but that is all we know. No one has ever made it to the core. Or at least if anyone has, they have never returned.\n\nThe ones to ask would be the gremlins, for they have likely gone deeper into the Clockworks than any creature. But that might prove difficult as they are quite a disagreeable lot.
helptips.properties|m.battle_arena_3: Truly you are among the greatest of all warriors who have ever lived\! The bounties of the Arena King are yours for the taking\!
item.properties|f.graviton_vortex: A Graviton Bomb fortified with potentially dangerous amounts of shadow steel. Its blast should draw your foes toward it... if it doesn't rip the entire universe in two, that is.
item.properties|f.vial_curse_ultra: A glass vial containing concentrated fiend essence. It can be used to inflict enemies with Curse.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes 10 years of bad luck\!
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_2: THEY WILL KILL US THEY WILL KILL YOU.
item.properties|f.feral_cannon: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it, you can feel the penetrating energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
item.properties|f.token_page: A crumbling page torn from a long-forgotten grimoire of the Moorcroft Manor archives. The indecipherable language written upon it glows faintly in the dark as if containing power in its very words.
item.properties|f.brute_jelly_mail: A firm set of mucilaginous mail crafted from the remains of particularly antagonistic jellies.
craft.properties|m.transmute_max_in_flig: Waiting for previous transmutations to finish...
conversation.properties|m.mission_surviv: B-beware...it stalks us...it watches our every move\!
helptips.properties|m.unlock_grim_gate: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use a Fiendish ID Card \n\nWARNING\: If this Grim Gate is unlocked the party will become locked and stay locked for the duration of the mission. Choose your party members wisely\!
item.properties|f.tri_guard_helm: A special helmet designed specifically for knights on first recon of alien planets. This rugged helmet protects against a variety of harsh elements.
conversation.properties|m.casino_bouncer: Welcome to the High Wobbler Lounge\!
item.properties|f.guild_storage: Permanently adds Member Storage, Veteran Storage and Officer Storage options to Guild Command Console. Storages allow guild members of sufficient rank to exchange unbound items with other guild members.
item.properties|f.omega_tortofist: A handgun empowered by the limitless fury of a tortodrone. While wielding it you are capable of unleashing the energy of a legion of tortodrones upon your foes.
item.properties|f.beast_basher: A powerful pick modified to add an extra helping of hurt to beast family monsters.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Be careful in there\!
projectx.properties|m.cross_the_chasm: Cross the chasm to reach Haven.
chat.properties|m.usage_level: Usage\: /{0} (weapon armor helmet shield) [level]\nSets the equipment to that level.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_2a: Missions range from dangerous combat engagements to talking to certain people, such as myself.  By completing missions, you'll earn progress towards new ranks, which will in turn give you access to increasingly powerful gear.  Greta informed me that you'll be tackling our power supply problem in the Ancient Generator?
chat.properties|m.usage_guild: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message to all guild members.
mission.properties|o.high_temperature_ho: Rescue the captured knights within the fiery Deconstruction Zone
sprites.properties|d.vengeful_quills: Each time a quilled target is hit, another quill is fired from the target to the next available target.
item.properties|f.hail_driver: Once you've seen the splitting bolts of unnaturally cold ice it produces, you'll understand why this Driver is hailed.
mission.properties|b.creators_and_create: In order to be fully prepared for the challenges ahead, Chief Biotech Hahn is requesting you contact him before undertaking the new missions that you have available to you.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_6c: No thanks, I'll explore on my own.
helptips.properties|m.party_button: The party button will activate when all living party members are standing on it.
helptips.properties|m.party_locked_warni: WARNING\! Upon using this elevator your party will be locked for the remainder of the mission.
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last: I'm saying that I have a lot of reading to do now.  The fight is over, that's all. \n\nPlease, head back to Haven and let everyone know things are ok.
item.properties|f.spiral_brigandine: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.eye_pack_suited: Contains a suite of suitable eye shapes for your style kit\: Club, Diamond, Heart, and Spade.
item.properties|f.glowing_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within burns bright enough to light a darkened room.
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_2c: Are there any friendly gremlins within the Clockworks?
dungeon.properties|m.rc_bomb_training_de: Just beyond the perimeter of the Rescue Camp is a field of ruined equipment and overrun defenses.  The surviving knights abandoned this area after a series of deadly attacks during the night.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_4a: Thanks, {0}.  I thought we were done for back there. \n\nLet's get the artifact back to Spiral HQ before someone else tries to nab it.
uplink.properties|m.bounced:

conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: Emberlight founded by gremlin outcasts from Great Colony. Gremlins of Emberlight not obey the Iron Law, so flee or die. We start over with Emberlight. New colony home to few of us\: most ex-schemers, some merchants, some fighters, all traitors in eyes of Great Colony gremlins.
item.properties|f.umbra_driver: This horrifyingly powerful handgun fires bullets that are completely devoid of color, odor and mercy.
guildhelp.properties|m.treasury_info: The Guild Treasury contains all the items and crowns collectively owned by the guild. In order to be placed within a Guild Hall, furniture must first be added to the Treasury. The costs of new rooms, items from the Birdsong Emporium and weekly upkeep are also paid from the Treasury, so guild members will have to be certain to keep the Guild Treasury full of crowns\!\n WARNING\: Anything added to the Guild Treasury can never be removed by any member of the guild, including the guild master. By adding items or crowns to the Guild Treasury, they forever become property of the guild. There are no exceptions.

helptips.properties|m.tg1_welcome: Welcome to the Training Grounds, recruit. In this derelict section of the Clockworks you'll find areas we have built in order to train you in the fine art of not dying a horrible death. So pay attention to these helpful tips, ready your weapon, and get moving\!

mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
item.properties|f.justifier_jacket: A finely-made suit for danger-seeking gunslingers who would much rather be quick than dead.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Right.  Spiral HQ has informed me you'll likely be facing hordes of gremlins and constructs on this next go around.  Keep in mind that in Tier 3, these monsters can inflict pure elemental damage.  Do be sure to gear up appropriately.

item.properties|f.nefarious_hood: A hood said to be crafted by a nefarious imp. The floating rune is certain to cloak you during clandestine campaigns.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch:
Black kats are the darkest souls of the former Kat Tribe. They carry the heaviest curse of all and mindlessly seek to devour magical auras. This constant consuming of power makes them incredibly strong. 

They were likely attracted to the power radiating from the ancient grimoires here in the Archives. 

Please {0}, you must help us restore the Moorcroft Archives\!
item.properties|f.starlit_hunting_cap: An advanced hunting cap, illuminated and downy, that resists the strongest sleep mists.

The recipes I have for you produce weapons and gear that focus on rapid, close-quarters combat. \n\nThe arsenal of a striker focuses on speed.  You want to get in close with your enemy, hit them hard and get out.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that leaps into battle ahead of your squad, striking first before they can even fire off a shot.
conversation.properties|m.rc_injured_a: Last night terrible monsters attacked us in the darkness.  It was utter chaos. With no power for the turrets we couldn't defend ourselves. \n\nSo many brave Knights lost...

craft.properties|m.empty: You have not yet learned any recipes.
item.properties|f.stellar_sentinel_suit: This suit was was once worn by Isoran starfarers of eons long passed that stood watch over extrasolar operations. With this equipped, you feel like you could dive into the heart of a star.
item.properties|f.celestial_nav_helm: A special helm built to commemorate Isoran spacefarers of old.  With this equipped, you can see a clear path across the night sky to countless worlds beyond.
item.properties|f.prize_box_ancient: Contains various unique items fashioned in the ancient, veiled homeland of the tortodrones. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
uplink.properties|m.returned: Your attachment was never accepted\n\nOriginal mail\: {0}
helptips.properties|m.tut_switches: Doors can often be opened by finding the right switch nearby. Have a look around. They are sometimes hidden under blocks.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roya: A scaled-down model of the Royal Jelly. He'd probably be flattered by it if he hadn't already been flattened.
item.properties|f.valestone_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of moonstone.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
chat.properties|m.usage_summon: Usage\: /{0} player name\nSummons a player to your current location.
social.properties|e.cannot_friend_gm: You can't be friends with a Game Master. They are like stone.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_steam_cont: Gamepad used for targeting, attacking, movement, advanced commands and quickslots
conversation.properties|m.rc_virgil_3a: It seems to lead to some kind of elevator, but with no power, the whole thing is just dead.
item.properties|f.omega_shell: A shield created from the armor of a Tortomega. The sheer weight of this powerful shield makes it only an option for the strongest of warriors.
chat.properties|m.usage_action: Usage\: /{0} command argument\nPosts an action to the scene controller.
conversation.properties|m.npc_mineraltec: I'm a field researcher working under Chief Geo Knight Wegner.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_snar: A long, razor-sharp tooth, proof that you encountered the fabled Snarbolax and survived to galumph back.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_773357: Defeat the Roarmulus Twins in the dangerous depths of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.
item.properties|f.prize_box_budding: Contains various unique costumes and accesories to celebrate the budding nature of spring.  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_1_7a: Cradle is growing more mysterious by the day.
item.properties|f.infernal_guardian_armo: Charred, stygian armor worn by those who defend the infernal depths.
conversation.properties|m.core_resting_3: I hope those supplies come soon.
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_4a: There's one last thing- it seems you won't be the first knight to have entered the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.  We've detected another Alpha Squad recon module somewhere within the factory.  Please attempt to recover it.  I hope that analysis proves that Euclid's squad made it out of there alive...
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Amazing...I never thought I'd see another one of us ever again\! I'm glad to see you made it here safely.
exchange.properties|m.opening_mobile: Opening mobile phone checkout in your browser...
mission.properties|o.pioneers: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
item.properties|f.fiery_pepperbox: When you've been attacked by a swarm of Ice Cubes, all Knights agree\: happiness is a Fiery Pepperbox.
chat.properties|m.usage_complain: Usage\: /{0} player name\nFile a complaint against the specified player.
item.properties|f.steamvalve_mask: Though now outdated by more sophisticated devices, these special pressurized masks were once used by soldiers in environments with extreme atmospheres. The pressure valve on the back would have to be turned just so or the soldier's head would, well, implode.
projectx.properties|m.head_north_arcade: Head North to the Arcade and report to Feron.
item.properties|f.dread_venom_striker: An assassin's armament whose edge causes deep wounds that seep with vitriol. You should probably store it separately from your snacks.
item.properties|f.polar_day_warden_hood: An insulated hood that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The full coverage mask makes it ideal for hours of daytime watch duty.
item.properties|f.spiral_pith_helm: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
helptips.properties|m.dead: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to cycle to Spectator View.
item.properties|f.frenzy_champion_helm: The helm of one who defied the gods and stormed the gates of a heavenly kingdom. Some say that whistling winds are the eternal warcries of her siege.
item.properties|f.snarble_barb: A bestial blade that can shoot slithy spines at those who would oppose its wielder.
item.properties|f.blackened_crest: A shield once carried by a knight of Almire, now a cursed relic that has been nearly burned beyond recognition within the Firestorm Citadel. Very powerful alchemy would be required to restore it to its former glory.
mission.properties|o.alone_in_dark: Make contact with a lost soul of Almire in the soldier's graveyard
dungeon.properties|p.join_leave_party: Leave your current party to join {0}?

mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: The drakon sounds like the battle sprite for me\!
item.properties|f.crown_fallen: A cursed crown once worn by a celestial being cast down from paradise.
item.properties|f.ionized_salt_bomb: A solid chunk of rock salt with an explosive surprise inside. Jellies hate surprises.

item.properties|f.rename_knight: Allows you to choose a new name for your knight. This item is destroyed once used.
mission.properties|r.alchemy_mastery_1a: I could always use a good sword.
item.properties|f.fused_demo_helm: An upgraded Demo Helm fused dangerously with the unstable core from a powerful Blast Cube. It produces an unpleasant hum in your ears.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_cb03dd: Earn clearance to explore Tier 3 of the Clockworks.
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_12b: Thanks Bechamel, I'll be seeing you\!
item.properties|f.fang_of_vog: A sword said to be created from the fang of the fire beast, Vog.
helptips.properties|m.energy: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to spend energy on this device.
monster.properties|m.overtime_2: I'm not saying to work this weekend, but everyone else is, so...
item.properties|m.expire_days.1: This item expires {0} day after it is equipped.\n
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: I don't know if I feel better or worse after finding out what happened to everyone in the Core. Poor Grantz...Parma...Euclid...Rulen...
item.properties|f.super_splinter_bomb: A shard bomb stuffed with even more synthetic mineral. It can also be used to mince vegetables, if you don't mind picking the occasional crystal out of your teeth.
item.properties|f.magnus: A large handgun with hard hitting rounds that can leave even the strongest of monsters dazed. A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_3c: Energy can only be obtained by purchase with a real money transaction or for trade via the Exchange. To purchase or trade for energy, simply open the Supply Depot and click the 'Get Energy' button.
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of crimsonite.
social.properties|m.discord_join_req: A discord player is asking to join your party. Please check the discord client.
mission.properties|o.abandoned_depot: Learn the basics of survival in the Abandoned Depot
mission.properties|o.p_r9_weap_4: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
guild.properties|m.formation:
You may form a new guild for {0} crowns and {1} energy. The crowns will be seeded into the guild's treasury. By creating a guild you will become the Guild Master and will have the ability to invite new members into your guild. Guild features include\:
Personal Guild Hall for Guild Members only
Guild Member chat channel
Guild Officer chat channel
Guild Member rankings
Guild Member status updates
item.properties|f.hive_helm: Insects know each other by scent, but the eyes are still for glaring at rivals.
social.properties|m.play_pvp: Sign up for a game of {0} {1} in the Coliseum\!
item.properties|f.raging_champion_helm: The helm of one who defied the gods and razed the gates of a heavenly kingdom.
conversation.properties|m.atg_greeter_2a: To the West, you will learn about useful items found in the Clockworks. To the North, you will learn about a variety of block types and doors. To the East, you will find an array of traps and hazards as well as a combat room to practice defense against training cubes.  Don't worry, we have taken precautions to make sure the cubes are perfectly harmless\!
sprites.properties|d.extra_crispy: Increases the potency of the fire and chance to set targets ablaze.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_2a: Lord Vanaduke rules over the citadel now.  His soul bound to some horrific armored prison. \n\nHe has the citadel ready for battle at all times, believing that his kingdom is still under siege.  He doesn't even realize that what he is trying to protect was lost a thousand years ago.
town.properties|m.rescue_camp_desc: The Rescue Camp serves as a refuge for newly dropped Spiral Knights. It offers a few creature comforts as well as a training facility to prepare recruits for their journey to Haven.
item.properties|f.bronze_bolt: A simple bronze bolt found everywhere throughout the Clockworks.
mission.properties|b.plan_of_attack: Deep within a toxic cavern lies a hidden test lab that gremlins have been using as a testing ground for components of Project R.  One of these components still in development is reported to have schematics for the project close by. \n\nIf this is true there will likely be a terminal of some kind close to one of Project R's components.  Locate the terminal and recover the schematics for analysis.  It should shed light on the exact nature of Project R.
item.properties|f.blast_powder: A dangerous by-product produced by fire-based organic creatures. Gremlins like to use it to blow stuff up.
mission.properties|o.aggressive_assembly: Rescue the lost squad and decommission the factory foreman
exchange.properties|m.paypal_tooltip: Checkout with PayPal in your browser.
dungeon.properties|m.confirm_boot: Are you sure you want to remove {0} from the party?
mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite:
...returning as something unnatural... 

...endless inferno.... 

...Almire destroyed... 

...they can never leave, they can never escape the flames...
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendnoti: Due to continual under-performance, there will be no paid holidays or free coffee in the break room.
mission.properties|o.darkest_depths: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
conversation.properties|m.tortodrone_hav: Tucked away inside a mysterious garden we found a strange portal that HQ is calling a Grim Gate. From what we were able to decode you will need a key of sorts to open it. Spiral HQ thinks the glyphs we spotted the Fiends carrying might have something to do with opening the gate.
item.properties|f.electron_bomb: Adapted from several unconventional Gremlin theories on physics, anyone unlucky enough to be dragged into this bomb's blast is in for a shock.
item.properties|f.energy_well: After energy is added to the energy well, guild members may withdraw 100 units of energy daily.
exchange.properties|m.anonymous_purchasi: Purchasing is disabled until you create an account.
sprites.properties|d.dark_harness_eli: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal shadow damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 10% \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Maskeraith
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_3b: Energy is used for all sorts of things\! It's the primary currency for buying goods from the Supply Depot, it allows you to purchase upgrades for yourself, revive yourself in the Clockworks when you run out of Sparks of Life, and it's required to form a guild. \n\nYou'll also find all sorts of devices in the world that are powered up by using energy. Just look for the blue energy symbol on the device.
item.properties|f.pummel_gun: A Punch Gun properly modified for combat use. The recoil from its powerful charge attack is notorious amongst recruits.
mission.properties|b.axes_of_evil: A gremlin logging operation has been discovered in levels known as the 'Jigsaw Valley.'  These strangely carved islands are home to an even stranger species of twisting trees that gremlins seem to be determined to completely wipe out. \n\nSpiral HQ believes that gremlins are using the lumber from this operation as resources for the development of Project R and needs you to enter the Jigsaw Valley and shut it down.
dungeon.properties|m.treasure_vault_1: Treasure Trove|Fortune Smiles on the Greedy
mission.properties|m.silent_legion_1a: Have they sent you for me?  To bring me back?  No, I am where I belong now. I no longer serve the Spiral Order and will remain here. \n\nLeave this place and never come back.  Leave me be.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r6: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.chaos_cloak: A forbidden mantle said to grant the wearer protection within the nameless realm where all elements are said to converge into one and divide into all.
item.properties|f.exp_east_3f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.silverweave: A length of understated cloth intricately interwoven with precious metal. It's tastefully ostentatious, yet prudently protective.
item.properties|f.solid_cobalt_helm: A sturdy Cobalt Helm with upgraded internal systems and external reinforcement.
item.properties|m.equip_locked: Equipping {0} will bind it to you. You will not be able to trade this item once bound. Are you sure?
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeexplo: Don't let spikes drop near monsters\!
item.properties|f.divine_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
helptips.properties|m.tut_explosive: Explosive blocks will harm anything around them when they are set off. This includes you\! Take them out from a safe distance with your handgun.
social.properties|m.autofriend_single_su: Your {0} friend is playing Spiral Knights\!
guild.properties|m.exp_removed: Success\! Expansion removed. Upkeep will be recalculated after your next publish.
guild.properties|log.theme_changed: Changed the theme to {0} for {1} crowns, replacing {2}.
mission.properties|o.p_tortodrone_r7: Investigate the Ancient Grove and put a stop to a Fiendish plot.
dungeon.properties|m.vanaduke_desc: Within the throne room of the citadel Lord Vanaduke stands waiting to mount a final defense against any who manage to breach his citadel's defenses.
conversation.properties|m.dark_harvest_e:
Welcome to the Dark Harvest Festival\!  This annual celebration honors the undead with festive masks, delicious treats and dangerous tricks\!

To participate, explore the Clockworks and try to find the legendary 'Punkin King.'  This ghoulish gourd gives out candy to visitors.  You can exchange the candy to the traders here in the Haven Town Square for monster masks\!

Should you prefer the direct approach, or just need a few more, our vendor will sell you candy as well.
item.properties|f.emberbreak_armor: Armor with a hacked elemental core aimed at resisting fire. However, this non-standard modification creates other elemental weaknesses.
conversation.properties|m.final_test_kni:
Astounding\!  I would have never expected a new recruit to crawl out of that fiery wreckage alive\!  You must really be something else... 

The name's Feron, Lieutenant of the Spiral Order.  We had believed this entire complex was derelict until the elevator leading to it suddenly surged to life.  Upon investigating the whole place soon went up in a blaze\! 

How did you end up here?
item.properties|f.haze_bomb: An alchemical bomb that creates a noxious cloud capable of stunning those caught inside.
mission.properties|o.creators_and_create: Learn about the most powerful construct and gremlin monsters
projectx.properties|e.name_too_long: Sorry, the name is too long.
item.properties|f.budding_coat: A ripped clean suit can mean death, but fortunately this one was colonized by an unusual symbiotic plant. Wear this and you'll be guaranteed to have a green thumb\!
logon.properties|m.failed_to_connect: Failed to connect to the server.
mission.properties|b.time_to_crafty: Bosco would like you to alchemize a Hot Edge and Frost Gun for him to inspect. If it's good, he'll inform Spiral HQ that you've grasped the vital art of alchemy and even add a couple powerful Unique Variants to your new weapons.  What a generous guy\!
helptips.properties|m.can_resurrect: You have been granted a Spark of Life by a party member. Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to revive.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_gamepad_1: Gamepad used for targeting, attacking, movement, advanced commands and quickslots
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_9a: Hi {0}\!  Look at you, wow\!  Hey, Vanguard or not you know where to go if you want to really stand out right?
chat.properties|m.unspecific_flag: Flag not specific enough, did you mean "{0}?"
helptips.properties|m.pressure_pads: These special buttons will only trigger if something is holding them down. Try using that statue to hold one down.
item.properties|f.rock_salt: A small amount of Clockworks mineral that's been infused with absolutely nothing. It hungrily draws at nearby essences and flavors, making it a staple in cooking, and the bane of jellies everywhere.
item.properties|f.valkyrie_helm: A priceless helmet whose name denizens of the Underworld dare not mention.
item.properties|f.ironmight_plate_shield: A superior shield forged from sun silver. The meaning of the crest on its face has been lost to time.
global.properties|m.idled_out: You have been disconnected due to idleness.
item.properties|f.storm_dragon_helm: An enchanted helm crafted into the visage of a beast who some believe created the world in its passing\: its fire the sun, its bones the mountains.
item.properties|f.gold_dragon_armor: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Gold Dragons,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
mission.properties|r.true_champion_2a: I'm looking forward to lots more intel then, Kora.
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: Well met\! When I heard they were sending you {0}, I didn't believe it. THE Vanquisher of Vanaduke\! It's an honor to be reporting to you.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_skescape: A piece of Spiral technology used to escape disabled starships. They're very cramped inside.
item.properties|f.corrosive_acid: A caustic substance characteristic of corrosive creatures.
item.properties|f.heavy_pulsar: A Pulsar upgraded with Spiral technology to pack a greater punch. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
item.properties|f.starlit_demo_suit: An advanced demolitions suit capable of resisting the strongest sleep mists. The soft glow is strangely stimulating.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_2_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 3 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
helptips.properties|m.mission_trap_chamb: They can be killed but often you can just avoid them.
item.properties|f.artillery_beacon: A portable beacon that when deployed, summons a barrage of powerful rockets
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_1a: Well Hahn, that's an awfully warm-
helptips.properties|m.sl_elevator_active: Shadow Key required to open.\nShadow Keys can be acquired randomly in lockboxes or purchased from the Supply Depot.
exchange.properties|m.other_tooltip: Opens the online Energy Depot in your browser where you can use a variety of payment methods to get more Energy.
item.properties|f.prize_box_owlite: Contains unique Owlite costumes and accessories, recreated from the latest archaeological evidence. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
helptips.properties|m.tut_ghost: Ghost blocks will destroy any blocks connected to them, even unbreakable blocks\!
guild.properties|i.console_publish: Publish design changes to the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.warmaster_helm_2: A remake of a mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus of the Crimson Order.  Though it very much resembles the original, it is still missing pieces.
dungeon.properties|m.ancient_generator_d: Beneath the Rescue Camp is a massive energy source, capable of powering the elevator to Haven if only it could be harnessed.
mission.properties|r.rc_buddyknight_2a: Thanks Rhendon, this will come in handy\!
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_6: Fire Crystals are somewhat unstable, the amount needed for a successful forge varies. \nAdditionally, we've discovered that adding more Fire Crystals results in chances at special bonuses that will be applied to the item\! \n
item.properties|f.rageous_plate_mail: A legendary suit of armor said to imbue the wearer with the rage of the titans.
item.properties|f.authentic_mask: A high quality {0} mask made to celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival. It's very well made and lasts forever\!
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_16: Thanks Tylen, I'll be seeing you\!
