mission.properties|o.becoming_champion: Speak with Lieutenant Feron via Comlink
exchange.properties|m.trade4energy_toolt: Enter the amount of energy you want to buy, in multiples of 100.
item.properties|m.item_lockable: This item will bind to you when equipped.\n
conversation.properties|m.tier_2_require: Well met, {0}.  In order to proceed and explore deeper depths of the Clockworks you must first achieve Rank 7-1. \n\nReturn here once you have completed the requisite Rank Missions.
conversation.properties|r.vise_seerus: Sure, Vise.  I'll see what I can do.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
projectx.properties|m.save_offer: In order to save the knight that you have created, you must create an account to use when logging into the game.
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_2a: What would you like to know?
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_3b: All gremlins belonging to the colony serve King Tinkinzar. Tinkinzar is said to be a great ruler and mechanical genius, responsible for the vision of the whole of the Clockworks. It is our understanding however that the king is never seen by common gremlins, but instead his orders are delivered and carried out by his Crimson Order, a fearful and zealous band of gremlins who alone share audience with the great king.
item.properties|f.brimstone: A smelly, stygian, sulfuric shard commonly found in the Underworld.
shop.properties|m.cart_recipe_learned: You have already learned this recipe\!
item.properties|f.night_cap_sallet: A comfortable cap for knights to wear at night. Sure to give the wearer lucid dreams to face their nightmares.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_remin: Once you find a sprite, carry them back to the sacred circle you see before you. They are no doubt weakened from Vanaduke's curse and will require rejuvenation. Once we are all reunited we will form a focus link with the Spirit Mother and bring water to the wells.\n\nPlease hurry\!
mission.properties|o.p_r3_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
item.properties|f.toxic_vaporizer_mkii: A Toxic Vaporizer modified to disperse noxious agents over a wider range.
chat.properties|m.usage_respond: Usage\: /{0} message\nResponds to the player who sent the last /tell.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_99c5a1: Travel the entire Clockworks from depth 0 to depth 29 in a single expedition without having to revive.
social.properties|m.invite_name: Enter the name of the knight you wish to invite\:
mission.properties|r.elemental_my_dear_3: I think I've got it thanks for-
item.properties|f.token_grim: A small wisp of the essential spirit of darkness and decay. It is of extreme value to the Spiral Order. Take it to the Token Trader in the Haven Bazaar\!
item.properties|f.illuminating_ward: A personal candle for warding off the darkness, and that which lurks within it.
item.properties|f.freezing_atomizer: A powerful alchemical bomb that produces a dense cloud of extremely frigid mist.
uplink.properties|m.autoprune: Note\: Mail is automatically deleted 30 days after sent date.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro3_3c: Remember, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!
item.properties|f.ash_tail_cap: A warm hat made from hide tanned with blaze pepper. It smells faintly of curry.
conversation.properties|m.npc_supplies_b: It's been days since we had fresh supplies.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_6a:
Wow, this thing is a massive tower of everfrost.  I've only ever seen little handfuls of the stuff, nothing close to what we're seeing here. 

The intel we've collected so far suggests that fiends utilize large deposits of the stuff to trap the souls of the lost within it, like some kind of icy prison. 

It would seem that Maulos, that horrible arch-fiend you just took down, had a different use in mind and was actually destroying this everfrost to unleash swarms of angry, frozen souls into the Clockworks.  Had he finished the job, well, I don't even want to think about how many sweaters we would all be needing right now...
item.properties|f.scary_skelly_suit: An upgraded Skelly Suit infused with the elemental essence of fear. It comes standard with matching pants that cannot be scared off.
item.properties|f.firetail_mail: A scorching simian mail typically worn by commanders in combat. It will ward off many wounds made to the wearer.
mission.properties|b.guardians_of_cradle: You have been invited to attend a meeting with several members of Spiral HQ to discuss what to do next about the Core and the threat of the Swarm. Join them in the Hall of Heroes to learn about Operations Missions.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_5: In most cases this is just a standard favored item, but when your sprite is ready to evolve, an Evo Catalyst will be required.
item.properties|f.confetti_dark_harvest_: Celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival by launching a sizeable gourd into the air. What comes next is up to the Punkin King...
conversation.properties|m.core_resting_2: Can't wait to get back to Haven...
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_0_1a: Well met, {0}. This is the Hall of Heroes, where veteran knights come to offer their services to members of our order who have attained the rank of Soldier or higher. \n\nBy undertaking more missions, I am confident that you will one day stand among us.
conversation.properties|m.hunter_3a: Indeed\! Monster trophies will require a great deal of materials, so it is only reasonable that a group effort is required. \n\nLastly, some of the materials you will need can only be acquired by spending boss tokens with Brinks in the Haven Bazaar. They act as proof of your valor in defeating such fearsome creatures\!
item.properties|f.flawed_snowball: A hard-packed snowball that is unfortunately too flawed for use in alchemy. It would be best to simply throw it away... at someone's head.
sprites.properties|d.crystal_harness: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal elemental damage. \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Seraphynx
item.properties|f.monster_bone: An intact bone from a now-deceased beast.
help.properties|m.energy_1: Energy is used to purchase items from the Supply Depot such as weapons, gear, orbs of alchemy, sparks of life, and fire crystals. \n\nTo purchase or trade for energy, simply open the Supply Depot and click the 'Get Energy' button.
item.properties|f.clockworks_box: A celebration of all things related to the Clockworks\! Contains costumes and accessories built from the same girders, plates, cogs, and gears that make up the Clockworks deep within the planet of Cradle. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_1a: Hello again, {0}.  I understand you're well on your way to reaching the Core and need an arsenal that will keep you alive.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_3a: Spiral HQ believes you are our best choice to help track down the energy signature, since you were the one to bring us the Artifact in the first place.  Rhendon will be dispatched to get on the trail of the gremlins below.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_danger: The Grinchlins have sabotaged Winterfest for the last time. Take the fight to them\!
item.properties|f.blast_bomb: An all-purpose bomb issued to Spiral Knights who have proven themselves in the field.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_lift_2: The door ahead is locked, but you can open it with the hit switch to your left. Try throwing a clay pot at the switch. They're quite useful in this way if you don't have a gun handy.
exchange.properties|e.disabled: Sorry, the exchange has been temporarily disabled.
item.properties|f.wyvern_scale_shield: A spiny buckler forged from beast chitin, providing ample resistance to both heat and venom.
logon.properties|m.peer_redirect: You are logged into a different peer. Redirecting...
item.properties|f.frost_sword: This sword is as cold as ice, and it's willing to sacrifice your love, in addition to any monsters that happen to get in your way.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Think you can just open the front door and walk in?\! You will suffer for this\!
item.properties|f.toxic_atomizer: A powerful alchemical bomb that produces a choking poisonous cloud.
chat.properties|m.usage_unmute: Usage\: /{0} player name\nStops blocking messages from the specified player.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_3a: Sadly, even with our link to the Spirit Mother restored we can only do so much to save this place. Yet, even as one path closes another might open. It is the nature of this shifting world.  Good fortune, star-borne.
item.properties|f.spark_plug: A small, mechanical component that really gets a construct's motor running.
chat.properties|x.stopwords: *nigger* *nigga* *fagg* *f@g* *fagot* *faget* *fagget* kike spic rape rapes raped raping rhape
item.properties|f.bechamel_room: A trendy room where Bechamel can add or remove Accessories from your favorite equipment.
projectx.properties|i.render_effects: Enables more detailed graphical effects, but\nmay reduce graphics performance with less powerful systems.
item.properties|f.raiders_hammer: An ornate hammer infused with the power of a great storm, it's as cutting-edge as a blunt weapon can be.
item.properties|f.savage_tortofist: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it you can feel the primal energy of a rampaging wolver pack within waiting to be unleashed.
exchange.properties|m.fee: For every trade, the energy seller pays the {0}% trading fee from the crowns.
guild.properties|e.leave_current_first: You must leave your current guild before accepting this invitation.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_wasd_move_: Mouse used for targeting, attacking and menu navigation
item.properties|f.electron_charge: A small electro-explosive charge with mysterious origins. It is capable of generating a crippling vortex of electricity.
guild.properties|i.guild_log: Examine recorded events within the guild.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_5a:
Ok, back to business then. 

Punch can add Unique Variants, a kind of special bonus to your weapons and gear for a price. But his methods are, er... chaotic.  You never really know what you're going to get. 

Vise is a little more precise.  He can unbind your weapons and gear for a price, allowing you to sell or gift the item again\!
item.properties|m.unlock_box_prompt: A Silver Key is required to open this Lockbox. Lockboxes contain random prizes inside.
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro3_1a: Glad to see you in one piece as well, Rhendon.  Where are the other survivors?
design.properties|e.furni_max_deployed: There are no available units of that furnishing to deploy.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: But what about you and the others?
item.properties|f.freeze_raider_helm: A fur lined helmet, sure to keep you warm on a winter raid.
global.properties|m.peer_shutting_down: The requested peer is shutting down.
mission.properties|o.rise_or_fall: Test your might with a slimy showdown in the Battle Arena
chat.properties|m.rank_set: Your rank has been set to {0}-{1}.
item.properties|f.metal_sonic_mask: A sinister looking mask crafted by a mechanical genius whose ability is said to rival that of even the greatest gremlin Gear Sages.
item.properties|f.furni_wardrobe_sklocke: A locked cabinet containing currently unequipped clothing and armor.
item.properties|f.heavy_demo_helm: A reinforced helmet that might be handy if you, the master of exploding, take it with you.
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r6: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
mission.properties|b.shopping_again_b: Now it's time to learn about some of the more advanced services the Bazaar offers.  Follow knight Bechamel and pay a visit to Punch and Vise, Brinks and even visit Bechamel's own shop\!
mission.properties|b.crossing_chasm_b: Having restored power to the Rescue Camp and established contact with Spiral HQ, it's time you attempted to cross the chasm north of the Rescue Camp and reach Haven where the rest of the Spiral Knights have taken refuge. \n\nIn order to cross the chasm you will need to take an elevator down into the Clockworks and find another to bring you up on the other side.  There's no telling what dangers lurk in the dark depths below so Rhendon will be accompanying you on your journey.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.
mission.properties|r.ending_in_fire_1a: Thanks Kora, I plan on being the first to reach the Core\!
item.properties|f.furni_pet_zombie_bellh: A bellhop with unusual dedication in charge of carrying luggage to a guest's quarters. Most just offer to carry the bags themselves.
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r9: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.
mission.properties|o.the_collector: Save the sprites and the researchers from the Collector
item.properties|f.slime_lockbox: A slippery, slimy lockbox won at the Golden Slime Casino.  It contains one of many special items.  It can be opened with a Slime Key or a Silver Key.
item.properties|f.furious_flamberge: Great fencers can carve their name into their opponents. Legendary ones brand it there.
mission.properties|m.breaking_in_recruit: This is no longer routine training\! Get those Recruits to the elevator. We're extracting them back to Haven. You on the other hand need to head down and see who's at the bottom of this.
item.properties|f.dark_ember: A mote of burning energy salvaged from Lord Vanaduke's throne room. It slowly smolders with a sinister intensity, creating an almost hypnotic trance when gazed upon for any length of time.
item.properties|f.eye_pack_shapely: Contains three shapely eyes for your style kit\: Triangle, Square, and Hexagon.
item.properties|f.kat_tribe_fetish: A tattered fetish from the now-extinct Kat Tribe, the ferocious feline warriors responsible for the destruction of the Owlites and their prestigious High Academy of Magicks. The fetishes were carried into battle by Kat warriors and are said to bring good luck despite the ill fate of the Kat Tribe itself.
conversation.properties|m.rc_vet_1a: Thanks for your help earlier. Stay safe\!
chat.properties|m.usage_hoh: Go to the Hall of Heroes
mission.properties|o.shadow_beast: Defeat the Snarbolax in the Gloaming Wildwoods and recover the recon module
item.properties|f.scrap_metal: A discarded piece of metal that could be easily repurposed.
projectx.properties|e.wrong_level_item: Must use required item to level up\!
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Very good, {0}. You will find a new set of missions for you under Operations. These new missions will be grouped according to their overall objective and can be tackled in parallel to each other. This should allow you maximum flexibility in order to respond to each new threat as they come up. Farewell, {0}, 'Guardian of Cradle'.
mission.properties|r.pumping_up_8a: Let's go over that again. [Restart tour]
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_housepla: A jolly green plant inside a cheerful pot.
item.properties|f.ultra_freeze_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly icy orbs that can freeze hostiles in their tracks
conversation.properties|m.casino_imposto: Waiter? Oh sorry about that good sir.
item.properties|f.spell_book: An old dictionary that seems to have quite a few spells within it.
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_2a: Oh {0}, I'm just doing my job.  And speaking of which, I have a job for you\!
item.properties|f.moonstone_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of moonstone.
item.properties|f.ash_agni: When this bomb has left the battlefield in ashes, then, and only then, will your enemies have permission to die.
conversation.properties|r.moorcroft_arch: I'll help any way I can, Pembrooke.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_wasd_move_: Keyboard used for movement, advanced commands, quickslots and chat
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_yel: A Spiral-issued light source typically used to recommend caution.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_5bfbda: Complete a Tier 2 expedition without having to revive.
craft.properties|m.transmute_accessories: {0} does not support certain accessories.  {1} will be destroyed if you transmute. Are you sure?
item.properties|f.aegis: A sublime shield entrusted to only the most worthy members of the Spiral Order. Whether its crest is a relic from the Order of old or a creation from the Knights' time on Cradle is not immediately clear.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
steam.properties|e.too_many_knights: There are too many knights to perform the conversion.  This account \nhas {0}, your Steam account has {1}, and you can only have {2} total.
item.properties|f.token_primal: A small wisp of the essential spirit of nature. It is of extreme value to the Spiral Order. Take it to the Token Trader in the Haven Bazaar\!
conversation.properties|m.winterfest_cam: Those Grinchlins are tricky and unpredictable. I'd recommend bringing a variety of gear just to be prepared for whatever they might throw at you.
social.properties|m.booted: {0} has been banned from the party.
dungeon.properties|m.graveyard_desc: A graveyard is a terrible place that simultaneously exists in the world of the living and the dead. Though they contain secret treasures in their dark corners, they are home to ancient horrors that wish to consume all who enter. Once inside, finding an exit as fast as possible is advised.
item.properties|f.frayed_fabric: The worn remains of a Clockworks denizen's duds. It could probably be recycled.
projectx.properties|m.mission_rjp: Recover the recon module in the Royal Jelly Palace.
conversation.properties|m.biscotti_2:
Great\! There are two ways to help me out\: 

You can accept the new Prestige Mission 'Total Caketastrophe,' which is available daily. 

Or you can journey into the Clockworks and weed out infestations of these 'Creep Cakes' as much as you like.  Just look for the tell-tale frosting\!
conversation.properties|m.biscotti_1: Hi there, I'm Biscotti, Head Chef of the Skylark\!  We've got a little situation on our hands that may or may not involve sentient, monstrous cakes that may or may not have completely overtaken my kitchen and infested the Clockworks... \n\nAnyway, I've worked it out with the Strangers to provide rewards for turning in slices of cake that prove you've helped eradicate these horrible monsters that may or may not exist.
mission.properties|r.darkest_depths_1a: Thank you Kora, I'm just as glad as anyone to have Haven safe once more.
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_3c: Once you reach Haven I would advise you explore the town and familiarize yourself with all the sights and services the town has to offer. You will gain access to more powerful gear than we offer here as well and be surrounded with many more experienced knights. Be sure to ask them for assistance if you get lost.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_5a: Euclid wasn't your typical knight.  By the time most in his division were getting their Squire crest, he had already achieved Vanguard.  As a Squad Leader, he lead a series of successful assaults against the Morai during the liberation of Isora.  A brilliant tactician, he was known for getting the job done with half the knights of other squads.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_9: Another strange device\! This one was clearly not made by the Almirians any more than the previous device was made by jellies. One thing we've noticed however\: this device is still active. On top of that, the energy signature is similar to the readings we took off the Artifact before it was stolen. This requires some further research I think.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro3_1a: {0}\! Am I glad to see you\!  This place is so alien, I'm happy to see a familiar face and not another hostile.
item.properties|f.thunderous_plate_mail: A legendary suit of armor said to imbue the wearer with the might of heavenly thunder.
helptips.properties|m.tut_shrubs: Try clearing out these shrubs. Plants and other destructible objects often hide treasures.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_4_1: {0}\!  I can hardly believe you managed to confront the Warmaster head on and come out of that inferno alive\!  You've got the makings of a true hero\!
item.properties|f.vitasuit: A special suit that provides a hearty, healthy bonus to the wearer.
item.properties|l.needs_sprite: Requires completion of Rank 2-3 Mission, 'An Eternal Bond' to use this item.
item.properties|f.prismatech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires bullets of photon-charged liquid that split on impact.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
item.properties|f.shadow_dust: A portion of special food favored by battle sprites who gain their powers using forbidden, dark arts.
item.properties|f.amputator: The culmination of slime family research, the heated reciprocating blades cut through all slimes with surgical precision and prevent their gelatinous bodies from reforming.
item.properties|f.lightning_capacitor: An upgraded Capacitor that can explode with the fury of an electrical storm.
item.properties|f.furni_library_bookstac: A loose pile of miscellaneous texts, ranging from cookbooks to eldritch codexes scribbled in unintelligible script.
item.properties|f.dragon_scale_helm: A mythical helmet crafted from the scales of a creature of legend.
item.properties|f.confetti_fall_equinox: When thrown, this fall confetti bursts with autumn embers.
help.properties|m.support_2: If you're lost or having trouble, our Game Masters can help\! They can be contacted by filing a support request.
design.properties|e.room_already_placed: That room has already been installed at another location.
pvp.properties|m.no_reward: You have dishonored my great Coliseum with your lack of fighting spirit\!  You shall receive no Krogmo Coins and no rank points\!
item.properties|f.combuster: Combining the principles of the Skylark's engines with the technology powering the Blast Furnace produced this brutal blade, which can ignite even the most flame-retardant materials at a distance.
item.properties|f.nefarious_raiment: A raiment said to be crafted by a nefarious imp. The ethereal plates will defend against heinous harassment while they shroud you in darkness.
conversation.properties|m.atg_greeter_1a: Welcome to our advanced training hall. Here you will find useful survival tips to help you on your journey through the Clockworks. \n\nWould you like some directions?
item.properties|f.lump_coal: A Grinchlin gift for those who have been naughty or nice.  Grinchlins are equal opportunity party poopers.
dungeon.properties|m.goahead_prompt: Invite party members to follow you\:
conversation.properties|m.mon_pocket_1:
Greetings\! I'm Nonna with the Emberlight Adoption Agency\! 

We at the Emberlight Adoption Agency collect baby monsters that have managed to become lost in the darkest depths of the Clockworks.  No longer having a home or any means of caring for themselves, we try to find these needy monsters a good home\! 

By purchasing one of these adorable 'monster pockets' you can carry around a baby monster of your very own\! 

The Emberlight Adoption Agency will visit Haven from time to time, and you never know what we will have to offer\!
mission.properties|m.shocking_sentient_s: Gaaah\! I need to get out of here\! \n\nEmergency Sneakfield...activate\!
item.properties|f.storm_chaser: A rare elemental found hovering in storm clouds. Their electric hum creates an almost melodic choir that can be faintly heard between thunderclaps.
item.properties|f.frenzy_dragon_helm: An enchanted helm crafted into the visage of a beast who some believe shaped the world in its passing\: its frenzy started the mighty winds, its scales became the shadows.
mission.properties|r.new_threat_5a: Roger that, I'm on my way\!
item.properties|f.fiery_atomizer: A powerful alchemical bomb that creates a dense cloud of highly combustible, searing dust.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_r9: Meet with Biscotti in her kitchen and provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.black_kat_cloak: A crudely crafted cloak made to resemble a shadowy sapper of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
support.properties|m.option_200_1: Be aware that what you consider offensive and personal may not generally be considered offensive. So please consider carefully if everyone would find that chat offensive. If you have read and understood all this and still wish to send the complaint then click here.
helptips.properties|m.mission_trap_chamb: All drones clad in gold armor are invincible.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeknigh: Did you see the view from the Arcade?
item.properties|f.charged_quicksilver_he: An enhanced Quicksilver Helm conductive to the destruction of electrical foes.
social.properties|m.already_played: You have already completed this mission today.
item.properties|f.dark_thorn_shield: A gloomy guard that gives one's sword strikes a supernatural savagery.
item.properties|f.celestial_vortex: A Celestial Bomb modified with a payload of a dying sun. Foes caught in its fiery blast radius are shown a glimpse of the dawn of creation.
item.properties|f.cold_iron_carver: An enchanted sword crafted from cold iron whose blade wards off the creatures of the dark.
item.properties|f.wild_hunting_blade: A legendary cutter feared by even the mightiest of Wolvers and Chromalisks.
item.properties|f.garden_snipes_room: A peaceful garden home to a number of Snipes. Perfect for both relaxing and spinning wildly in place.
item.properties|f.radiant_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within is wild and mysterious, shining brighter than any natural fire.
item.properties|f.honor_blade_2: A ceremonial sword issued to seasoned Spiral Knights. Though intended for formal occasions, its fine edge makes it suitable for combat use.
item.properties|f.winterfest_tree: A spectacularly spiraling tree decorated in the spirit of Winterfest. Folklore states that Impostoclaus leaves presents for those that have been nice throughout the year while those that have been naughty find their presents filled with jelly. Some believe this is the only reason that chromalisks are hostile.
item.properties|f.mega_tundrus: An upgraded tundrus that takes no prisoners, except when it does and then the prison is made of ice. A charged shot can even plow through multiple enemies.
social.properties|m.autofriend_multiple_: These knights have automatically been made your friend\:\n{1}\n{2}
item.properties|f.spur: A mechanized sword with a built in motor that generates energy bursts when used.
item.properties|f.master_blaster: This advanced sidearm is an excellent choice if your adventuring party happens to need another hero.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_2b: I don't understand, the distress signal came from here... but that can't be, right?
mission.properties|b.p_fiend_test_t1: Please refer to the posted instructions when testing this content.
item.properties|f.prize_box_almire_furni: Contains various unique Almire-themed furnishings. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
sprites.properties|d.plentiful_pain: Increases the bonus duration of hexing haze as additional targets are acquired.
item.properties|f.nightmare_mane: A coat of coarse fur taken from a Snarbolax.  Each fiber seems to curl and fray as if life is still flowing through it.
item.properties|f.gold_dragon_helm: A helm once worn by a member of the 'Gold Dragons,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
mission.properties|b.another_trace: The technicians in the Haven Laboratory report that their tracking system has finally been repaired and brought back online. Intel Agent Kora would like to bring you up to speed on the challenges ahead. Contact her via comlink for the details.
item.properties|f.spoiled_treat: A terrible tummy ache awaits those who partake in the fetid fare of Winterfest past.
item.properties|f.cursed_idol: A small, stone statue carved into the form of one of the thousands of arch fiends of the Underworld. The shadowy surface color seems to move and shift like smoke.
item.properties|f.alchemy_room: A utilitarian room equipped with two Alchemy Machines and a General Goods Merchant.
mission.properties|m.ancient_generator_2: You nasty, little things\! Don't you dare touch the artifact\! \n\nArgh\! I'll be back for you\!
helptips.properties|m.tg1_end: Hey, you made it\! That's just great, really. You just saved me a whole lot of paperwork, so thanks. Hope those wolvers weren't too much of a surprise. Head on over to the elevator and we'll call this expedition complete.
projectx.properties|m.downloading: Please wait while we install the rest of the game.
arena.properties|m.chat_all: Spectators may now chat with players.
social.properties|m.friend_party_progres: You must wait for {0}'s party to reach depth {1}.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_3d4b16: Amass an Arsenal that includes a 5 star helmet, armor, shield, gun and bomb.
item.properties|f.prize_box_stranger: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Stranger style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.vial_shock_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing hyper-charged electric fluids. It can be used to inflict enemies with Shock.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes a real ZAP\!
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
helptips.properties|m.final_test: You've made it this far knight - but your final exam will require quick thinking and even faster feet.
item.properties|f.spike_shower: A powerful device designed to shred opponents with a snarl.
item.properties|f.vial_fire: A glass vial containing a molten mixture. It can be used to inflict enemies with Fire.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and turn 'em into toast\!
conversation.properties|r.fc_greeter_1: I've come this far, I need to move forward.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
mission.properties|b.p_r6_mat_3: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
guild.properties|m.treasury_warning: WARNING\: Deposits made to the Treasury cannot be removed. Please review carefully before confirming.
item.properties|f.cryotech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires hyper low temperature bullets that split on impact.
item.properties|f.perplexing_element: A rare metal recovered from a shattered mountain deep within the realm of the Apocrea. Under a microscope it reveals to have a kind of impossible geometry. Perhaps more dedicated study, free from the distractions of the world would reveal its secrets.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_4c: Harness upgrades are definitely worth the crowns. Superior versions of each harness reduce combat skill cooldowns\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_guildhall: Contains random furnishings.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Moorcroft Manor.
item.properties|f.power_mitt: A must have in every kitchen. The comfortable fit and heavyweight silverweave surface are great for handling high heat. Now you're cooking with power\!
item.properties|f.mega_magnus: An upgraded Magnus powerful enough to take a monster's head clean off. A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
mission.properties|m.great_escape_2a: Behold\! The Sparkcaster 9000 Deluxe\! A triumph in gremlin engineering\!
chat.properties|m.usage_auction: Go to the Auction House in Haven.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_3_2a: Well met, {0}. It is good to see you once more. \n\nNow then {0}, for your 4 Star Certification you must be currently equipped with a 4 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
conversation.properties|r.rc_greet2_2a: How can I help channel power to the camp?
mission.properties|o.sewer_stash: Destroy the gremlin war machines hidden in the wasteworks
item.properties|f.super_dark_matter_bomb: A shard bomb stuffed with even more Dark Matter. How much Dark Matter is too much? This much.
item.properties|f.mighty_cobalt_armor: An advanced set of Spiral Knight armor skillfully crafted using the most recently deciphered Clockworks technology.
item.properties|f.blaze_pepper: A delectable spice prized by Clockwork denizens of all sorts. In powdered form, it has a terrible habit of clinging to absolutely everything.
item.properties|f.personal_color: Once used, this item will permanently change your Knight's personal color to the specified color.
item.properties|f.frenzy_warrior_helm: A helm worn by a fabled sword master so fast, his frenzy alone could fell armies before they rose against him.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_weap_3: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
item.properties|f.master_door: Installs a force barrier at the entrance of the room that can only be passed by the Guild Masters of the guild.
item.properties|f.grave_soil: Dreadful dirt dredged from a creepy crypt. It is always a little cold to the touch.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_3: Then use them with honor and let them protect you from the fury of the countless foes you will soon face.  The Core that we seek, there's something truly dreadful about it.  I know that it may very well be what gets us home, but I can't shake this feeling that we've been thinking about it all wrong.
item.properties|f.dragon_scale_shield: A mythical shield crafted from the scales of a creature of legend.
mission.properties|m.prestigious_opportu: Prestige Missions are entirely optional and cannot be repeated in a single day.  And don't forget to keep an eye out for special missions that offer large prestige rewards\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_collec: They burst out of the ground all around us...
chat.properties|m.usage_joinknight: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nAttempts to join a player's instance or party.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.

mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_1:
The Hall of Heroes is where knights go to receive their Star Certification allowing them to access deeper depths of the Clockworks.  Each certification ensures a knight meets the star level required to deal with challenges in the upcoming missions. 

The Hall of Heroes also allows knights the opportunity to speak to veteran knights and discover their loadouts, even offering the opportunity to purchase recipes for these loadouts. 

Visit the Hall of Heroes and receive your 2 Star Certification in order to obtain access to missions within deeper levels of the Clockworks.

mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_4b:
Lastly please instruct your division to cease using our mail system to inform other Undercorp divisions that 'The freezing corruption of lord Maulos is inescapable.'  Improper use of the mail system hurts productivity. 

As your division's disciplinary action will undoubtedly result in relocation to the Eternal Torment Division, this will likely be our final correspondence.  I wish you luck in your continued career here at Undercorp. 

Cheers, 
Morgral'm 
Assistant Supervisor of Resource Allocations, Undercorp 

Attached\: Amu-Sol.pip

support.properties|m.subheader_step207:
Scamming is when a player is trying to trick you into doing something you shouldn't do. Examples\:
- This could be trying to reveal your account name or password.
- Wanting to trade accounts with you.
- Claiming to be a Game Master or a friend of yours and trying take advantage of that.
There are many other ways to scam.

mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.

mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks. These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.

mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_4a: Piercing damage is produced by slime and beast family monsters. Additionally, slime monsters tend to be weak to shadow damage and beasts themselves to piercing damage. Keep this in mind. \n\nNow then, is there anything else you require?
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
chat.properties|m.fail_format: {0} is appalled at that display of failure.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.

uplink.properties|i.crowns: The number of crowns to attach.
item.properties|f.dangerous_oni_helm: A helm worn by members of the Recon Rangers. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of a fiend who lives in the mountains of a distant land. Said to guard the gate to heaven itself, it only allows those who are worthy to pass.
item.properties|f.furni_crate_toughbox_s: It's a rough and tumble security container used for a variety of purposes.
item.properties|f.dragon_scale: An armored scale from what was thought to be an extinct creature. It reflects light with an otherworldly sheen.
mission.properties|b.return_of_ur: A Recon squad has reported that deep within a fiendish city, devilites are attempting to summon a legion of powerful trojan warriors.  Based on intel from a devilite internal memo, the trojans are known as the 'Legion of Ur,' and are said to have once numbered in the thousands.  Strangely, the memo indicated that the Legion of Ur was sealed away in the Underworld and that an alternative approach would be required for bringing them back. \n\nWhatever means the devilites intend to use to bring a few thousand trojans into the Clockworks, they must be stopped.  Infiltrate their city and stop the fiendish army before they become unstoppable\!
item.properties|f.nameless_hat: A nameless hat worn by a nameless hero of legend.
mission.properties|b.strength_unity: Something has riled up a pack of beasts in the Aurora Isles and they have descended upon a Geo Knight research team.  Cornered, the team has sent a distress signal and Spiral HQ has issued the task of saving them to you. \n\nBy standing together, the Geo Knights have made it this long but their time is running out. Assemble a team and confront the beasts that seek to devour your fellow knights\!
item.properties|f.pullover: The perfect pullover for parties and perilous adventures alike.
mission.properties|m.legion_almire_1a:
Nothing like a death-defying romp through a haunted necropolis to really get the blood pumping, eh Rangers? 

The necropolis originates from Almire, fallen kingdom of some crazy lord something-something, population\: innumerable legions of Undead.  Apparently these less-than-living residents are guarding something that Spiral HQ would like to acquire. 

Our job is to recover a special book, a piece of a much larger collection of works that may give us more insight into the nature of this cursed kingdom.  So grab your helmets, and your best zombie-basher- I'm not expecting a warm reception. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!
guildhelp.properties|m.emporium_info:
The Birdsong Emporium allows high-ranking guild members to purchase items for the guild using funds from the Guild Treasury. These items include various Guild Hall furniture items and upgrades. Purchased items go directly into the Guild Treasury, and thus cannot ever be removed from the guild.
 Furniture comes in a variety of types and sizes and is used to decorate your Guild Hall's rooms and halls to make them feel more like home. Some furniture even has special effects when activated\! Any furniture currently in your Guild Treasury can be placed into the Guild Hall using Design Mode.
 The Birdsong Emporium is also where you purchase Guild Upgrades that enhance your guild's capabilities, such as by increasing its maximum member count.
 As a Guild Hall's size increases by adding expansions, the selection of items available in the Birdsong Emporium's catalog also increases. Be sure to check back often to see what's available\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_spritely: Contains various unique accessories and new Sprite colors to celebrate Battle Sprites. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|o.welcome_to_haven: Contact Intel Agent Kora via Comlink

mission.properties|m.first_contact_2a:
You're eager, that's good.  Your current mission is to reach the town of Haven where Spiral HQ has set up base.  Spend the time you need within the Rescue Camp to prepare yourself for your journey to come. 

Make use of any traveling merchants as well as the knowledge of other knights in the camp to learn how to survive in this new world.  I will contact you again once you reach Haven. 

Good luck to you.
conversation.properties|m.winterfest_bra: The path of danger takes you further up this perilous mountain. For now you will pass on the cache of Grinchlin treasures stored here for a chance at an even greater haul further up the mountain. \n\nBe warned\! Should you be overcome by the challenges ahead before reaching the next shelter, you will forfeit all treasures\!

item.properties|f.plate_helm: A heavy duty helm suited for heavy combat.

mission.properties|o.choose_your_sprite: Talk to Morlin and choose a battle sprite as your companion
mission.properties|b.pierce_of_cake: Now that you are undertaking missions in 'Tier 2' of the Clockworks, monsters will begin inflicting special damage types that you need to be aware of and prepare for or else you could face certain doom\! \n\nOne of our lead Biotechs, Hahn, has prepared a brief lesson on piercing monsters. conversation.properties|m.rc_technician_: This thing is useless without power.  How are we supposed to defend ourselves from those monsters?\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_5a: Once again, lots of empty transport crates. Trouble is brewing, {0}. You best go on ahead and clear the area of hostiles so that a rescue squad can arrive safely.
item.properties|f.furni_rainbow: A magnificent arc of refracted light. What does it mean?

He has once again specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'other very informative lecture' that was given to you 'free of charge for the second time' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
item.properties|f.stop_sign: A strange shield capable of stopping many status attacks from harming the user. However it has an unnatural power that causes the user to come to a halt when behind it.

mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
help.properties|m.monster_fiend: Deal SHADOW - Weak to PIERCING - Strong against SHADOW
mission.properties|m.tortodrone_1a:
[All] Important Employee Reminder\: 

An ID Card is required to access the staging area. Properly presenting the ID Card will consume it to power the Grim Gate. Remember\: "When you Use it, you Lose it." 

ID Cards not used in this manner ("lost, broken, or misplaced") will need to be reissued by HR. The cost for a card replacement will be deducted from your next paycheck and a black mark will be added to your employee file. Don't let this happen to you. Don't lose your ID Card. 

Cheers, 
Morgral'm 
Assistant Supervisor of Resource Allocations, Undercorp
projectx.properties|d.achievement_c2f28b: Complete a Tier 1 expedition without having to revive.
item.properties|f.shadow_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who gain their powers using forbidden, dark arts.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_5a: It seemed like the world itself tried to trap you back there, what a close call\! \n\nKeep your wits about you when you go off exploring the Ancient Generator below.  If the surface of this world is crawling with monsters and rigged with traps, who knows what you'll find down there in the dark\!
conversation.properties|r.dark_harvest_e: Sounds like fun\!  I'm off to find the Punkin King\!
sprites.properties|d.enduring_night: Increases duration of the shadow cloak.
mission.properties|r.explosive_plot_1a: Thanks Kora.  I owe a lot to your intel.
sprites.properties|d.bristle: Increases the number of quills fired and their sticking duration.
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet3_1a: You've restored the power and saved us all, {0}\!  I can't thank you enough, all these recruits owe you their lives. \n\nYou should now try to contact Spiral HQ via your comlink.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_2a: As you know I am attempting to assemble a research team to work on-site in the Core terminal.  In order to successfully utilize it to restore the Skylark, it is imperative that we reach it and set up this research station. \n\nAll evidence seems to point towards you having the potential to finally reach the Core.  By breaking through the Firestorm Citadel and establishing a link to the Core, my team could set up the necessary supply lines and get to work immediately.  But we can't do that while that infernal citadel and its horrible ruler stand in our way.
item.properties|f.slumber_squall: A powerful alchemical bomb that creates a thick fog of sleepy mist.

dungeon.properties|m.leaveparty_return: Leave the party and return to {0}.
conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: We're cut off\!  Please help us defeat those lichens\!
dungeon.properties|m.cogmaster_castle_de: Calling all knights\!  Spiral HQ has launched a full-scale assault on the heavily fortified castle of Warmaster Seerus, a devious gremlin of the Crimson Order. All attacks against the sturdy walls and destructive artillery have failed - Spiral HQ needs YOU to turn the tide of the battle and take the fight to the Warmaster himself\!
mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_inf: 'Speak with the one, true voice and they will listen. Quiet as a child's whisper, roaring like the death of this world.'

mission.properties|m.search_continues_4a: I don't know, but it is certainly a terrifying picture she has painted. Something stirs within the heart of this world, {0}, something terrible.  I've felt it since we first set foot on this world; invisible eyes watching our every move, shapes that form just out of view... something greater than gremlins calls this world home.
item.properties|f.token_vanaduke: A seal from the lost kingdom of Almire, proof that the keeper braved the ever-burning abyss known as the Firestorm Citadel.
item.properties|f.prize_box_plunge: Contains various unique costumes and items to celebrate the warm days of summer.  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.voltedge: Combining Spiral capacitor technology with samples recovered from the Ironclaw Munitions Factory produced this blade, which can output a particularly hazardous 1.21 gigawatt discharge.
helptips.properties|m.loading1: The Clockworks below the surface cycle levels in real time. You will never see all the levels a world has to offer in a single trip. Only a true adventurer will discover all the secrets\!
mission.properties|b.prestigious_opportu: It seems you have been excelling in the eyes of Spiral HQ.  Contact Intel Agent Kora and learn how you can take on extra missions from Spiral HQ.
guild.properties|m.storage_warning: WARNING\: Items left here can be taken by any guild member of the appropriate rank.
item.properties|f.furni_chess: A statuesque figurine, ideal for use in a board game.
item.properties|f.needle_shot: An Autogun modified to fire piercing bolts at an alarming rate.
conversation.properties|m.mission_surviv: It hunted us down...got the rest of my team...
mission.properties|b.go_shopping_b: The Haven Bazaar is a place where all manners of item-related goods and services can be found. However, there seems to be some kind of commotion just outside the normally bustling marketplace. It looks like there is no time to waste; there is trouble brewing\!
mission.properties|o.in_cold_blood: Prevent the lost squad from becoming dinner to a lounge of lethal lizards
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: None know for sure. Tinkinzar not seen for many many years. Crimson Order carries out Tinkinzar's plans for Cradle. Emberlight was blight on master plan because built by outcasts. Haven probably the same, founded by non-gremlins. Not part of plan\!
item.properties|f.magma_driver: Spitting gobs of molten death at an alarming rate, this sublime sidearm is not recommended for use around (or on) anyone (or anything) that you happen to care deeply about.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Having smashed the most terrifying zombies to dust, escaped the cold maws of grimalkins and stood victorious in battle against an army of trojans, you have no doubt collected samples from these encounters that would be of great use to Spiral HQ's research teams.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_b45a8d: Travel the entire Clockworks from depth 0 to depth 29 in a single expedition.
conversation.properties|m.sl_guard_3: All Shadow Lairs are locked with a strange mechanism that can only be unlocked with a 'Shadow Key.'  Shadow Keys can be purchased from the Supply Depot. \n\nOnce a party member uses a Shadow Key, the party is locked and cannot be changed, so choose your party members wisely\!
item.properties|f.critter_carapace: A chitinous chunk carefully shucked from a Clockworks creature. It's in surprisingly good shape.
mission.properties|b.first_contact_b: With the power restored to the Rescue Camp, you can now use your comlink to contact Spiral HQ and find out where they have located after the crash of the Skylark.  Once you have made contact with Spiral HQ you will hopefully find out what caused the crash and the nature of this alien world you now inhabit.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_3: they are waiting to ambush you ahead
mission.properties|b.the_flickering_flam: After your victory in Firestorm Citadel, the nature sprites of the great Spirit Mother finally began to make headway in battling the cursed flames engulfing the charred remains of Almire. A recent flare-up has impeded that progress, hinting at some lingering malevolent force that continues to fuel the fires. Contact Intel Agent Kora for details.

conversation.properties|m.rc_end_3b: While the path is dangerous, you will not be traveling very deep, so the monsters you encounter should be easy enough to handle. However, scouts have been reporting increased gremlin activity in the area since we set up camp, so watch out.
sprites.properties|d.dark_veil: Increases the defensive power of the shadow cloak.
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_1a: {0}, I hear you have been promoted to Knight... er, well done, yes?
mission.properties|m.prestigious_opportu: I have faith in you, {0}.  I just know that you will be among the select Knights skillful enough to reach the Core and with any luck, get us off this planet.
conversation.properties|m.core_tech_1: Welcome to the Core on-site research camp.  Got any news from the surface?
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_r7: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.

item.properties|f.sun_shards: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in solar-charged Luminite. Whatever you do, don't look directly at it.

guildhelp.properties|m.storage_info: The Guild Storage acts like a community item bank. Guild members of the appropriate rank can add or remove equipment or items to the Storage as they see fit. It's a great way to share resources between guildmates, or to help out newer members\!\n WARNING\: Items placed in Guild Storage can be removed and claimed by any guild member with access to Guild Storage. Do not put items into Guild Storage that you want to keep for yourself\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: B-beware...they...they are everywhere...in the shadows...\!

conversation.properties|r.fc_court_compl: This will greatly aid me, thank you.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_short_bl: A short, elegant street lamp that emits a blue glow with a gentle hiss.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_mat_1: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_2: During your travels in the Clockworks you will encounter five special minerals\: crimsonite, moonstone, valestone, luminite and dark matter.
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r4: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
sprites.properties|d.concussive_firebolt: Adds a chance for a powerful stun to the firebolt.
conversation.properties|m.fountain_1: Greetings and welcome to Haven\!  If you head north, you'll reach the Arcade where you can get up to speed on the details of our mission.  If you head west, you'll reach the Bazaar, where the Strangers have a selection of gear and weapons for sale.  Be sure to check their stock daily, it changes\!
craft.properties|m.name: Name
social.properties|e.maxfriends_inviter: Sorry, {0} already has the maximum number of friends.
mission.properties|m.ancient_generator_1: What do we have here, more little creatures that came from the sky?  Here to take my power and disturb my research? \n\nNo one disrupts the work of the great Schemer Razwog\!  I'll see to it you never leave this room alive\!
item.properties|f.winter_pullover: A not-so-stylish sweater for the snowy season. The perfect pullover to embarass your family and guildmates alike.
mission.properties|b.spark_roar:
An exceptionally high concentration of constructs has been found guarding an area of the Clockworks that Spiral HQ suspects could be a Crimson Order hideout. Unlike other monsters, constructs don't seem capable of reproducing on their own, meaning that any time one is deconstructed, it's a permanent dent in their numbers. It will be a worthwhile task regardless of Crimson Order influence or not. 

Spiral HQ is requesting that you enter these levels, investigate the possible hideout, and eliminate the construct threat. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with elemental resistant gear with elemental and shadow damage weapons\!
sprites.properties|d.backfire_barrier: Gain a brief movement speed boost upon executing flame barrier.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_10a: Rulen was very... logical.  I think he was very aware of the odds we have of reaching the Core and then doing something with it in order to restore the Skylark.  I think Rulen knew exactly what kind of mission he was undertaking when they made their first descent into the darkness of the Clockworks.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2c: All battle sprites wear a mechanical harness that aligns their skills to a damage type. Not all sprites can wear all harnesses though. For example, a drakon cannot output piercing damage. \n\nBy default, you have an iron harness that any sprite can equip. If you want to branch out as you likely do with your weapons and gear, you need to purchase new harnesses.
item.properties|f.haze_bomb_mkii: A Haze Bomb modified to disperse noxious chemicals over a wider range.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
conversation.properties|m.hunter_1a:
Hello there my good Knight, I am Armero, great hunter of the wilds and curator of this prestigious lodge you see before you. 

On the walls are some of the many trophies claimed from many courageous expeditions, where life and limb were put on the line in order to experience the pure, untamed thrill of the hunt. 

Now I say, do you have the same spark within you? The same taste for the open air, for danger?
item.properties|f.scissor_blades: A custom made Leviathan Blade designed by Bechamel, the Accessorizor.  While these blades are typically used for crafting stylish accoutrements for armor, they are said to be powerful enough to cleave through solid rock.

item.properties|f.vile_striker: A sneaky saber that stores a payload of poison. Its serrated edge is not meant for cutting bread\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight3_1a: We managed to pull the secondary generator from the Skylark mostly intact. Unfortunately it's barely powerful enough to keep this lab running, let alone power our ship.  We'll need to find another power source if we ever hope to return home.
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r7: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We're in\!  This is it\!
item.properties|f.power_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.

mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_danger:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

On behalf of Impostoclaus, Spiral HQ has located the base of operations of the nefarious Grinchlins. It's time to take the fight to them and end their Winterfest terrorism once and for all. But it won't be an easy task. 

Those who accept this mission must climb Mount Krampus, a perilous trek filled with Grinchlin ambushes and icy deathtraps. Along the way you will find shelters that allow you to collect Grinchlin treasures and escape the mountain, or press on toward the summit for even greater rewards\! Just be warned\: Grinchlins and their allies are a stingy lot and will not drop ANY loot. All the treasures to be found on Mount Krampus are at the shelters. And should you pass on them for greater rewards ahead, you risk losing everything if you fail\! 

Some say that on the very summit of Mount Krampus lies a stash of Grinchlin loot that may contain treasures none have ever seen before...

uplink.properties|m.royal_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we've detected another Recon Module of the Alpha Squad within this palace.  It is your mission to locate and retrieve the module. 

The Royal Jelly Palace is a strange place.  It appears to be some sort of castle that slimes have re-purposed as a residence for members of their oozing aristocracy.  Known as a 'Royal Jelly,' these noble slimes are said to rule over their countless loyal subjects with an iron fist-shaped appendage. 

Our intel suggests that the module is located somewhere near an enormous concentration of slimes, so it is reasonable to believe that it may be the 'throne room' of a Royal Jelly.  If so, be prepared for a fearsome fight- Royal Jellies are quick to anger and love to throw their enormous weight around.  Your best bet is to find a way to suppress their natural regenerative abilities. 

Good luck\!

mission.properties|m.silent_legion_recon:
I am drawn to this place. 

In the eyes of these silent warriors I see myself\: cold, strong, unflinching... and crumbling. I have been asked to let it go, to move on, but this I cannot do. 

Their faces, their dying cries... they haunted me in my dreams, so I no longer sleep.  Now I see them when I close my eyes, so I shall not blink. 

I will remain here, among the stones... never blinking, never forgetting.

mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.

mission.properties|b.king_of_ashes:
Within the ever-burning depths of the Firestorm Citadel, Lord Vanaduke lies in wait for any living being to pass into his accursed kingdom.  Any squad that has ever attempted to infiltrate the citadel has perished or was simply lost, like the countless lost souls bound to this terrible realm. 

Lord Vanaduke is ready for war, believing in his twisted mind that any who dare enter the citadel to be an invading force bent on overtaking his kingdom.  He stands as the last obstacle before gaining access to the Core and the Spiral Knights having any chance of restoring the Skylark and returning home. 

As a Champion of the Spiral Knights, you alone have what it takes to lead a team into the very heart of this inferno and face the titanic might of Lord Vanaduke.
